methodology: Selected public WNN articles by date and topic; article descriptions are concise extracts, not editorial endorsements. Date and source links verified at retrieval.

articles.title: Rosatom signs floating nuclear power deal for Indonesia
articles.summary: Rosatom and an Indonesian partner announced an electricity-supply arrangement for northern Halmahera using two proposed floating nuclear units with 200 MW of combined capacity.

articles.title: AEP, Amazon and X-energy planning 12-SMR plant
articles.summary: American Electric Power and X-energy agreed to assess a 960 MW, 12-unit Xe-100 project in Indiana, with Amazon expected to support development and power offtake.

articles.title: Joint venture to produce HALEU in South Africa
articles.summary: Quantum Leap Energy and South Africa's Necsa set out a proposed Pelindaba venture to develop test and commercial production of high-assay low-enriched uranium.

articles.title: Oklo plans isotope facility under US Launch Pad initiative
articles.summary: Oklo outlined plans for its Groves-2 Forge isotope production and processing pilot facility alongside its isotope-reactor development programme.

articles.title: Mochovce 4 connected to the grid
articles.summary: Slovakia's Mochovce 4 began supplying electricity to the grid, marking a commissioning milestone.

articles.title: Norwegian used fuel to be stored in Sweden
articles.summary: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning selected Studsvik to manage and process used research-reactor fuel under an agreement running through 2055.

articles.title: Multiple milestones for India's nuclear projects
articles.summary: India reported progress on Kakrapar units 5 and 6, component manufacturing for fleet construction and a design milestone in its SMR programme.

articles.title: Thorizon, TNO launch MSR materials programme
articles.summary: Thorizon and TNO launched corrosion and materials testing to support qualification and licensing of molten-salt reactor components.

articles.title: US DOE funding to accelerate molten salt reactor development
articles.summary: US DOE approved cost-shared funding for the Molten Chloride Reactor Experiment, which is targeting first criticality in 2027.

articles.title: Milestone for Bruce 4 refurbishment
articles.summary: Bruce Power completed installation of 480 calandria tubes for the unit 4 refurbishment, progressing its major component replacement programme.

articles.title: Joint venture formed for six-unit SMR plant in Poland
articles.summary: SGE and ZE PAK agreed to create a venture for a potential 1,800 MW project at Pątnów comprising as many as six BWRX-300 reactors.

articles.title: Newcleo opens MOX fuel development centre
articles.summary: Newcleo inaugurated a EUR10 million fuel engineering and testing centre in France to support its mixed-oxide fuel development work.

articles.title: MHI delivers replacement steam generators for French reactor
articles.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries delivered three replacement steam generators intended for EDF's Cruas unit 2.

articles.title: US maritime nuclear firm Bluecore Energy announces uranium purchase
articles.summary: Bluecore Energy announced acquisition of low-enriched uranium as it advances its maritime nuclear development plans.

articles.title: Hot testing of Chinese SMR under way
articles.summary: Hot functional testing began at the ACP100/Linglong One small reactor demonstration project in Hainan, a pre-fuel-loading commissioning step.

articles.title: Kairos Power automates fuel pebble inspections
articles.summary: A new facility at Kairos Power's Manufacturing Development Campus in Albuquerque, New Mexico, verifies manufacturing specifications and engraves each fuel pebble with a unique code so it can be traced through testing and operation.

articles.title: Namibia takes step towards nuclear power
articles.summary: Namibia appointed a Nuclear Commissioner to coordinate the institutions and planning needed for a potential domestic nuclear power programme.

articles.title: Westinghouse places initial orders for Polish plant
articles.summary: Westinghouse issued conditional orders for safety-related AP1000 modules to four Polish companies, an early supply-chain milestone for Poland's first plant.

articles.title: Agreement signed on second Polish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polish state entities agreed on responsibilities for preparatory work for the country's proposed second nuclear power station.

articles.title: Agreement aims to support US maritime nuclear
articles.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping and US DOE agreed to advance research and feasibility work on floating nuclear power and nuclear-powered shipping.

articles.title: Czech SMR environmental impact assessment submitted
articles.summary: ČEZ submitted environmental impact documentation for a proposed Rolls-Royce SMR at Temelín, advancing the project's permitting process.

articles.title: IAEA carries out fresh LTO review mission to Oskarshamn
articles.summary: The IAEA reviewed safety preparations for long-term operation at Sweden's Oskarshamn 3 reactor.

articles.title: NND applies to take over Kjeller nuclear facilities
articles.summary: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning applied for the licence to take responsibility for Kjeller research facilities ahead of decommissioning.

articles.title: Bangladesh's Rooppur 1 achieves criticality
articles.summary: Bangladesh's first commercial nuclear unit reached first criticality during commissioning.

articles.title: Milestone for Urenco USA expansion project
articles.summary: Urenco USA brought a sixth new enrichment cascade into production, reaching 75% completion of its current capacity addition.

articles.title: Hyundai E&C tests used fuel repository excavation equipment
articles.summary: South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction announced it has employed equipment it has developed to excavate a full-scale deposition hole for used nuclear fuel disposal in the bedrock at its research demonstration site.

articles.title: Hanhikivi-1 termination decision cases 'to continue'
articles.summary: Disputes surrounding the terminated Hanhikivi 1 nuclear project remain in arbitration and related proceedings.

articles.title: Hydraulic tests completed at Turkey's Akkuyu 1
articles.summary: Hydraulic tests to check the primary circuit systems and equipment at unit 1 of Turkey's Akkuyu nuclear power plant have been successfully completed, paving the way for hot functional tests to begin.

articles.title: Latest Terrestrial Energy topical report submission could lead to faster deployment
articles.summary: Approval of the Thermal and Electric Facility Topical Report submitted by the company to US regulators would mean that part of the Integrated Molten Salt Reactor plant would be classed as a conventional industrial, rather than nuclear, project, allowing it to be built and operated ahead of nuclear licensing.

articles.title: JAIF estimates economic impact from nuclear power plants
articles.summary: The economic impact generated over the lifecycle of a single 1,200 MWe nuclear power plant is about JPY4.3 trillion (USD27.2 billion), according to the Japan Atomic Industrial Forum.

articles.title: Framatome to continue maintaining Sizewell B plant
articles.summary: Framatome and EDF have renewed their long-term service agreement covering a comprehensive range of maintenance and outage services to support the long-term operation strategy of the Sizewell B nuclear power plant in Suffolk, England.

articles.title: Poland begins ordering long-lead components for first AP1000
articles.summary: Poland advanced procurement of long-lead equipment for its planned first AP1000 nuclear project.

articles.title: China's Tianwan 7 connected to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 7 at China's Tianwan plant connected to the grid in another commissioning milestone.

articles.title: Last Energy's Texas micro-modular reactor clears safety analysis
articles.summary: The Department of Energy's approval of the Documented Safety Analysis clears Last Energy's planned pilot reactor at Texas A&M-RELLIS to move into the readiness review, the final step before authorisation for criticality and reactor operations.

articles.title: Thorizon, Urenco to cooperate on MSR fuel cycle
articles.summary: A memorandum of understanding with the molten salt reactor developer Thorizon will examine Urenco's potential role in the molten salt fuel supply chain and how depleted uranium could become a fuel resource for advanced nuclear.

articles.title: Westinghouse teams up with Hyundai E&C for Dutch FEED studies
articles.summary: South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction has been contracted by Westinghouse to carry out basic design studies for the construction of two large nuclear power plants in the Netherlands based on Westinghouse's AP1000 design.

articles.title: Slovakia buys out Czech stake in new nuclear project company
articles.summary: ČEZ has sold its 49% stake in JESS, the company formed to develop new nuclear capacity in Slovakia, for EUR189 million (USD211 million).

articles.title: Swiss citizens may get to vote on construction of new reactors
articles.summary: The Alliance for Secure Electricity Supply has launched a campaign for the lifting of the ban on new nuclear power plant construction in Switzerland. It comes as a broad coalition claims to have collected enough signatures in support of a referendum against the construction of new plants.

articles.title: German uranium oxide storage facility commissioned
articles.summary: Uranium enrichment services provider Urenco has officially commissioned the uranium oxide storage facility at its site in Gronau, Germany. Construction of the facility was completed several years ago.

articles.title: Key equipment installed in BREST-OD-300 turbine hall
articles.summary: Two separator-superheaters, each 16 metres tall and weighing 95 tonnes, have been installed in their design positions for the innovative lead-cooled BREST-OD-300 fast neutron reactor.

links.label: information paper on fast neutron reactors

articles.title: Deployable Energy to test its Unity nuclear battery in DOME
articles.summary: Deployable Energy's Unity demonstration reactor has been selected by the US Department of Energy's National Reactor Innovation Center for testing inside the Demonstration of Microreactor Experiments, or DOME, testbed at the Idaho National Laboratory in 2027.

articles.title: Fusion firm Xcimer announces fresh DOE milestones award
articles.summary: American laser fusion company Xcimer says it has finalised an agreement for up to USD30.5 million of funding through the US Department of Energy's Milestone-based Fusion Development Program.

articles.title: DOE offers Vistra loan for reactor upgrades and uprates
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has announced a conditional loan commitment of up to USD4.2 billion to finance uprates and modernisation projects at Vistra Corp's Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse and Perry nuclear power plants.

articles.title: BWXT's BANR microreactor selected for Canadian project
articles.summary: BWX Technologies says that its BANR microreactor has been selected by Prodigy Clean Energy, Pabineau First Nation and Eel River Bar First Nation for a proposed project in Belledune in New Brunswick.

articles.title: Concreting milestones at Chinese Hualong One units
articles.summary: The concreting of the inner containment dome has been completed at unit 3 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, while concrete pours have also been completed at units 1 and 2 of the Zhaoyuan plant in Shandong province.

articles.title: Second part of construction permit application submitted for SMRs at Palisades
articles.summary: Holtec has submitted the Preliminary Safety Analysis Report to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for two small modular reactor units at the Palisades Energy Center in Michigan, completing the second phase of the Construction Permit Application process.

articles.title: NPCIL signs MoU for Gujarat nuclear power projects
articles.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited and Gujarat State Electricity Corporation Limited have signed a memorandum of understanding to explore and identify suitable sites in India's Gujarat state for new nuclear power plant projects.

articles.title: Constellation, Amazon agree nuclear-focused power purchase deal
articles.summary: A 20-year power purchase agreement signed by tech giant Amazon will enable Constellation to add 190 MW of capacity and extend the operating life of the Calvert Cliffs nuclear power plant in Maryland in the US.

articles.title: First construction permit issued for BWRX-300 SMR in the US
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a construction permit for the Tennessee Valley Authority's planned GE Vernova Hitachi BWRX‑300 small modular reactor at the Clinch River site.

links.label: for its gas-plus-nuclear project in Texas

articles.title: NRC completes environmental review of Crane restart
articles.summary: The US regulator, together with the Department of Energy Office of Energy Dominance Financing, has issued an environmental assessment and finding of no significant impact for environmental effects from proposed Federal actions related to reauthorising power operations at the Christopher Crane Clean Energy Center in Pennsylvania.

articles.title: Taiwan regulator completes review of restart plan
articles.summary: Taiwan's nuclear regulator has completed its review of Taipower's plans for the restart of the Maanshan nuclear power plant, which was submitted earlier this year.

articles.title: Milestone for X-Energy's TRISO-X fuel facility
articles.summary: Construction of the 214,000-square-foot building which will house the TX-1 advanced nuclear fuel facility in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, has been completed.

articles.title: Agreement clears way for resumption of Niger uranium project
articles.summary: The Mining Convention for the Madouela project formalises a framework agreement announced in August and triggers the process to discontinue international arbitration proceedings over the project in Niger.

articles.title: US-Turkey agreement to accelerate SMR deployment
articles.summary: The US Trade and Development Agency has signed an agreement with Turkey's state-owned nuclear development enterprise TÜNAŞ to fund technical assistance to create the regulatory, institutional, and financial roadmap needed for Turkish private sector companies to deploy small modular reactor nuclear technology.

articles.title: Polish plant contract negotiations move to next stage
articles.summary: The Westinghouse-Bechtel consortium and Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe have agreed the main commercial and legal terms of the Engineering, Procurement and Construction contract that will deliver Poland's first nuclear power plant, and plan to complete the contract negotiation process by the end of this year.

articles.title: Second reactor manufactured for floating nuclear plant
articles.summary: The second RITM-200C small modular reactor unit has been manufactured for the floating nuclear power plant destined to supply electricity to a copper mining centre in Chukotka.

articles.title: China's giant crane for nuclear power plant construction
articles.summary: China General Nuclear says the 250,000-ton-metre lifting torque ring-rail crane rolled off the production line last month to support the construction of Hualong One 2.0 nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Contracts announced as Pickering refurb approaches
articles.summary: The Province of Ontario has announced the signature of more than CAD3 billion (USD2.1 billion) worth of contracts for the refurbishment of four units at Ontario Power Generation's Pickering plant as site construction for the project gets under way.

articles.title: SGE confident of UK SMR fleet prospects
articles.summary: The team behind plans for a fleet of 14 BWRX-300 small modular reactors in the UK says they are confident of the economic model and supply chain capability to deliver these units.

articles.title: Škoda JS to supply control rod drives for Rolls-Royce SMR's reactors
articles.summary: Czech company Škoda JS has been chosen as sole supplier of control rod drive mechanisms for Rolls-Royce SMR's future small modular reactors.

articles.title: Framatome secures first contract for higher enriched fuel
articles.summary: Framatome announced it has signed a commercial contract to deliver the world's first nuclear fuel reload with uranium-235 enrichment above the industry standard of 5%, to an operating nuclear reactor in the USA.

articles.title: Google agreement to support Georgia plant uprates
articles.summary: A new agreement will see Google support uprates on Georgia Power's share of the Vogtle and Hatch plants, which will add around 96 MW of new capacity to the grid.

articles.title: Indian plants celebrate fuel loading milestones
articles.summary: As fuel loading begins at Rajasthan Atomic Power Project unit 8, Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd has started geotechnical investigations for the next two units at the plant. Meanwhile, fuel loading has begun at Kaiga unit 1 as the unit begins the process to return to service after refurbishment.

links.label: summary of the current status of India's…

articles.title: France prepares to start dismantling first UNGG reactor
articles.summary: EDF subsidiary Cyclife announced the Chinon A nuclear power plant dismantling project has reached a major milestone with the validation of the contractual strategy for dismantling the Chinon A2 plant's heat exchangers.

articles.title: Antares, Centrus sign multi-year HALEU contract
articles.summary: Pre-payments under the contract will support Centrus's ongoing expansion of its uranium enrichment capacity, with deliveries of high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) to support Antares' advanced reactor projects, including for space and national security missions, to begin by the end of the decade.

articles.title: Cameco in offtake agreement for US laser enrichment plant
articles.summary: Canadian company Cameco Corporation is to buy all of the future production of GLE's planned Paducah Laser Enrichment Facility in Kentucky under a newly announced exclusive offtake agreement.

articles.title: Blue Energy submits first construction application to NRC
articles.summary: Blue Energy has submitted the first part of its construction permit application to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for its planned gas-to-nuclear project in Texas.

articles.title: US funding for Thai SMR feasibility study
articles.summary: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand has signed an agreement with the US Trade and Development Agency for a feasibility study on the deployment of US small modular reactor technologies in Thailand.

articles.title: China begins building hydrogen-boron fusion device
articles.summary: The ENN Group has held a groundbreaking ceremony for the ENN Fusion Spherical Ring Hydrogen-Boron Plasma Platform (Helong-2) project at the group's fusion R&D centre in the Langfang Economic and Technological Development Zone in China's Hebei Province.

articles.title: Holtec SMR project gets regulatory nod for early site work
articles.summary: An exemption granted by the US regulator means Holtec can go ahead with certain works before the issuance of a Limited Work Authorisation for two small modular reactor units at the Palisades Energy Center in Michigan.

articles.title: First SMR funding agreed by European Investment Bank
articles.summary: The European Investment Bank is to invest up to EUR40 million (USD46 million) in Finland's small modular reactor company Steady Energy, whose LDR-50 reactor is designed specifically for district heating networks.

articles.title: China launches Global Network for SMR Innovation
articles.summary: China Atomic Energy Authority has launched the Global Network for SMR Innovation with the aim of supporting small modular reactor technology progress, standards and deployment "helping make nuclear energy safer, more affordable and more accessible in support of climate action and sustainable development".

articles.title: eVinci sets temperature record during zero-power criticality tests
articles.summary: Westinghouse says the completion of zero-power high-temperature criticality testing for the microreactor, which saw it reach criticality at 663 degrees Celsius, is a defining milestone in the programme's build-test-learn development journey.

articles.title: Indiana to get its first power-producing nuclear reactor
articles.summary: A commercially owned and operated micromodular reactor is to be installed at Naval Weapons Station Crane, becoming the US Navy's first shore-based advanced micromodular reactor as well as the state of Indiana's first power-producing reactor.

articles.title: Groundwork begins for demonstration Hualong One 2.0 units
articles.summary: Site levelling and excavation work for the second phase of the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang Province has begun, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. The site will eventually house six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units.

articles.title: Chubu withdraws restart applications for Hamaoka units
articles.summary: Japanese utility Chubu Electric Power Company has said it will withdraw applications for regulatory reviews of units 3 and 4 at its Hamaoka nuclear power plant in Shizuoka Prefecture after an independent committee found that workers felt under pressure from senior management to manipulate earthquake data submitted to the regulator.

articles.title: Red Book confident on uranium resources to meet future growth
articles.summary: The global uranium sector is responding to growing interest in nuclear capacity expansion, according to the latest assessment by the OECD Nuclear Energy Agency and the International Atomic Energy Agency. But investment is needed to turn resources into supply.

articles.title: Tips from China's 56-month nuclear construction schedule
articles.summary: The President of China's State Nuclear Power Technology Corporation, Ma Yuanhua, shared their "thinking and practice" in developing a fleet-based construction process which now has a target of 56 months for new nuclear power units.

articles.title: Uranium companies see new chapter for the market
articles.summary: The momentum that is currently driving the East's appetite for uranium is not currently being matched in the West - but new types of customers are starting to show interest in buying uranium as part of forward-looking strategies, according to senior executives from the world's two largest uranium-producing companies.

articles.title: Westinghouse fuel approved for Czech Temelín units
articles.summary: The Czech Republic's State Office for Nuclear Security has given the go-ahead for Westinghouse's fuel to be used at ČEZ's VVER-1000 units at Temelín Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: Bannerman completes Etango funding, moves towards FID
articles.summary: Bannerman Energy has completed an AUD124 million (USD89 million) underwritten placement which - together with the company's other financial arrangements - is expected to fully fund the Namibian Etango project through construction and ramp-up as the company moves towards a Final Investment Decision.

articles.title: Google signs up for electricity from Finnish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Tech giant Google has signed a long-term power purchase agreement with Finland's Fortum covering up to 50% of the Loviisa nuclear power plant's capacity and providing financial certainty for power uprates and lifetime extensions until 2050.

articles.title: Groundwork begins at new Chinese plant site
articles.summary: Full-scale site levelling work for the initial phase of the Laiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong Province has begun, State Power Investment Corporation announced. The site will eventually house six Guohe One (CAP1400) units.

articles.title: Centrus to supply Radiant with microreactor fuel
articles.summary: US enrichment company Centrus Energy and California-based nuclear microreactor developer Radiant have signed a definitive multi-year contract to supply high-assay, low-enriched uranium fuel needed to deploy multiple Kaleidos microreactors.

articles.title: Orano, KHNP expand cooperation in uranium enrichment
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a letter of intent with French nuclear fuel cycle company Orano for long-term cooperation in the uranium enrichment sector.

articles.title: US Department of Energy closes loan for Duane Arnold restart
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy's Office of Energy Dominance Financing has closed a loan of up to USD1.9 billion to NextEra Energy to help finance the restart of the Duane Arnold Energy Center, taking the company closer to bringing Iowa's only nuclear power plant back into operation.

articles.title: Rolls-Royce SMR, ABB agree to collaborate
articles.summary: ABB has signed a memorandum of understanding with the UK's Rolls-Royce SMR through which ABB will explore how its automation and electrification solutions can be used in the delivery of company's standardised, factory-built small modular reactors.

articles.title: Construction under way of second Zhaoyuan unit
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 2 at the Zhaoyuan nuclear power plant. It is the second of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site in China's Shandong province.

articles.title: Kairos completes first phase of testing in ETU 3 reactor mockup
articles.summary: Testing at the mockup of the Hermes 2 reactor cavity has validated aspects of the precast concrete shielding design and remote handling and maintenance capabilities to support Kairos Power's Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant and future commercial fleet.

articles.title: Argentina aims for 2027 launch of RA-10 multipurpose reactor
articles.summary: The National Atomic Energy Commission and the Secretariat for Nuclear Affairs say commissioning of the RA-10 multipurpose reactor will begin before the end of the year - and outlined plans for private financing for the associated production plant.

articles.title: US Launch Pad supports reactor and fuel projects
articles.summary: Projects included in the second round of selections under the US Nuclear Energy Launch Pad initiative to promote the rapid development and implementation of advanced nuclear technologies by private industry include companies focused on fuel cycle innovation as well as reactor developers, with plans for a new conversion facility and a fuel fabrication plant at…

links.label: a letter from the company's CEO

articles.title: Siemens Energy to produce Rolls-Royce SMR turbines in the UK
articles.summary: Key steam turbine components - including high-pressure turbines and valve casings - for Rolls-Royce SMR's first three small modular reactors at the Gwyndod project on Anglesey in North Wales, will be manufactured at Germany-based Siemens Energy's facility in Newcastle, in northeast England.

articles.title: Rosatom signs EPC contract for Kazakhstan nuclear plant
articles.summary: An engineering, procurement and construction contract for Kazakhstan's proposed Balkhash Nuclear Power Plant has been signed by Rosatom and Kazakhstan Nuclear Power Plants.

articles.title: Rosatom considers Murmansk site focused on floating power plant construction
articles.summary: The establishment of a new facility to help meet the future anticipated demand for floating power plant orders is being considered by Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom.

articles.title: India and Uzbekistan eye uranium deal as ties grow
articles.summary: The leaders of India and Uzbekistan have announced plans to increase bilateral trade to USD5 billion per year. A long-term uranium supply arrangement looks likely to be part of that.

articles.title: Fuel loading under way for Palisades restart, Holtec announces
articles.summary: The loading of fuel into the reactor has begun at Palisades nuclear power plant in the US, as Holtec International continues to move towards the first restart of a closed-down unit.

articles.title: Ampera, LLNL team up for TRISO fuel development
articles.summary: US microreactor developer Ampera Inc has announced a strategic partnership project with the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory to further the development of scalable, advanced nuclear fuel for use in advanced nuclear energy systems, including compact and subcritical reactor platforms.

articles.title: Outer dome hoisted at Xudabao unit 1
articles.summary: The outer dome of the double-layered containment building has been installed at unit 1 of the Xudabao nuclear power plant in Liaoning Province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: Newcleo-led consortium to develop floating nuclear plant
articles.summary: A consortium led by France-headquartered innovative reactor developer Newcleo has been awarded funding to develop the conceptual design of a nuclear barge able to host multiple 200 MWe small modular reactors.

articles.title: Testing under way for Atucha 2's dry storage facility equipment
articles.summary: Argentina's Nucleoeléctrica says that testing of key equipment is under way as part of the verification process before the commissioning of the dry storage facility for used fuel, which is under construction for Atucha 2.

articles.title: Welding of Akkuyu 2's primary circuit completed
articles.summary: The reactor, steam generators and reactor coolant pumps are all connected in the primary circuit of Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant's second unit, after the completion of the welding of the main coolant pipeline.

articles.title: Drilling of deposition holes starts at Onkalo
articles.summary: Workers have begun drilling the first deposition hole for use at the Onkalo underground used nuclear fuel repository near Olkiluoto, Finland.

articles.title: Holtec's SMR-300 test facility taking shape at INL
articles.summary: Holtec International says the HI-TEST facility - a one-third scale representation - will probe the SMR-300 design margin and potentially support future power uprates.

articles.title: US Army selects five microreactor techs for deployment
articles.summary: The US Department of the Army has selected five microreactor developers for deployment at five Department of War installations as part of its USD2.2 billion Janus Program.

articles.title: Fortum's NuCore Energi applies for Swedish state support for new nuclear
articles.summary: NuCore Energi - a subsidiary of Finnish utility Fortum - has submitted an application to the Swedish government for state support for the construction of new nuclear generating capacity adjacent to the existing Oskarshamn site.

articles.title: Niger awards Arlit uranium mining permit to state-owned company
articles.summary: Niger's Council of Ministers has awarded a mining permit previously held by Orano to the state-owned company set up earlier this year to replace SOMAÏR.

articles.title: Reactor technology selection process progresses in Netherlands
articles.summary: EDF and Westinghouse have been awarded contracts by the Nuclear Energy Organisation of the Netherlands - the state-owned company established for the construction and operation of two new large nuclear power plants - to carry out design studies for the plants.

articles.title: Pacific Fusion breaks ground on New Mexico facility
articles.summary: California headquartered pulsed magnetic fusion system developer Pacific Fusion has broken ground for its USD1 billion Research and Manufacturing Campus in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

articles.title: Rosatom and Egypt discussing more potential units
articles.summary: Egypt's Ministry of Energy and Russia's Rosatom have held talks to review progress on El Dabaa Nuclear Power Plant's construction - and also discussed further potential large and small reactor options.

articles.title: Second EPR site authorised for site preparations
articles.summary: The French government has given EDF the go-ahead to start site preparation work for the second pair of new EPR2 reactors proposed for construction.

articles.title: Criticality testing milestone for Westinghouse's eVinci reactor
articles.summary: Zero-power criticality testing for the eVinci microreactor has been successfully completed, Westinghouse Electric Company has announced.

articles.title: Blykalla submits second SMR plant application
articles.summary: Sweden's Blykalla has submitted a proposal to the Swedish government for a nuclear power plant at Untra in the Tierp municipality which would feature up to eight lead-cooled small modular reactors with a total capacity of up to 440 MWe.

articles.title: Myanmar SMR site work 'could start in 2027'
articles.summary: Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom expects to sign a contract for initial engineering surveys in Myanmar by the end of the year, with work on site beginning in 2027.

articles.title: Core Power teams up with US Administration on maritime nuclear
articles.summary: Core Power said it is targeting first construction "from 2028" under a newly announced federal-private cooperation framework to accelerate the commercial, industrial and regulatory pathway for a future fleet of US-flagged nuclear-powered merchant ships.

articles.title: Xudabao control room simulator commissioned
articles.summary: The full-scope simulator for units 1 and 2 of the Xudabao nuclear power plant in China's Liaoning province has entered operation and will be used for training operators of the two CAP1000 reactors.

articles.title: Atomic Eagle reaches agreement on Niger uranium project
articles.summary: Atomic Eagle Limited has reached an agreement with the Republic of Niger to re-establish its interest in the Madaouela Uranium Project, which was expropriated from previous holder GoviEx Uranium Inc in 2024.

articles.title: 'New realities' for Kazatomprom as demand accelerates
articles.summary: The era of "cheap" uranium is fading away, Kazatomprom's CEO told investors in a half-year financial results call that also gave updates on forthcoming contracts and delays to an acid plant construction project.

articles.title: Reactors installed on nuclear-powered icebreaker Leningrad
articles.summary: The two RITM-200 nuclear reactors have been installed on the nuclear-powered icebreaker Leningrad, which is under construction at the Baltic Shipyard.

articles.title: Ur-Energy makes first shipment from Wyoming uranium project
articles.summary: Ur-Energy has made the first shipment of uranium from its Shirley Basin uranium mine, marking the project's transition to full operations and making the company a multi-asset uranium producer.

articles.title: IAEA project focuses on research reactor testing of fuels and materials
articles.summary: A four-year project aims to develop technical guidance to help produce more effective, safer and efficient testing of new reactor and fuel technologies in research reactors.

articles.title: Kaleidos microreactor begins journey to Idaho
articles.summary: Radiant's 1 MWe microreactor - which is designed to be transportable - is making the journey from California to the DOME test bed at Idaho National Laboratory on the back of a truck.

articles.title: Detritiation facility reopens at Culham
articles.summary: The Materials Detritiation Facility at the UK Atomic Energy Authority's Culham Campus, in Oxfordshire, UK, has resumed operation after being offline for a year for upgrades enabling research into materials which have been removed from the Joint European Torus facility.

articles.title: FANCO advances engagement with regulator on HALEU plant
articles.summary: The company says the US regulator has docketed its regulatory engagement plan for a facility to manufacture ceramic fuel for its EAGL-1 small modular reactor, and plans to submit a construction and operation licence application in 2027.

links.label: the publicly available version of the plan

articles.title: India begins public consultation on SHANTI Bill rules
articles.summary: India's Department of Atomic Energy has launched a public consultation on its draft rules and regulations under the 2025 legislation to modernise the country's nuclear legal framework and, amongst other things, enable limited private participation in India's nuclear sector.

links.label: the documents which the Department of Atomic…

articles.title: IAEA sees enhanced safety at Philippine research reactor
articles.summary: The Philippines has made progress in implementing recommendations aimed at strengthening the safe operation of its sole nuclear reactor training facility, the PRR-1 SATER, according to an International Atomic Energy Agency team of experts.

articles.title: Construction starts at Saskatchewan uranium mine
articles.summary: NexGen Energy Ltd has marked the official start of construction at the Rook I Project in northern Saskatchewan, kicking off a four-year construction pathway for the mine which is expected to produce some 30 million pounds of uranium every year.

articles.title: CNNC to procure contract for high-temperature reactor
articles.summary: China National Nuclear Corporation plans to soon procure a high-temperature reactor engineering contracting project for the first phase of the Xuwei nuclear power project in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: Construction of Bailong 2 conventional island begins
articles.summary: The first concrete pour has been completed for the basemat of the conventional island of unit 2 at the Bailong nuclear power plant in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of southern China, State Power Investment Corporation announced.

articles.title: First fuel loaded into Tianwan unit 7

articles.title: US collaboration to study used nuclear fuel recycling
articles.summary: US advanced nuclear recycling technologies firm Curio has signed a memorandum of understanding with NuScale Power and Framatome to evaluate how recovered materials from used nuclear fuel can support future fuel and product streams.

articles.title: Water levels to be increased in Zaporizhzhia's used fuel pools

articles.title: X-Energy and Centrus sign HALEU supply agreement

articles.title: Finnish regulator gives positive decision on used fuel repository

articles.title: McDermott to support potential Dutch Rolls-Royce SMR projects

articles.title: Argentina's Nucleoeléctrica signs MoU relating to life extension project in Romania

articles.title: Nuclearelectrica's proposal to review SMR options rejected by ministry
articles.summary: Romania's state-owned nuclear company had asked shareholders to approve "the initiation of steps to reassess the initial development strategy for small modular reactors by expanding the analysis to include other SMR technologies and broadening the list of potential sites (in the event of a decision to scale up)".

articles.summary: EDF Energy has highlighted what it sees as the positive impact on people and the economy resulting from the Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant project in Somerset, England.

articles.title: Agreement on UAE nuclear workforce development
articles.summary: The Emirates Nuclear Energy Company has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with the Department of Government Enablement – Abu Dhabi, represented by the Mawaheb Talent Hub, to establish a comprehensive framework for the training and employment of UAE nationals in the growing civil nuclear energy sector.

articles.title: First RITM-200 reactor unit manufactured for floating nuclear plant
articles.summary: The RITM-200C reactor will be one of two which will together be installed on the first of Russia's planned fleet of floating nuclear power units.

articles.title: Oklo selected for US surplus plutonium programme
articles.summary: Nuclear technology company Oklo has been selected by the US Department of Energy for advanced negotiations under the Surplus Plutonium Utilization Program, which aims to turn designated surplus plutonium material into fuel for advanced reactors.

articles.title: Assystem, AtkinsRéalis contracted to support EDF in the UK
articles.summary: French engineering group Assystem and Canadian engineering firm AtkinsRéalis have both been appointed by EDF and Sizewell C Limited to a new five-year Professional Services Framework.

articles.title: Third application lodged for Swedish SMR plant
articles.summary: Swedish nuclear technical services provider Studsvik has submitted an application to the Swedish government to construct a small modular reactor power plant at its existing site in Nyköping in Södermanland County.

articles.title: Approval milestone for US microreactor project
articles.summary: Weeks after being selected for US Department of Energy support under the Nuclear Energy Launch Pad programme, microreactor developer Deployable Energy has received the department's approval of the Preliminary Documented Safety Analysis for its Unity microreactor.

articles.title: Vessel for Newcleo technology demonstrator installed
articles.summary: France-headquartered innovative reactor developer Newcleo announced that the main vessel for its PRECURSOR non-nuclear demonstrator has been installed at the ENEA Brasimone Research Centre, near Bologna, Italy.

articles.title: 'Largest ever shipment' for a single nuclear plant
articles.summary: A reactor pressure vessel, four steam generators and a pressuriser, have been shipped together from Volgodonsk in Russia to Egypt's El Dabaa Nuclear Power plant.

articles.title: TAE, UKAEA joint venture formally established
articles.summary: US private fusion energy company TAE Technologies and the UK Atomic Energy Authority have announced that TAE Beam UK - their joint venture focused on commercialising particle accelerator technology for fusion and non-fusion applications - has been formally established in the UK and is now fully funded.

articles.title: Antares signs long-term HALEU supply deal with Urenco
articles.summary: Urenco will supply high-assay low-enriched uranium for Antares' planned deployment of microreactors in North America and other markets.

articles.title: US enrichment plant begins accelerated review
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission intends to complete its technical review of Orano Enrichment USA's application for a licence to build and operate the Project IKE uranium enrichment facility within 12 months.

links.label: NRC said in its acceptance of Orano's…

articles.title: Atucha II granted 10-year licence renewal
articles.summary: Argentina's Nuclear Regulatory Authority has renewed the operating licence for Atucha II Nuclear Power Plant until May 2036.

articles.title: Kazakhstan outlines localisation plans
articles.summary: The Kazakh government has approved a resolution aimed at developing a domestic industrial base for the implementation of nuclear power plant construction projects.

articles.title: TerraPower and HD Hyundai sign Natrium reactor agreements
articles.summary: The shipbuilding subsidiary of South Korea's HD Hyundai has been selected as preferred manufacturer for TerraPower's Natrium Reactor Enclosure System components, one of a series of agreements aimed at the "rapid commercialisation and deployment of a fleet of Natrium … plants in the coming years".

links.label: transferred part of its stake in TerraPower…

articles.title: Holtec and Rwanda advance plans to deploy SMR-300s
articles.summary: Holtec and Rwanda's Atomic Energy Board signed an early-stage development agreement to assess SMR-300 deployment.

articles.title: Licensing milestone for Texas SMR plant
articles.summary: The US regulator has completed its environmental assessment of the proposed Long Mott Generating Station advanced reactor facility at Dow Chemical's manufacturing site in Texas ahead of schedule.

articles.title: NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy agree deal
articles.summary: NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy have announced plans to combine in an all-stock transaction valued at about USD66.8 billion that they say will create the world’s largest regulated electric utility business.

articles.title: Blykalla applies to build Swedish SMR plant
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla has submitted an application to the government to construct a power plant in Norrsundet, Gävle, in east central Sweden, comprising six SEALER reactors.

articles.title: IAEA concern after drone strike close to Barakah nuclear power plant
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency says it has been informed by the UAE that radiation levels at the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant remain normal and no injuries reported "after a drone strike ... caused a fire in an electrical generator located outside the inner site perimeter of the NPP".

articles.title: Permit issued for second phase of Grohnde dismantling work
articles.summary: PreussenElektra has received the second and final permit needed for the dismantling of the Grohnde nuclear power plant in Germany.

articles.title: US federal funds awarded to spur SMR deployment
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has selected eight companies to collectively receive more than USD94 million in federal cost-shared funding to support the near-term deployment of advanced light-water small modular reactors in the USA by addressing key barriers in licensing, supply chain, and site readiness.

articles.title: Contest launched to name UK's first SMR plant
articles.summary: The people of Anglesey in North Wales are being asked to suggest a name which is "easy to pronounce and welcoming to a wide audience" for the small modular reactor plant which is to be built at the Wylfa site on the island.

links.label: until 17:00 on 8 June to submit their…

articles.title: FANCO and AtkinsRéalis form strategic alliance for SMR deployment
articles.summary: The two companies will work together to establish a scalable framework for deploying First American Nuclear Co's (FANCO) EAGL-1 small modular reactor and associated fuel facilities, with AtkinsRéalis providing engineering services.

articles.title: First RITM-200 reactor unit manufactured for Leningrad nuclear icebreaker
articles.summary: The RITM-200 reactor unit is the eleventh so far manufactured at the ZiO-Podolsk plant, part of Rosatom's machine-building division.

articles.title: Joint effort sees research reactor fuel removed from Venezuela
articles.summary: A fast-tracked international effort to remove all the remaining high-enriched uranium from a legacy research reactor in Venezuela has been completed, with the material now set to be processed into high-assay low-enriched uranium for use in the USA.

articles.title: Indian reactor set to restart as private sector plans progress
articles.summary: As India's nuclear regulator gives the go-ahead for the second unit at India's oldest nuclear power plant to restart operations after major refurbishment work, NTPC, India's largest integrated power company, is ready to submit its first feasibility study for a nuclear project to the Department of Atomic Energy.

articles.title: Experiments provide data for SMR passive cooling system simulations
articles.summary: Researchers at Switzerland's Paul Scherrer Institute have experimentally investigated passive cooling systems for small modular reactors, collecting high-resolution measurement data for the first time.

articles.title: World Nuclear Fuel Cycle: How best to meet growing demand?
articles.summary: Volatile geopolitical times bring considerable challenges, but also mean that more and more countries are looking to nuclear energy to boost energy security and meet economic and clean energy goals. How to turn that enthusiasm into action was a feature of discussion at the World Nuclear Fuel Cycle 2026 conference.

articles.title: Nuclear fuel loading completed at Rooppur 1
articles.summary: The process of loading 163 nuclear fuel assemblies into Bangladesh's first nuclear power plant reactor has been completed.

articles.title: Construction begins on fourth Taipingling unit
articles.summary: The first nuclear safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 4 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant in Huizhou in south China's Guangdong province. It is the fourth of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

articles.title: TerraPower starts work on flagship Ac-225 facility
articles.summary: TerraPower Isotopes announced it has broken ground in the Bellwether District of Philadelphia on what it claims will be the world's largest actinium-225 manufacturing facility.

articles.title: USA and Japan mark historic HALEU shipment
articles.summary: The cooperative effort to transfer 1.7 tonnes of high-assay low-enriched uranium - HALEU - fuel from Japan to the USA has been hailed as a pivotal step in reducing nuclear proliferation risks and enhancing global security while supporting the US domestic supply chain.

articles.title: Concreting completed of Kursk II's third reactor building foundation
articles.summary: Rosatom says that the pouring of concrete for the foundation of the third unit at Kursk II nuclear power plant has been completed ahead of schedule.

articles.title: Funding boost for Bruce C pre-development work
articles.summary: Ontario's government has announced a cost-sharing and recovery agreement enabling Bruce Power to move ahead with an estimated CAD300 million (USD220 million) of pre-development work for the Bruce C new nuclear project.

articles.title: Innovative thorium-based fuel concludes irradiation campaign
articles.summary: Nuclear fuel company Clean Core Thorium Energy announced its patented ANEEL fuel has successfully reached more than 60 GWd/MTU of burnup in the Advanced Test Reactor at Idaho National Laboratory.

articles.title: Fuel loading completed at two new Chinese units
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the cores of Taipingling unit 2 and Changjiang unit 3 - both Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors - has been completed ahead of their start-ups.

articles.title: Ship modified for transport of used MOX fuel
articles.summary: Pacific Nuclear Transport Limited's Pacific Grebe ship is the first of its fleet to be adapted to carry a new flask for the transportation of used mixed oxide fuel.

articles.title: Fuel loading begins at Changjiang 3
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 3 at the Changjiang nuclear power plant is under way. It is the first of two Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors under construction as the second phase of the site in China's Hainan province.

articles.title: Darlington SMR project's foundation module milestone
articles.summary: The giant Basemat module, which will serve as the foundation of the reactor building for the first small modular reactor to be built in a G7 country, has been set into place 35 metres below ground in the excavated reactor building shaft.

articles.title: Second Indian fuel cycle complex gets operating licence
articles.summary: The Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has issued an operating licence for the NFC-Kota fuel plant at Rawatbhata in Rajasthan.

articles.title: Grid connection requested for US fusion power plant
articles.summary: US private fusion company Commonwealth Fusion Systems has applied to connect its first ARC fusion power plant to PJM Interconnection, the largest US competitive wholesale electricity market. The plant is expected to start up in the early 2030s.

articles.title: Pilot operation completed of fuel with minor actinides
articles.summary: Three trial uranium-plutonium MOX fuel assemblies containing americium-241 and neptunium-237 were loaded into the Beloyarsk BN-800 fast neutron reactor core in the summer of 2024. After completing three fuel campaigns they will now cool in a used fuel pool before undergoing post-irradiation studies.

articles.title: First unit at San'ao enters commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the San'ao nuclear power plant has entered commercial operation, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Zhejiang province.

articles.title: US research reactor first to produce electricity
articles.summary: In the coming months, the University of Utah's TRIGA research reactor will be used to produce electricity to power a mini AI data centre as part of proof-of-concept for powering full-scale data centres with microreactors.

articles.title: Fuel loading begins for Bangladesh’s first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: A ceremony has been held in Bangladesh to mark the start of the loading of 163 nuclear fuel assemblies into Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant’s first unit.

articles.title: Flushing of safety systems begins for Kudankulam unit 3
articles.summary: The flushing of safety systems at unit 3 of India’s Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant is described as a key moment, signifying the beginning of the active commissioning phase.

articles.title: Czech SMR project - early works contract signed
articles.summary: Czech nuclear operator ČEZ has signed an early works contract with Rolls-Royce SMR for the proposed construction of a small modular reactor at Temelín. ČEZ has also signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Industry and Trade to consider the investor model and possible sources of financing.

articles.title: Funding pledge and tributes paid at Chernobyl anniversary
articles.summary: Tributes have been paid to those who risked their lives tackling the aftermath of the Chernobyl accident in 1986, with a fundraising process launched for ongoing safety work at an international conference held at the plant.
