Chernobyl at 40: Wildlife and science in the…

articles.title: TerraPower starts construction of 'first US utility-scale advanced nuclear plant'
articles.summary: TerraPower has announced the official start of construction on its first Natrium plant, Kemmerer unit 1 in Wyoming. The Bill Gates-chaired company says the unit will be the first utility-scale advanced nuclear power plant in the United States.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at third Zhangzhou unit
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 3 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. Zhangzhou 3 is the third of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

articles.title: Uzbek uranium mine enters commercial production
articles.summary: Navoiyuran has announced the start of commercial in-situ uranium recovery at the Qizilkok deposit, located in the Navoi region of Uzbekistan.

articles.title: Regulator extends Hermes 1 reactor construction deadline
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved Kairos Power's request that the completion date specified in the construction permit for its Hermes 1 demonstration reactor be extended by 28 months.

articles.title: JSC Dalur construction at new uranium deposit gets regulatory approval
articles.summary: Nuclear regulator Rostekhnadzor has issued a certificate for the successful construction and installation of the first mobile sorption unit at the Verkhne-Uksyanskaya deposit of the Dalmatovskoye uranium deposit.

articles.title: First new Kursk unit 'ready for commercial operation'
articles.summary: The first VVER-TOI unit at the Kursk II Nuclear Power Plant in Russia has successfully completed pilot operation and is ready for commercial operation, Rosatom says.

articles.title: OSGE and development agency sign agreement for Polish SMR project
articles.summary: Poland's Orlen Synthos Green Energy has signed a letter of intent with the country's Industrial Development Agency to collaborate on the preparation for the construction and operation of small modular reactors at the Strategic Investment Park in Stalowa Wola.

articles.title: EC to examine Romanian plans for funding reactor refurbishment
articles.summary: The European Commission has opened an in-depth investigation to assess whether public support that Romania plans to grant for the refurbishment and lifetime extension of unit 1 at the Cernavoda nuclear power plant is in line with EU state aid rules.

articles.title: First Taipingling unit enters commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Taipingling nuclear power plant has entered commercial operation, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: Kairos breaks ground for Hermes 2 reactor
articles.summary: The Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, will be the company's first commercial-scale reactor and is the first power-producing Gen IV reactor to receive a construction permit from the US regulator.

articles.title: Dutch agreement paves way for construction of commercial MSR
articles.summary: A memorandum of understanding has been signed for the construction of a non-nuclear demonstrator Thorizon molten-salt reactor in the Dutch province of Zeeland, a nuclear demonstrator at Petten, Noord-Holland, followed by the first commercial unit in Zeeland.

articles.title: UK awards GBP100 million in contracts for prototype fusion plant
articles.summary: Britain's Tokamak Energy has been named magnet systems partner for the UK's STEP Fusion programme, while France's Dassault Systèmes has been contracted to expand STEP's product lifecycle management capability.

articles.title: CNL to produce demonstration ANEEL fuel bundles
articles.summary: Nuclear fuel company Clean Core Thorium Energy has signed an agreement with Canadian Nuclear Laboratories for the manufacture of demonstration irradiation bundles of its patented ANEEL thorium and high-assay low-enriched uranium fuel.

articles.title: Bruce Power to share large reactor experience with SaskPower
articles.summary: Bruce Power has signed a memorandum of understanding with SaskPower to share its expertise in nuclear generation, project development, and long-term operations as Saskatchewan evaluates large nuclear technologies for potential use in the Canadian province.

articles.title: Growing recognition of nuclear fuel cycle's importance, WNFC hears
articles.summary: This is a significant time of change for the nuclear energy sector - and existing nuclear capacity is the bedrock for nuclear growth that could be unprecedented, according to nuclear industry leaders at the World Nuclear Fuel Cycle 2026 conference in Monaco.

articles.title: Kashiwazaki-Kariwa 6 resumes commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 6 of the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant has resumed commercial operation, becoming the first reactor owned by Tokyo Electric Power Company to do so since the accident at its Fukushima Daiichi plant.

articles.title: Grohnde nuclear fuel transfer completed
articles.summary: All the used nuclear fuel assemblies in the storage pool at Germany's Grohnde nuclear power plant have been transferred to an on-site interim storage facility, PreussenElektra announced.

articles.title: SGE to cooperate with Spanish fuel manufacturers
articles.summary: Poland's SGE has signed cooperation agreements with Spanish nuclear fuel manufacturers Enusa Industrias Avanzadas SA and GNF Enusa Nuclear Fuel SA to support the deployment of BWRX-300 small modular reactors across Europe.

articles.title: US Air Force names potential SMR hosts
articles.summary: Buckley Space Force Base in Colorado and Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana have been selected by the US Department of the Air Force as potential locations to site microreactors under the Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations programme.

articles.title: Conditional funding announced for US fusion-based isotope facility
articles.summary: The award to SHINE Chrysalis LLC, through the Department of Energy's Office of Energy Dominance Financing, is dependent on the company satisfying technical, legal, environmental, and financial conditions.

articles.title: Contract signed for delivery of UK's first SMRs
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR and Great British Energy - Nuclear have signed a contract that enables work to start immediately on the delivery of three Rolls-Royce small modular reactors at Wylfa, on the island of Anglesey, North Wales. In addition, the National Wealth Fund is committing up to GBP599 million (USD805 million) to Rolls-Royce SMR to support the development of…

articles.title: Third unit at Korea's Saeul plant starts up
articles.summary: Unit 3 at the Saeul nuclear power plant has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power announced. It is the third of four APR-1400 reactors that have begun operating at the site.

articles.title: Dismantling of reactor channels to begin at second Ignalina unit
articles.summary: With the dismantling of the reactor channels of unit 1 at Lithuania's Ignalina nuclear power plant complete, the country's nuclear regulator has now issued a permit for dismantling and decontamination works on the upper and lower zone equipment of the reactor channels of unit 2.

articles.title: New Korean reactor cleared for start up
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission said it has completed all nine inspections required to be performed prior to the reactor's initial criticality during the pre-operation inspection of Saeul unit 3.

articles.title: Framatome signs VVER-440 fuel agreement with EU utilities
articles.summary: France's Framatome has signed an agreement with four European energy companies - ČEZ, Fortum, MVM Paks NPP and Slovenské elektrárne - to further develop a fully European fuel for VVER-type nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Production begins at US uranium project
articles.summary: Uranium Energy Corp's Burke Hollow in Texas is the first new in-situ recovery operation to start up in the USA in over a decade.

articles.title: Testing of innovative VVER fuel begins
articles.summary: Unit 1 of Russia's Balakovo nuclear power plant has begun pilot operation using accident-tolerant MOX fuel assemblies.

articles.title: Commission calls for Norway to prepare for nuclear energy
articles.summary: The Norwegian Nuclear Commission has recommended that the government does not start a process for nuclear power development in the country at this stage, but says it should prepare for its possible future use.

articles.title: GE Vernova Hitachi, AFRY to collaborate on SMR deployment
articles.summary: Sweden-based engineering, project management and advisory company AFRY has entered into a non-exclusive collaboration with GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy to support the deployment of BWRX-300 small modular reactor technology.

articles.title: Construction of second Jinqimen unit begins
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 2 at the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. It is the second of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the plant.

articles.title: First criticality for Indian fast breeder reactor
articles.summary: India's 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam achieved its first sustained fission chain reaction.

articles.title: South Korean reactor restarts after three-year outage
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has restarted unit 2 at its Kori nuclear power plant, which had been offline since its original 40-year operating permit expired in April 2023.

articles.title: Belarus set for role in Smolensk nuclear construction
articles.summary: A working meeting requested by Smolensk Governor Vasily Anokhin has been held "to discuss the coordination of joint efforts and the participation of Belarusian partners in the Smolensk NPP-2 construction project".

articles.title: OPG applies for operating licence for BWRX-300 SMR
articles.summary: Canada's Ontario Power Generation has submitted its application for a licence to operate the first BWRX-300 small modular reactor at the Darlington New Nuclear Project.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Lianjiang unit 2
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 2 of the Lianjiang nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It is one of two CAP1000 reactors planned for the first phase of the plant.

articles.title: Polish companies team up for regional SMR deployment
articles.summary: Poland's SGE, construction engineering firm Polimex Mostostal and engineering consultant ATEC Group have signed a memorandum of understanding to cooperate on the development and deployment of BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Central and Eastern Europe.

articles.title: Milestone for Palisades restart
articles.summary: Holtec International has announced the completion of passivation of the primary system, bringing it to operating temperature and pressure for the first time since the plant was shut down in 2022.

articles.title: Constellation seeks regulator's help for 2027 plant restart
articles.summary: Constellation Energy still expects to restart the Crane Clean Energy Center - formerly known as Three Mile Island unit 1 - in 2027 despite possible grid connection delays.

articles.title: EC launches investigation into French nuclear funding plans
articles.summary: The European Commission has launched an in-depth investigation into whether France's planned public support for its new nuclear programme is within the European Union’s rules on state aid.

articles.title: Ukraine's cabinet approves nuclear fuel production plan
articles.summary: Energoatom says construction of the production facility for nuclear fuel assemblies will be an important step towards Ukraine's energy independence.

articles.title: Korean reactor gets go-ahead to restart
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has been given approval by South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission to restart unit 2 at its Kori nuclear power plant, which has been offline since April 2023 when its original 40-year operating permit expired.

articles.title: Application lodged for Poland's first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has submitted an application to Poland's National Atomic Energy Agency for a construction permit for the country's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Holtec SMR design clears key UK regulatory stage
articles.summary: Holtec International's SMR-300 small modular reactor design can potentially be built, operated and decommissioned in a manner that is safe and secure, UK regulators have concluded after the design completed Step 2 of the Generic Design Assessment.

articles.title: South Africa's Necsa seeks SMR partnership
articles.summary: The South African Nuclear Energy Corporation has launched an Expression of Interest process which "aims to identify capable technology partners … to advance a fit-for-purpose SMR technology for future deployment".

articles.title: Rooppur 1 boron flushes completed, ahead of fuel loading
articles.summary: Bangladesh's first nuclear power reactor has taken a fresh step towards starting up, after the successful completion of boron flushing of the first unit's primary circuit piping systems.

articles.title: New US company plans uranium conversion facility
articles.summary: Newly-launched FluxPoint Energy says it is developing what it expects will be the first new uranium conversion facility in the USA in 70 years.

articles.title: Excavation work approved for India's Mahi Banswara units
articles.summary: India's Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has approved the start of activities towards excavation for construction of the Mahi Banswara Rajasthan Atomic Nuclear Power Project units 1 and 2.

articles.title: Taipower applies to restart Maanshan plant
articles.summary: Taiwan Power Company has submitted a plan to the Nuclear Safety Council for the restart of the Maanshan nuclear power plant, whose two units were taken offline in July 2024 and May 2025 following the expiry of their 40-year operating licences, in accordance with Taiwan's nuclear phase-out policy.

articles.title: Rolls-Royce SMR, Studsvik enhance collaboration
articles.summary: The UK's Rolls-Royce SMR has signed a memorandum of understanding with Swedish nuclear technical services provider Studsvik to explore further collaboration and broaden their relationship across Studsvik's full range of services to support the small modular reactor programme.

articles.title: Pilot operation for REMIX fuel completed
articles.summary: Three fuel assemblies with uranium-plutonium REMIX fuel have completed their third 18-month VVER-1000 fuel cycle at Russia's Balakovo Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: Uzbekistan and Russia mark SMR construction progress
articles.summary: Russia and Uzbekistan have signed a roadmap for nuclear cooperation, as initial concrete was poured as part of preparations for the construction of the first small modular reactor at Uzbekistan’s first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Data centre to be built near planned Polish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Renewable energy developer WBS Power has announced plans for a 3.2 GW data centre campus in the municipality of Choczewo in northern Poland's Pomerania region. It says the nuclear power plant planned to be built nearby will help provide a stable power supply.

articles.title: Vietnam, Russia sign agreement on new nuclear plant
articles.summary: An intergovernmental agreement has been signed on cooperation in the construction of the Ninh Thuan 1 Nuclear Power Plant in Vietnam, to feature two VVER‑1200 reactors, with the new Leningrad units as the reference project.

articles.title: Application submitted for Swedish SMR plant
articles.summary: Kärnfull Next has submitted an application to build a power plant based on small modular reactors in the municipality of Valdemarsvik in Östergötland county in southeastern Sweden. It is the first application under the country’s new Act on Government Approval of Nuclear Facilities.

articles.title: Early construction landmarks for Chinese units
articles.summary: The giant CA20 structural module of Bailong nuclear power plant's unit 1 has been lifted into place - and the first steam generator moved into position at Lufeng nuclear power plant's unit 6.

articles.title: Framatome to supply low-enriched fuel for Belgium's BR2 research reactor
articles.summary: The Belgian Nuclear Research Centre SCK-CEN has signed a contract with Framatome to supply fuel for the BR2 research reactor, which is converting from the use of high-enriched uranium fuel to low-enriched uranium fuel.

articles.title: Aalo completes assembly of experimental reactor
articles.summary: Aalo Atomics has held a ceremony to unveil its completed Critical Test Reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory. The company said it expects the reactor to achieve criticality "well before" the 4 July deadline.

articles.title: X-energy, Talen to assess deployment of multiple SMR plants
articles.summary: US advanced nuclear technology developer X-energy Reactor Company has signed a Letter of Intent with Talen Energy Corporation to assess deploying X-energy's XE-100 small modular reactors in Pennsylvania and across the PJM Interconnection Regional Transmission Organization market.

articles.title: Work begins on solar power supply at Chernobyl
articles.summary: Preparatory work has begun for installing solar panels which the operators of the Chernobyl plant site say will help meet energy needs if external power is lost.

articles.title: Kazakhstan updates on nuclear energy, uranium plans
articles.summary: An intergovernmental agreement with Russia on the construction of the Balkash Nuclear Power Plant, and the signing of an EPC contract, are among priorities set out by Kazakhstan's Atomic Energy Agency for 2026.

articles.title: Planning for Swedish SMR plant proceeds
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla said it plans to proceed with the next phase of planning for a power plant in Norrsundet, Gävle, in east central Sweden, after initial assessments confirmed that the site offers suitable conditions.

articles.title: 'Projectile' hit 350 metres from Bushehr nuclear reactor - IAEA
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has said that "following information from Iran of a projectile incident on Tuesday evening, the IAEA can confirm that a structure 350 metres from the Bushehr NPP reactor was hit and destroyed".

articles.title: NANO outlines progress on HALEU transport package
articles.summary: NANO Nuclear Energy says it has achieved a series of key engineering milestones in its development of an "optimised transportation solution for High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium fuel".

articles.title: Licensing of Oklo pilot reactor facilities advances
articles.summary: Nuclear technology company Oklo has received US Department of Energy approval for the Nuclear Safety Design Agreements for both its first Aurora powerhouse at Idaho National Laboratory and Atomic Alchemy's Groves Isotopes Test Reactor in Texas. Atomic Alchemy has also been granted a materials licence for the isotope reactor.

articles.title: Key contracts awarded in UK fusion programme
articles.summary: The ILIOS consortium has been appointed as the construction partner for the UK's STEP Fusion programme, while Kinectrics has been named as the design and fabrication partner for the UKAEA-Eni H3AT Tritium Loop Facility. The appointments came as the government published its Fusion Energy Strategy.

articles.title: Pilot operation of accident-tolerant fuel completed
articles.summary: The third and final pilot 18-month operation of accident-tolerant fuel has been completed at Rostov Nuclear Power Plant’s unit 2.

articles.title: First new Kursk unit reaches full power
articles.summary: The first VVER-TOI unit at the Kursk II Nuclear Power Plant in Russia has had its power increased to 100% as its commissioning process continues.

articles.title: First San'ao unit connected to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the San'ao nuclear power plant has begun supplying electricity to the grid for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Zhejiang province.

articles.title: Infrastructure work under way for Namaru uranium deposit
articles.summary: Service roads and power lines are being constructed as part of JSC Khiagda's infrastructure work for the Namaru deposit in the Bauntovsky District of Buryatia in Russia.

articles.title: Regulatory justification for Rolls‑Royce SMR
articles.summary: UK Secretary of State for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, Emma Reynolds, has decided to provide regulatory justification for the Rolls‑Royce SMR design - the first small modular reactor to receive this approval.

articles.title: Construction of Bushehr nuclear power units 'remains a priority'
articles.summary: Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said that a further 150 people evacuated from Iran have arrived back in Moscow, adding that "the construction itself - the second and third units - remains a top priority for the corporation".

articles.title: Arup to support delivery of the UK's first SMR
articles.summary: Multinational professional services firm Arup has been appointed by Great British Energy - Nuclear to provide early-phase foundation engineering and design support for the construction of its small modular reactor project at Wylfa on the island of Anglesey, North Wales.

articles.title: Deep Fission begins drilling first data acquisition well
articles.summary: California-based startup Deep Fission, which aims to place small modular reactors in boreholes a mile underground, has begun drilling the first of three planned data acquisition wells in Parsons, Kansas, where it is building its pilot project.

articles.title: EDF launches global nuclear investment and financing advisory board
articles.summary: The Financing and Investing in Nuclear - Advisory Board EDF brings together leading experts from across the energy and finance ecosystems to facilitate the financing of, and investment in, new nuclear projects globally.

articles.title: Framatome and NuScale expand fuel partnership
articles.summary: France’s Framatome and the USA's NuScale Power have announced their fuel manufacturing agreement is to include European fuel fabrication facilities.

articles.title: Equilibrion assesses nuclear-derived sustainable aviation fuel
articles.summary: The UK's Rolls-Royce SMR has signed a memorandum of understanding with strategic and technical consultancy and project development company Equilibrion to collaborate on a technical and economic assessment of sustainable aviation fuel produced using small modular reactors.

articles.title: Studsvik acquires Swedish SMR project development firm
articles.summary: Swedish nuclear technical services provider Studsvik has announced its acquisition of small modular reactor project development company Kärnfull Next, expanding its role from supporting the world's existing nuclear fleet into the development of new nuclear projects.

articles.title: Oklo, Centrus explore advanced nuclear fuel joint venture
articles.summary: Centrus Energy and Oklo have announced discussions on a joint venture "focused on deconversion services for high-assay low-enriched uranium and the advancement of related fuel-cycle technologies and supply chains".

articles.title: Rook I uranium project gets construction approval
articles.summary: NexGen Energy has received the final regulatory approval for the Rook I uranium project in northern Saskatchewan, and will begin construction later this year.

articles.title: Decommissioning of Finnish research reactor completed
articles.summary: Finland's Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority has declared that the site of the country's first nuclear reactor is no longer classified as a nuclear facility following the dismantling of the Finnish Reactor 1 in Espoo.

articles.title: Mini drones used to explore Fukushima 3 reactor
articles.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company has begun its internal investigation of Fukushima Daiichi unit 3's primary containment vessel, using palm-sized micro-drones.

articles.title: NRC issues construction permit for first Natrium plant
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved a construction permit for TerraPower's Kemmerer unit 1 project - the first such permit for a commercial-scale non-light water reactor in the country for four decades.

articles.title: Contracts awarded for Dukovany control system modernisation
articles.summary: The work includes replacement of the unit control systems of the primary and secondary circuits on all four generating units at the Dukovany nuclear power plant in the Czech Republic.

articles.title: Aalo secures fuel and turbine for experimental reactor
articles.summary: Aalo Atomics, a US developer of sodium-cooled small modular reactors for data centres, has signed a fuel fabrication contract with Global Nuclear Fuel. Meanwhile, Baker Hughes has been contracted to supply the steam turbine for Aalo-X, Aalo's experimental reactor.

articles.title: Standard design approval sought for i-SMR
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission has received an application for standard design approval for the Innovative Small Modular Reactor from the i-SMR Technology Development Project Group.

articles.title: Fisher German lands Wylfa advisory contract
articles.summary: UK land and property consultancy Fisher German has secured a contract to provide Great British Energy - Nuclear with expert advice during the planning and delivery of its small modular reactor project at Wylfa on the island of Anglesey, North Wales.

articles.title: KHNP, EMA to cooperate on Singapore SMR study
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a memorandum of understanding with Singapore's Energy Market Authority to cooperate on civil nuclear energy, particularly small modular reactors.

articles.title: Cameco and India sign new uranium supply agreement
articles.summary: Cameco agreed to supply nearly 22 million pounds of uranium ore concentrate to India from 2027 through 2035.

articles.title: 'Transformative' research reactor mooted for Texas A&M
articles.summary: The Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station has signed an agreement with advanced small modular reactor company ZettaJoule to explore building a very-high temperature modular reactor that could attract USD1 billion in research funding.

articles.title: Amazon and Meta agreements boost Vistra nuclear plants
articles.summary: Landmark power purchase agreements with companies including Amazon Web Services and Meta are supporting Vistra Corp's plans to relicense and uprate its nuclear plants - but the focus on uprates is likely to come after 2028, the company's CEO has said.

articles.title: Lithuania assessing potential for BWRX-300 deployment
articles.summary: Poland's SGE, Ignalina Nuclear Power Plant operator Altra and GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to assess the potential for BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Lithuania.

articles.title: Potential sites identified for SMRs in Chernobyl exclusion zone
articles.summary: The State Agency of Ukraine for Exclusion Zone Management has said that sites by two long-abandoned villages have been identified as potential locations for future small modular reactors.

articles.title: Agreement to build German nuclear fusion power plant
articles.summary: Munich-based Proxima Fusion has signed an agreement with the Free State of Bavaria, RWE, and Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics to construct the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant at the former Gundremmingen nuclear power plant site.

articles.title: First concrete for Kaiga 5 & 6 in India approved
articles.summary: India's Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has given its consent for the first pour of concrete for Kaiga units 5 and 6 - which are both 700 MWe pressurised heavy water reactors.

articles.title: Lloyd's Register approves hybrid powered ship design
articles.summary: UK-based classification society and professional advisory service Lloyd's Register has issued approval in principle to Australian ship design group Seatransport Pty Ltd for a concept of a hybrid nuclear-diesel powered ship.

articles.title: New heat-resistant steel developed for BR-1200
articles.summary: Rosatom says a new austenitic steel has been developed for the primary circuit of the planned lead-cooled BR-1200 reactor where the operating temperature will be 500-600 degrees Celsius.

articles.title: Contract signed for generic Polish BWRX-300 design
articles.summary: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy and Orlen Synthos Green Energy have signed an agreement to develop a detailed technical design of the BWRX-300 small modular reactor adapted to Polish regulations, safety standards and environmental conditions.

articles.title: NANO signs MoU exploring MMR deployment in UAE
articles.summary: NANO Nuclear Energy has signed a memorandum of understanding with Abu Dhabi-based EHC Investment LLC to explore the potential deployment of KRONOS micro modular reactors in the United Arab Emirates.

articles.title: Urenco to supply fuel for Deep Fission reactors
articles.summary: Deep Fission, which aims to place small modular reactors in boreholes a mile underground, has signed an agreement to purchase low-enriched uranium from Urenco USA to support demonstration and testing of its initial Gravity reactor, as well as early commercial operations.

articles.title: Denison to proceed with Canada's first ISR uranium mine
articles.summary: Denison Mines Corp's Board of Directors has made the final investment decision to proceed with the construction of the Phoenix in-situ recovery uranium project in Saskatchewan, with site preparation and construction activities planned to start next month.

articles.title: Russian uranium mining hit targets in 2025, expansion planned
articles.summary: Rosatom has reported that uranium mining companies achieved their production plans in 2025 and are expanding their mineral resource base.

articles.title: Contract for Sellafield plutonium storage containers
articles.summary: UK pressure vessel manufacturer LTi Metaltech Ltd has been awarded a contract worth more than GBP45 million (USD60 million) by Sellafield Ltd to manufacture and supply containers for use in Sellafield's Product and Residue Store Retreatment Plant.

articles.title: Partners discuss licensing for Brazil's phosphate-uranium project
articles.summary: The Santa Quitéria Project is expected to produce about 2,300 tonnes of uranium concentrate per year, as part of Brazil's plan to become self-sufficient in nuclear fuel production.

articles.title: Philippines streamlines licensing for nuclear projects
articles.summary: The Philippine government has completed a "harmonised, whole-of-government licensing and permitting flowchart" for nuclear power plant projects, a key step toward enabling the safe and efficient operation of nuclear power facilities by 2032.

articles.title: Environmental approval for Saskatchewan uranium project
articles.summary: Australia-headquartered Paladin Energy Limited has received approval from the Government of Saskatchewan for its Environmental Impact Statement for development of its Patterson Lake South project, located in the Athabasca Basin, Canada.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Lufeng 6
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been hoisted into place at unit 6 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It is the second of two HPR1000 (Hualong One) units under construction at the site, where four CAP1000s are also planned.

articles.title: Kairos, DOE enhance collaboration on advanced reactor design
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy's Oak Ridge National Laboratory and Kairos Power have entered into a USD27 million strategic partnership to accelerate the technology needed to deploy a new generation of advanced nuclear reactors.

articles.title: TerraPower's Natrium reactor enters UK GDA process
articles.summary: The Bill Gates-chaired company's Natrium 345 MWe sodium-cooled fast reactor with a molten-salt-based energy storage system has been accepted into the UK's Generic Design Assessment process.

articles.title: Construction phase completed in Bruce 3 refurbishment
articles.summary: Bruce Power has completed the construction phase of its Unit 3 Major Component Replacement project, which it says remains on budget and ahead of schedule.

articles.title: OpenStar demonstrates dipole fusion reactor concept
articles.summary: New Zealand-based fusion energy startup OpenStar Technologies says it has become the first commercial company in the world to successfully create and confine plasma using a levitated dipole reactor.

articles.title: Blue Capsule begins building sodium test loop
articles.summary: French small modular reactor developer Blue Capsule Technology has announced the start of construction of ELISE - a full-size test rig for sodium at high temperatures - at Peyrolles-en-Provence, in collaboration with France's CSTI Groupe.

articles.title: TVONS to provide advice for Estonian SMR project
articles.summary: Finnish consulting company TVO Nuclear Services and Estonia's Fermi Energia have signed a framework agreement under which TVONS will act as a consultant in Fermi Energia's small modular reactor power plant project in Estonia.

articles.title: Construction of Steady Energy pilot plant begins
articles.summary: Finnish small modular reactor developer Steady Energy has poured the first concrete for a full-scale, non-nuclear pilot of its LDR‑50 small modular reactor for district heating at the decommissioned Salmisaari B coal-fired power station in central Helsinki.

articles.title: USA touts SMR designs to the Philippines
articles.summary: The US Trade and Development Agency has announced USD2.7 million in funding for technical assistance to Meralco PowerGen Corp, to evaluate US small modular reactor designs and develop an implementation roadmap for the Philippines' first SMR nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Tripartite agreement to advance nuclear energy in Africa
articles.summary: The OECD Nuclear Energy Agency, the African Union and the African Commission on Nuclear Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to cooperate in support of peaceful applications of nuclear science and technology for socio-economic development across Africa.

articles.title: First unit at San'ao plant starts up
articles.summary: San'ao 1, a Chinese Hualong One reactor, reached first criticality in Zhejiang province.

articles.title: Taipingling 1 connected to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Taipingling nuclear power plant has begun supplying electricity to the grid for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: US regulator issues licence for TRISO-X fuel facility
articles.summary: The X-energy, LLC subsidiary is now authorised for the commercial fabrication of tristructural isotropic - or TRISO - fuel for advanced nuclear reactors at a facility that is currently under construction in Tennessee, marking the first-ever US approval of a category II fuel fabrication facility.

articles.title: Final Investment Decision taken for Romanian SMR project
articles.summary: The shareholders of Romanian nuclear operator Nuclearelectrica have approved the Final Investment Decision for the small modular reactor project in Doicești.

articles.title: Bannerman partners with CNNC for Namibian uranium project
articles.summary: Australia-based Bannerman Energy has signed a strategic financing and joint venture agreement with China's CNNC Overseas Limited, paving the way for debt-free construction of its Etango uranium project in Namibia.

articles.title: Study examines benefits of Pallas to future power plant construction
articles.summary: The knowledge and expertise gained in the Netherlands from the construction of the Pallas research reactor reduces the risk of delays in future nuclear power plant construction thanks to experience with permits, documentation, and supply chain qualification, according to a study by SEO Economic Research.

articles.title: Assessment of proposed Norwegian SMR plant to begin
articles.summary: The Norwegian government has given Norsk Kjernekraft approval to begin work on an impact assessment for a nuclear power plant in Aure and Heim municipalities, the first step in the licensing process for nuclear power in Norway.

articles.title: Safety review completed at South African research reactor
articles.summary: A team of International Atomic Energy Agency experts has outlined areas of good performance, and areas for strengthening South Africa's Safari-1 research reactor's ageing management programme.

articles.title: US campaign puts case for disposal, not reprocessing, of used fuel
articles.summary: The Nuclear Scaling Initiative’s Scale What Works campaign says that direct disposal of used nuclear fuel in the US is the "safest, most secure and least expensive pathway for the country" as nuclear energy capacity is expanded.

articles.title: India’s Rajasthan unit 7 reaches full power
articles.summary: Rajasthan nuclear power plant’s unit 7 is the third of sixteen 700 MW Indian-designed pressurised heavy water reactors being built in the country.

articles.title: Copenhagen Atomics reaches pump testing milestone
articles.summary: Danish nuclear technology company Copenhagen Atomics has completed two years of continuous operation of a molten salt pump and test loop at its facilities in Copenhagen. The system has been running without issues under high-temperature molten salt conditions, marking one of the longest continuous durability tests of its kind worldwide, it said.

articles.title: US, Armenia sign agreement on nuclear energy
articles.summary: Days after Rosatom's CEO reiterated the Russian nuclear company's willingness to cooperate with Armenia in the construction of new nuclear capacity, Armenia and the USA have completed negotiations on a cooperation agreement that will pave the way for US companies to strike deals on nuclear power projects in Armenia.

articles.title: US funding for research into recycling used nuclear fuel
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy's Office of Nuclear Energy has awarded more than USD19 million to five US companies to research and develop recycling technologies for used nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Testing of fuel rods taking place for Brazil's microreactor project
articles.summary: Indústrias Nucleares do Brasil is preparing for the final phase of testing for fuel rods to be used in the development of Brazil's national microreactor project.

articles.title: US Nuclear Regulatory Commission launches reorganisation
articles.summary: The US nuclear regulator is aiming to implement a reorganisation which it says will streamline decision-making, consolidate functions, and align with national goals for more efficient licensing and deployment of nuclear technology by the end of September.

articles.title: TRISO fuel progress for US reactor pilot programme
articles.summary: BWX Technologies says its TRISO nuclear fuel for Antares Nuclear is on track for "timely completion" for the reactor demonstration planned to meet the US’s 4 July target date.

articles.title: Tepco prepares for restart of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa unit
articles.summary: Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Company plans to restart unit 6 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant on Monday. An attempt last month to restart the reactor, which has been offline for almost 14 years, was halted after an alarm was triggered in the control rod operation monitoring system.

articles.title: First unit at China's Taipingling plant starts up
articles.summary: Unit 1 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: Location of second Kazakh nuclear power plant announced
articles.summary: Kazakhstan's second nuclear power plant will be constructed in the Zhambyl district of the Almaty region - adjacent to the site selected for the country's first nuclear plant - the government has decided.

articles.title: Kursk II's first unit reaches 40% capacity
articles.summary: Pilot operation of the first unit of Russia's Kursk II nuclear power plant has begun, with the unit set to increase its output in stages over the coming months.

articles.title: Yokogawa to supply Rolls-Royce SMR control systems
articles.summary: Japanese industrial automation specialist Yokogawa Electric Corporation is to provide the data processing and control systems for the initial Rolls-Royce SMR small modular reactor units.

articles.title: PEJ signs first loan agreement with US export credit agency
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has signed a loan agreement with the Export-Import Bank of the United States, giving the Polish company greater flexibility in implementing design works planned in 2026 for the country's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: KHNP seeks site for new nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has launched a bidding process to select the host cities or towns for two new large nuclear power reactors. The announcement came just days after the government confirmed plans to construct the reactors by 2038.

articles.title: Type One Energy initiates licensing of fusion power plant
articles.summary: US fusion energy developer Type One Energy has submitted the initial licensing application in preparation for the construction of a fusion power plant at Tennessee Valley Authority's former Bull Run fossil plant site in Clinton, Tennessee.

articles.title: Saskatchewan to evaluate large nuclear reactor technologies
articles.summary: The Government of Saskatchewan and utility SaskPower have announced plans to formally evaluate large nuclear reactor technologies for use in the Canadian province. Saskatchewan already has plans for the deployment of small modular reactors.

articles.title: Amentum awarded further UK contracts by EDF
articles.summary: USA-based engineering company Amentum has been awarded several new contracts by EDF, worth up to GBP540 million (USD743 million), expanding the critical solutions it provides for the UK's existing reactor fleet as well as for the construction of the new Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Steam generator removal begins at German plant
articles.summary: The removal of the first of four steam generators from the reactor building has begun at the shutdown Grafenrheinfeld nuclear power plant in Germany.

articles.title: First concrete for Uzbekistan SMR 'well before December'
articles.summary: Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev have discussed progress on the project to build a nuclear power plant featuring both large and small reactors.

articles.title: Stellaria seeks permission to build experimental reactor
articles.summary: French molten salt reactor developer Stellaria has announced it is seeking the necessary authorisations to construct an experimental reactor. Its application is now under review.

articles.title: UK-US partnership for HALEU transport packages
articles.summary: The UK's Nuclear Transport Solutions has signed a strategic agreement with Westinghouse of the USA to work together on the development of Pegasus – NTS's package designed for the safe transport of high-assay low-enriched uranium fuel.

articles.title: Civil construction of replacement Trino waste store completed
articles.summary: The demolition and subsequent reconstruction of a temporary storage facility for low-level radioactive waste has been completed at Italy's Trino nuclear power plant, which is undergoing decommissioning.

articles.title: Kairos secures HALEU for Hermes' first fuel load
articles.summary: Kairos Power has finalised a contract with the US Department of Energy to receive the high-assay low-enriched uranium that will be used to make the fuel for the startup and operation of its Hermes low-power demonstration reactor.

articles.title: Denmark begins study on potential use of nuclear energy
articles.summary: A framework is now in place for investigating the "potential and risks" of new nuclear technologies - including small modular reactors - and the lifting of a moratorium on nuclear power, Denmark's Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities has announced.

articles.title: Reactor internals delivered for Xudabao unit 1
articles.summary: The reactor internals for Xudabao Nuclear Power Plant's Unit 1 have been delivered to the site, the Chinese project company has announced.

articles.title: Bureau Veritas to aid Dutch deployment of Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Dutch nuclear energy development and consultancy company ULC-Energy BV has signed an agreement with France-based testing, inspection and certification services provider Bureau Veritas to collaborate on the deployment of the Rolls-Royce SMR in the Netherlands on an industrial scale.

articles.title: Tepco halts restart of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa reactor
articles.summary: Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Company has temporarily shut down unit 6 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant after an alarm was triggered in the control rod operation monitoring system. Before Wednesday's restart, the unit had been offline for almost 14 years.

articles.title: First VVER-1200 fuel delivered to China for Tianwan 7
articles.summary: Rosatom has supplied fuel for the initial loading for Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant's unit 7, which is a VVER-1200 reactor.

articles.title: Cooling system tests at RA-10 multipurpose reactor
articles.summary: The commissioning of the first pump in the primary cooling circuit of the RA-10 multipurpose reactor has taken place as part of preparations for cold testing.

articles.title: Tepco restarts Kashiwazaki-Kariwa reactor
articles.summary: Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Company announced it has begun the process of restarting unit 6 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant, which has been offline for almost 14 years.

articles.title: Government funding for Saskatchewan SMR test facility
articles.summary: Western Canada's first Small Modular Reactor Safety, Licensing, and Testing Centre at the University of Regina is to receive nearly CAD6 million (USD4.3 million) in funding from the federal and provincial governments.

articles.title: Amentum to be delivery partner for Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Amentum has been appointed as programme delivery partner for Rolls-Royce SMR small modular reactor projects, beginning with those in the UK and the Czech Republic.

articles.title: Joint study validates SMR use for chemical plants
articles.summary: A two-year study by Oak Ridge National Laboratory and NuScale looked at the performance and profitability of coupling a NuScale Power Module with a US chemical facility to provide nuclear-generated steam and electric power - and shows pairing NuScale's nuclear technology with a heat augmentation system to be both profitable and reliable.

articles.title: Tepco delays restart of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa reactor
articles.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company has reportedly postponed the scheduled 20 January restart of unit 6 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant after a safety alarm failed to sound during pre-reactor start-up checks.

articles.title: Slovakia and USA sign nuclear energy agreement
articles.summary: Slovakia's Prime Minister Robert Fico and US Energy Secretary Chris Wright have signed an Intergovernmental Agreement to advance the European country's nuclear power programme, including deploying a new 1,200 MWe unit.

articles.title: China starts construction of innovative nuclear project
articles.summary: First concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 1 at Phase I of the Xuwei nuclear power project in China's Jiangsu province. The plant will supply both industrial heating and electricity by coupling a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor with two Hualong One pressurised water reactors.

articles.title: Project Phoenix report backs SMR use in Slovakia
articles.summary: A feasibility study carried out as part of the USA's Project Phoenix scheme has backed the suitability of small modular reactors in the Slovak Republic.

articles.title: NASA, DOE aim for nuclear reactor on moon by 2030
articles.summary: The US government space and energy agencies have renewed their commitment to work together to develop a fission power source for use on the surface of the Moon and future missions to Mars.

articles.title: Licensing of Newcleo's SMR progresses in France
articles.summary: Innovative reactor developer Newcleo has submitted the safety options dossier for its lead-cooled fast neutron reactor to the French Nuclear Safety and Radiation Protection Authority.

articles.title: Long-term graphite agreement strengthens X-energy supply chain
articles.summary: The 10-year framework agreement between X-energy Reactor Company and SGL Carbon LLC covers the supply of graphite for the deployment of X-energy's Xe-100 small modular reactor, with a contract to support the first deployment of the reactor at the Seadrift site in Texas and an agreement to reserve capacity for a planned 12-unit plant in Washington State.

articles.title: Skanska to produce prototype aseismic bearing for Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR has contracted Skanska UK to deliver an aseismic bearing pedestal demonstrator for its small modular reactor. These structural isolation devices are a key part of the factory-built nuclear power plant's design.

articles.title: Operating permit for very low-level waste disposal facility in Finland
articles.summary: An operating permit which is valid until 2095 has been issued by the Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority of Finland for a new disposal facility for very low-level radioactive waste at Olkiluoto, to be operated by Teollisuuden Voima Oyj.

articles.title: Impact assessment process begins for Canadian new-build
articles.summary: Ontario Power Generation has submitted the Initial Project Description for a new nuclear plant at Wesleyville near Port Hope, a regulatory milestone marking the first step in the impact assessment process.

articles.title: Hinkley Point B plant declared free of fuel
articles.summary: The UK's Office for Nuclear Regulation has granted the Hinkley Point B nuclear power plant in Somerset Fuel Free Verification status, confirming all nuclear fuel has been removed on time and on budget and allowing the plant to move into its decommissioning phase.

articles.title: US enrichment funding recipients flesh out plans
articles.summary: The companies selected to receive nearly USD3 billion in federal funding to strengthen US uranium enrichment services over the next decade have set out details of how and where they intend to deploy the funding, which will support thousands of jobs as well as building the domestic nuclear supply chain.

articles.title: Bulk sample programme begins at Tony M mine
articles.summary: The programme will see the extraction of up to 2000 tons of mineralised material to generate real-world mining, processing, and cost data, and is a "decision gate" towards a potential restart decision for IsoEnergy's past-producing uranium mine.

articles.title: DOE delivers HALEU feedstock for advanced reactor fuel
articles.summary: Standard Nuclear, Inc has received its first shipment of high-assay low-enriched uranium feedstock at its facility in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, under the US Department of Energy's initiative to fast-track the fuel supply chain for advanced reactors.

articles.title: Chinese SMR completes non-nuclear steam start up test
articles.summary: The ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project, under construction at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, successfully passed its non-nuclear turbine test run on the first attempt on 23 December, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Revised plan for clean-up of Central Asian uranium legacy sites
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has published a new strategic master plan to continue its cooperation with Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan and international organisations on the remediation of uranium legacy sites until 2030.

articles.title: Construction milestone at Chinese underground laboratory
articles.summary: Excavation of the spiral ramp of the Beishan Underground Research Laboratory near Jiuquan City in China's Gansu province has been fully completed, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: Agreement extension enables continued development of Polish plant
articles.summary: Polish power company Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has signed an amendment with the Westinghouse-Bechtel Consortium enabling the implementation of the next stage of work under the project to build Poland's first nuclear power plant, as part of the Engineering Development Agreement.

articles.title: DOE awards USD2.7 billion to strengthen US uranium enrichment
articles.summary: General Matter, American Centrifuge Operating and Orano Federal Services have each been awarded USD900 million of funding by the US Department of Energy to provide uranium enrichment services. A further USD28 million has been awarded to Global Laser Enrichment to continue advancing next-generation uranium enrichment technology.

articles.title: Fuel loading under way at new Chinese units
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the cores of unit 1 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant in Guangdong province and unit 1 at the San'ao plant in Zhejiang province - both Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors - has commenced ahead of their start-up, China General Nuclear announced.

articles.title: Final unit at Bilibino Nuclear Power Plant permanently shut down
articles.summary: The last of the three operable units at the Bilibino Nuclear Power Plant in Chukotka, Russia, was permanently shut down on 30 December.

articles.title: Denison ready to start construction at Canadian uranium project
articles.summary: Denison Mines Corporation says it is ready to make a final investment decision and begin construction of the Phoenix In-Situ Recovery uranium mine, with first production expected by mid-2028.

articles.title: China begins construction of two new nuclear power units
articles.summary: Construction began on two Chinese CAP1000 reactor units at Bailong and Lufeng.

articles.title: Chinese reactor enters commercial operation
articles.summary: China's Zhangzhou 2 Hualong One reactor completed commissioning and entered commercial operation.

articles.title: First Kursk II unit connected to the grid
articles.summary: The first new VVER-TOI power unit at the Kursk II nuclear power plant in Russia has been connected to the grid and reached a capacity of 240 MW on 31 December.

articles.title: Operating permit issued for South Korea's Saeul 3
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission has issued an operational licence for Saeul Nuclear Power Plant unit 3.

articles.title: Duke Energy submits early site permit application for nuclear project
articles.summary: Duke Energy has submitted a technology-neutral application to the US nuclear regulator for an early site permit for potential small modular reactors at a site near the Belews Creek Steam Station in North Carolina.

articles.title: How are geological repository projects progressing?
articles.summary: A growing number of countries are planning a permanent solution to the issue of radioactive waste by burying it deep underground. Schemes take many years to plan, and many more years to build, but progress is being made.

articles.title: EU launches inquiry into Czech funding plan for new nuclear
articles.summary: The European Commission "has doubts" that the proposed Czech funding plan for its proposed new nuclear units "is fully in line with EU State aid rules".

articles.title: Sweden gets first application for state aid for new nuclear
articles.summary: The Swedish government has received an application for state aid to support proposals for either five GE Vernova Hitachi BWRX-300 reactors or three Rolls-Royce SMRs to provide about 1500 MW capacity at Ringhals on the Värö Peninsula.

articles.title: Kazakh-Japanese nuclear cooperation highlighted during presidential visit
articles.summary: An agreement between Kazatomprom and Japanese utility Kansai to supply Kazakh uranium products for Japanese nuclear power plants and a raft of nuclear-related bilaterals were signed during the visit to Japan by Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev.

articles.title: Restart of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa reactors approved by regional assembly
articles.summary: The Niigata Prefectural Assembly has backed Niigata Governor Hideyo Hanazumi's decision to approve the restart of units 6 and 7 at Tokyo Electric Power Company's Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant.
