articles.title: Rosatom reports successful tests of HTGR fuel in extreme conditions
articles.summary: The Russian state nuclear corporation says that tests have been successfully completed on fuel samples for high-temperature gas-cooled reactors under extreme conditions.

articles.title: China launches HTGR industrial alliance
articles.summary: The High-Temperature Gas-Cooled Reactor Modern Industrial Chain Alliance, created by China National Nuclear Corporation subsidiary Chinergy, brings together more than 60 organisations.

articles.title: AI tool can simulate complex fusion plasma in seconds
articles.summary: A team of scientists from the UK Atomic Energy Authority, the Johannes Kepler University Linz, and Emmi AI, have developed an artificial intelligence tool - named GyroSwin - which can create simulations up to 1,000 times faster than traditional computational methods.

articles.title: Pre-feasibility study launched for Estonian SMR plant
articles.summary: Samsung C&T, in collaboration with Fermi Energia AS, has been selected to receive funding support from the South Korean government for a pre-feasibility study related to Estonia's planned small modular reactor power project.

articles.title: Trump Media announces merger with fusion firm TAE Technologies
articles.summary: Trump Media & Technology Group - the social media firm majority-owned by US President Donald Trump - and US private fusion energy company TAE Technologies have announced an agreement to merge in a transaction valued at more than USD6 billion.

articles.title: Ethiopia and Russia hold talks over potential nuclear power project
articles.summary: Negotiations have taken place in Moscow over advancing proposals for a gigawatt-scale nuclear power plant in Ethiopia.

articles.title: Argentina and Brazil progressing their multipurpose reactors
articles.summary: Argentina aims to become self-sufficient and an exporter of radioisotopes when the RA-10 multipurpose reactor is operating, while Brazil says construction of its similar facility is due to start in the first half of 2026.

articles.title: Modified fuel supplied to Uzbekistan research reactor
articles.summary: Dense uranium and uranium-silicide fuel produced by the Novosibirsk Chemical Concentrates Plant in Russia is said to offer better performance than the IRT-4M fuel assemblies previously supplied to Uzbekistan.

articles.title: Urenco USA produces first LEU+ fuel
articles.summary: Urenco USA has produced its first uranium enriched to 8.5% U-235, in what it describes as a first for a commercial uranium facility in the USA.

articles.title: UK achieves early milestone in plutonium disposal programme
articles.summary: The UK's Nuclear Decommissioning Authority announced it has succeeded in safely processing a can of plutonium residue into a stable waste form for the first time, marking a significant step toward permanently disposing of the country's plutonium legacy.

articles.title: Newcleo submits SMR design for Euratom safeguards review
articles.summary: France-based innovative reactor developer Newcleo has officially initiated its safeguards-by-design engagement with Euratom, the regulatory body overseeing nuclear safeguards within the European Union, for its lead-cooled fast reactor.

articles.title: EDF estimates EPR2 programme cost at EUR72.8 billion
articles.summary: France's EDF has said its preliminary cost estimate for the project to build six EPR2 reactors at Penly, Gravelines and Bugey totals EUR72.8 billion (USD85.3 billion).

articles.title: Holtec signs MoU for SMRs in Hungary
articles.summary: Holtec International has announced a memorandum of understanding with Hungary's energy giant MVM to explore the deployment of Holtec’s SMR-300 small modular reactor technology in the country.

articles.title: Permit issued for final Brunsbüttel dismantling work
articles.summary: Vattenfall has received the second and final permit for the dismantling of the Brunsbüttel nuclear power plant from the German state of Schleswig-Holstein. The 771 MWe boiling water reactor was permanently shut down in 2007.

articles.title: Three Illinois reactors receive licence extensions
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has granted a 20-year initial licence renewal for Constellation's Clinton unit 1 and a 20-year subsequent licence renewal for Dresden units 2 and 3.

articles.title: Norwegian towns take stakes in nuclear project company
articles.summary: The municipalities of Lyngdal and Farsund in southern Norway's Lister region have decided to become co-owners of Lister Kjernekraft AS, a nuclear power plant project development company established by Norsk Kjernekraft AS in September.

articles.title: Construction starts on sixth Ningde unit
articles.summary: The first concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 6 at the Ningde nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, marking the official start of construction of the second of two HPR1000 (Hualong One) reactors at the site.

articles.title: Korean floating SMR design certified
articles.summary: South Korea's Samsung Heavy Industries has received Approval in Principle from the American Bureau of Shipping for a floating marine nuclear power platform featuring two SMART100 small modular reactors developed by the Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute.

articles.title: Niger builds relationships with overseas uranium partners
articles.summary: Niger's state-owned Timersoi National Uranium Company has signed an agreement with Russian company Uranium One Group to cooperate in uranium mining and eventually open new mines. Meanwhile, Global Atomic Corporation remains upbeat about the prospects for securing financing for the Dasa uranium project - although first uranium shipments could now be delayed.

articles.title: UK aims for cancer treatments from reprocessed uranium
articles.summary: A 15-year agreement between the UK Nuclear Decommissioning Authority and biotech firm Bicycle Therapeutics focuses on securing the medical isotope lead-212 from the UK's stockpile of reprocessed nuclear fuel.

articles.title: X-energy 'reserves' Doosan forgings
articles.summary: X-energy of the USA - developer of the Xe-100 high temperature gas-cooled small modular reactor - has signed a reservation agreement with South Korean nuclear component designer and manufacturer Doosan Enerbility for key components for its reactors.

articles.title: Polish-Korean partnership for SMR deployment
articles.summary: Poland's Synthos Green Energy has signed a memorandum of understanding with South Korea's Samsung C&T Corporation to explore future partnership opportunities for the fleet deployment of GE Vernova Hitachi's BWRX-300 small modular reactor technology in Central and Eastern Europe.

articles.title: Flamanville EPR reaches full power
articles.summary: The Flamanville 3 reactor has reached full power for the first time, after the Autorité de Sûreté Nucléaire et de Radioprotection gave approval on Friday for it to move beyond 80% of its nominal power as part of its commissioning process.

articles.title: WIPP contract extension for Bechtel
articles.summary: The engineering, construction and project management company Bechtel will continue managing and operating the Waste Isolation Pilot Plant in New Mexico after receiving a three-year extension to its contract with the US Department of Energy.

articles.title: GE Vernova Hitachi SMR design clears key UK regulatory stage
articles.summary: GE Vernova Hitachi's BWRX-300 small modular reactor design appears suitable for construction in the UK, regulators have concluded following Step 2 of the Generic Design Assessment. The regulators said there are "no fundamental safety, security, safeguards or environmental protection shortfalls with the design that could prevent its deployment in Great Britain".

articles.title: Five companies selected for HALEU transport funding
articles.summary: NAC International, Westinghouse Electric Company, Container Technologies Industries, LLC, Centrus subsidiary American Centrifuge Operating and Paragon D&E have been selected by the US Department of Energy to receive federal awards totalling USD11 million.

articles.title: Japanese supermarket chain signs up for fusion power
articles.summary: Tokyo-based fusion company Helical Fusion has signed a power purchase agreement with Aoki Super Company, a major regional supermarket chain in central Japan.

articles.title: India and Russia discuss new nuclear power plant options
articles.summary: India and Russia outlined potential additional plant locations and expanded cooperation on fuel supply and smaller nuclear technologies.

articles.title: First projects selected for INL reactor experiments
articles.summary: The five initial selections for end user experiments at Idaho National Laboratory's Microreactor Application Research Validation and Evaluation (MARVEL) reactor include projects related to data centres, technology application in commercial and advanced reactors, and applications for nuclear-generated process heat.

articles.title: Korean interest in Finnish heating SMR
articles.summary: Finland's Steady Energy and Korea District Heating Corporation - South Korea's largest district heating company - have signed a memorandum of understanding aimed at fostering cooperation in the field of small modular nuclear reactors for the generation of heat.

articles.title: First nuclear fuel delivered for Kudankulam unit 3
articles.summary: Initial nuclear fuel arrived for India's Kudankulam 3 reactor, marking progress toward the unit's start-up process.

articles.title: Kansas site selected for underground reactor demo
articles.summary: California-based startup Deep Fission has chosen Great Plains Industrial Park in Parsons, Kansas, for its pilot project and plans to build a full-scale commercial plant there following the test reactor demonstration.

articles.title: Brazilian development bank gauges consultancy interest in uranium expansion
articles.summary: A Request for Information has been launched by Brazil's National Bank for Economic and Social Development for consulting firms interested in participating in the structuring of Indústrias Nucleares do Brasil's uranium production expansion project.

articles.title: First fuel produced for molten salt reactor experiment
articles.summary: Idaho National Laboratory has launched full-scale production of enriched fuel salt for the world's first test of a molten chloride salt fast reactor - technology that could be deployed as soon as the 2030s for both terrestrial and maritime applications.

articles.title: Upgrading of third Russian uranium enrichment plant starts
articles.summary: The first new 9+ generation gas centrifuges have been launched at the Isotope Separation Plant at the Siberian Chemical Combine in Seversk, Rosatom's fuel division TVEL has announced.

articles.title: Two SMR projects selected for US federal funding
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has selected Tennessee Valley Authority and Holtec to each receive USD400 million in federal cost-shared funding to support early deployments of advanced light-water small modular reactors in the USA.

articles.title: Laurentis, BWXT and CNPSA sign Bulgarian new nuclear contract
articles.summary: The three-company consortium has signed an owner’s engineer contract to advance two new AP1000 units at Bulgaria’s Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: Reactor vessel completed for Hinkley Point C's second unit
articles.summary: Framatome has completed the manufacture of the reactor pressure vessel for the second of two EPR units being built at the Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant in Somerset, UK. The first two of four steam generators for the unit have also been completed.

articles.title: Final safety evaluation completed for Wyoming advanced reactor
articles.summary: The US regulator has completed its final safety evaluation for TerraPower's application to build Kemmerer Power Station Unit 1 in Kemmerer, Wyoming, one month ahead of its already accelerated schedule.

articles.title: Uzbekistan progressing work on first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev has visited the Jizzakh region to identify growth opportunities in the area, with construction work under way at the site of what will be Uzbekistan’s first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Modular construction completed at Xudabao VVER-1200s
articles.summary: The final module of the passive water tank has been installed within the reactor building of unit 4 at the Xudabao nuclear power plant in China's Liaoning Province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: Fifth Belgian reactor is permanently shut down
articles.summary: Unit 2 of the Doel nuclear power plant in Belgium's Flanders region has been taken offline for the final time after 50 years of operation and disconnected from the grid. Its closure is in line with Belgium's nuclear phase-out policy, under which four other reactors have already been shut down.

articles.title: Niger reveals plans to sell Somaïr uranium
articles.summary: Niger's plans to put uranium produced by Somaïr on the international market were announced on state television, days after Orano condemned a reported shipment of material from the site as illegal.

articles.title: Restart of two Taiwanese plants feasible, ministry says
articles.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs has approved Taipower's report on the current condition of its decommissioned nuclear power plants, which concludes that the Kuosheng and Maanshan plants are "feasible for reoperation". The utility is expected to submit plans next year for their restarts.

articles.title: Rolls-Royce SMR and ÚJV Řež deepen collaboration
articles.summary: The Czech Republic's ÚJV Řež has signed a memorandum of understanding with UK-based Rolls-Royce SMR "aimed at deepening further cooperation in the implementation of small modular reactor technology in the Czech Republic and abroad".

articles.title: GDES, KEPCO KPS team up for Spanish and French markets
articles.summary: Spanish energy services group Grupo Dominguis Energy Services and South Korea's KEPCO Plant Service & Engineering have signed a collaboration agreement to further their joint development and expand cooperation in the Spanish and French markets, specifically in the field of nuclear power plant maintenance.

articles.title: Equinix signs up for power from first Stellaria reactor
articles.summary: French molten salt reactor developer Stellaria has signed a pre-order agreement with data centre developer and operator Equinix. Under the agreement, Equinix has secured the first power capacity reservation on the Stellarium, the reactor that Stellaria plans to deploy starting in 2035.

articles.title: Kyrgyzstan considering possible Russian SMR plant
articles.summary: Kyrgyzstan is exploring the possibility of building its first nuclear power plant using Russian small modular reactors, Vladimir Putin has said.

articles.title: Dutch support for molten salt reactor demonstrator facility
articles.summary: Molten salt reactor developer Thorizon announced it has secured broad industrial and regional support in the Netherlands for the construction of Thorizon Pioneer, a nuclear demonstrator for next-generation molten-salt reactors.

articles.title: Neighbouring countries consulted on Norwegian nuclear power plant
articles.summary: The Norwegian Environment Agency is sending a proposal for a study programme for a nuclear power plant in Aure and Heim municipalities for consultation to neighbouring countries, as required by the Espoo Convention.

articles.title: Turkish, Korean firms sign cooperation agreement
articles.summary: A memorandum of understanding on cooperation in nuclear energy has been signed by Türkiye Nükleer Enerji AŞ and Korea Electric Power Corporation during a meeting between the presidents of Turkey and South Korea.

articles.title: International agreement signed for fusion materials research facility
articles.summary: Fusion for Energy, representing the European Commission and Member States' contribution, together with Spain, Japan, Croatia and Italy have signed the Multilateral International DONES Agreement, laying the groundwork for the construction of IFMIF-DONES, a facility in Granada, Spain, to test materials for future fusion reactors.

articles.title: Framatome makes first nuclear fuel assemblies for Barakah
articles.summary: The first lead fuel assemblies have been manufactured by Framatome for the Emirates Nuclear Energy Company's Barakah nuclear power plant in the UAE under a fuel supply agreement announced by the two companies in July.

articles.title: Chinese reactor connected to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 2 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant has begun supplying electricity to the grid, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. The unit is the second of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned at the site in China's Fujian province.

articles.title: Blast marks restart of mining operations at Kayelekera
articles.summary: The first blast at the open pit mine in Malawi marks the resumption of mining operations at the restarted project and means that Lotus Resources can proceed with its plans to transition production from previously mined ore stockpiles to include new run-of-mine ore from Kayelekera.

articles.title: Rosatom to 3D-print equipment elements for SMR
articles.summary: Regulatory approval has been granted for the first components of an RITM-200 small modular reactor plant to be produced using 3D printing in Russia.

articles.title: Brazil aims to start construction of Centena repository in 2026
articles.summary: The National Nuclear Energy Commission says that a preferred site has been selected and the aim is for the Centena radioactive waste repository to be completed by 2030.

articles.title: Valar Atomics project achieves early criticality milestone
articles.summary: The company said its NOVA Core achieved zero-power criticality at LANL's National Criticality Experiments Research Center on 17 November.

articles.title: Niigata governor consents to restart of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa reactors
articles.summary: The governor of Japan's Niigata Prefecture has given his approval for the restart of units 6 and 7 at Tokyo Electric Power Company's Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant. Pending backing of his decision by the prefectural assembly next month, Hideyo Hanazumi will inform the central government of the approval, ending the process of obtaining local consent.

articles.title: INL begins irradiation testing of Lightbridge fuel samples
articles.summary: Samples of enriched uranium-zirconium alloy fuel material are being irradiated in the lab's Advanced Test Reactor, a significant step forward in the development and testing programme which is part of a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement between Lightbridge and INL.

articles.title: UK radioisotope project receives funding
articles.summary: A GBP9.9 million (USD12.9 million) investment from Innovate UK, backed by a further GBP8.9 million from industry, will support a major project to develop cutting-edge new treatments for cancer using lead-212 derived from used nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Oklo and Siemens Energy sign power conversion system contract
articles.summary: Siemens Energy has signed a contract to design and deliver the power conversion system for Oklo's Aurora powerhouse reactors.

articles.title: Third San'ao unit under construction
articles.summary: The first concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 3 at the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province, marking the official start of construction of the third of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) reactors planned at the site.

articles.title: Constellation secures USD1 billion loan for reactor restart
articles.summary: US Secretary of Energy Chris Wright announced that the Department of Energy's Loan Programs Office has closed a USD1 billion loan to Constellation Energy Generation to help finance the restart of Three Mile Island unit 1, now known as the Crane Clean Energy Centre.

articles.title: Presidents launch El Dabaa reactor pressure vessel installation
articles.summary: The first unit at the El Dabaa nuclear power plant has had its reactor pressure vessel installed, following a ceremony which included speeches from the Egyptian and Russian presidents.

articles.title: Construction of new Chinese nuclear power plant begins
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 1 at the Zhaoyuan nuclear power plant in Shandong province. It is the first of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

articles.title: Building work starts at US SMR fuel plant
articles.summary: Construction work above ground - also known as vertical construction - has begun for TRISO-X's TX-1 advanced nuclear fuel fabrication facility in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, which will be the first plant of its kind in the USA.

articles.title: First of Russian test rigs delivered to ITER construction site
articles.summary: A ceremony has been held to mark the arrival of the first of the four test rigs at the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor construction site in southern France.

articles.title: Study highlights potential benefits of Dutch SMR design
articles.summary: A study conducted by strategic consultancy firm Roland Berger has confirmed that the small modular reactor proposed by Dutch offshore construction engineering contractor Allseas offers major strategic opportunities for the Netherlands.

articles.title: Belarus to build third unit at nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Belarus has decided to build a third unit at its first nuclear power plant - and is also going to start surveys for a second plant which may be needed to meet future energy demands.

articles.title: US affirms support for Korean uranium enrichment
articles.summary: President Lee Jae Myung of the Republic of Korea and US President Donald Trump have issued a joint briefing which includes US support for South Korea's pursuit of uranium enrichment and used fuel reprocessing, as well as a project to build nuclear-powered submarines.

articles.title: Accident-tolerant fuel completes second US PWR cycle
articles.summary: The first complete assembly of accident tolerant fuel to operate in a commercial nuclear reactor has completed its second cycle of operations and has undergone testing before being loaded into Constellation's Calvert Cliffs plant for a third 24-month cycle.

articles.title: Anfield breaks ground at Utah uranium mine
articles.summary: Weeks after receiving its final construction permit from the State of Utah, Anfield Energy has broken ground at the Velvet-Wood Uranium-Vanadium Mine - first production could be as soon as 2026.

articles.title: Korean reactor cleared for extended operation
articles.summary: The continued operation of unit 2 at the Kori nuclear power plant until 2033 has been approved by South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission. The reactor has been offline since April 2023, when its original 40-year operating permit expired.

articles.title: Nuclear fuel delivery for Vietnam research reactor
articles.summary: The delivery of fuel from Russia’s TVEL for the Da Lat Research Reactor in Vietnam is part of the roadmap for developing the two countries’ nuclear cooperation.

articles.title: Oklo fuel facility receives design approval
articles.summary: The Nuclear Safety Design Agreement for the Aurora Fuel Fabrication Facility, where the fuel for Oklo's first commercial-scale Aurora powerhouse will be made, is the first under the US Department of Energy's Fuel Line Pilot Projects initiative and was approved in just under two weeks.

articles.title: X-energy, Toyo Tanso sign graphite supply chain agreement
articles.summary: Toyo Tanso USA, a subsidiary of Japanese company Toyo Tanso Co, is to supply fine-grain graphite components for the first deployment of X-energy's Xe-100 small modular reactor under the agreement, which is worth around USD40 million.

articles.title: Construction of UNITY-2 under way
articles.summary: Fusion Fuel Cycles Inc has officially begun construction at the Chalk River Laboratories in Ontario of the Unique Integrated Testing Facility - the world's first integrated tritium fuel cycle system test facility capable of full-loop operations.

articles.title: Potential sites identified for Helsinki SMR plant
articles.summary: Finnish energy firm Helen has announced that three potential sites in Helsinki have been identified for further assessment for locating a small nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Westinghouse to supply fuel to Hungary’s Paks nuclear plant
articles.summary: Hungary’s MVM Group and Westinghouse have signed a contract for the American firm’s VVER-440 fuel from 2028 as part of measures to diversify supply for the Paks Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: French-Italian industrial partnership for Nuward SMR development
articles.summary: Italian technology and engineering group Maire SpA and its sustainable technology subsidiary NextChem have signed a memorandum of understanding with EDF and its Nuward subsidiary to jointly explore opportunities for cooperation in the development and deployment of the Nuward small modular reactor programme.

articles.title: US lab begins TRISO fuel irradiation test
articles.summary: Pebbles of X-energy's TRISO-X fuel have begun 13 months of irradiation testing at Idaho National Laboratory to evaluate fuel performance across operating scenarios and qualify them for commercial use.

articles.title: Framatome plans French TRISO fuel pilot plant
articles.summary: Framatome has announced plans to produce TRISO nuclear fuel at its fuel fabrication site in Romans-sur-Isère, France. The company has also signed an agreement to manufacture fuel elements using TRISO for Blue Capsule Technology's high-temperature reactor.

articles.title: Hexana SMR to be considered for deployment in the Netherlands
articles.summary: French small modular reactor developer Hexana has signed a memorandum of understanding with Dutch cooperative Atoomcoöperatie to explore cooperation on the potential development of Hexana's nuclear platform in the Netherlands.

articles.title: Contract signed for pilot UK integral molten salt reactor fuel plant
articles.summary: Small modular reactor company Terrestrial Energy Inc has signed a manufacturing and supply contract with Westinghouse subsidiary Springfields Fuels Limited for the design and construction of an Integral Molten Salt Reactor fuel pilot plant.

articles.title: Koeberg unit 2 approved for extended operation
articles.summary: South Africa's National Nuclear Regulator has authorised the 930 MWe Koeberg 2 unit for a further 20 years of operation.

articles.title: Swedish parliament votes to allow uranium mining
articles.summary: The Swedish parliament has voted to pass legislative changes that will come into effect on 1 January, lifting the country's ban on uranium mining and extraction.

articles.title: Kansai begins surveys of Mihama site for new reactor
articles.summary: Japanese utility Kansai Electric Power Company is beginning surveys of the Mihama nuclear power plant site in Fukui Prefecture to determine if a new reactor could be built there as a replacement for unit 1, which was declared permanently shut down in 2015.

articles.title: Framatome, TerraPower in advanced fuel breakthrough
articles.summary: The metallic 'pucks' of uranium that have been produced at Framatome's nuclear fuel manufacturing facility in the USA are a critical component in the fuel supply chain for TerraPower's Natrium reactor and described as a "milestone" for the commercialisation of advanced reactor fuel.

articles.title: Tractebel and Hexana launch SMR cogeneration task force
articles.summary: The two companies have signed a memorandum of understanding aimed at promoting nuclear-powered cogeneration "as a key solution for industrial decarbonisation, energy system resilience, and efficiency across Europe".

articles.title: Chinese molten salt reactor achieves conversion of thorium-uranium fuel
articles.summary: The experimental TMSR-LF1 thorium-powered molten salt reactor in Wuwei, Gansu Province, has achieved the first successful conversion of thorium-uranium nuclear fuel, the Shanghai Institute of Applied Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences announced.

articles.title: Sellafield awards multi-year 'high hazard risk reduction' contracts
articles.summary: Amentum, AtkinsRéalis, Westinghouse Environmental Services UK, Altrad, Cavendish Nuclear and Shepley Engineers will all be involved in the GBP4.6 billion (USD6 billion) framework agreement to deliver decommissioning solutions for some of the oldest facilities at the UK's Sellafield site.

articles.title: Official request made to extend Spain's Almaraz nuclear units
articles.summary: The board of Spain's Centrales Nucleares Almaraz-Trillo has officially requested a three-year extension to the operating licence for Almaraz Nuclear Power Plant's units I and II.

articles.title: X-energy sister company contracted for in-space nuclear technology
articles.summary: The US Air Force Research Laboratory’s Space Vehicles Directorate has given space technology and infrastructure services company Intuitive Machines a USD8.2 million contract extension to develop next-generation nuclear power systems for spacecraft and lunar infrastructure.

articles.title: European Investment Bank finance for Olkiluoto upgrades
articles.summary: The European Investment Bank has agreed a EUR90 million (USD104 million) loan for updating automation and control systems and steam separators for Finland’s Olkiluoto units I and II.

articles.title: Nova Scotia, Ontario sign SMR MoU
articles.summary: The Canadian provinces of Nova Scotia and Ontario will work together to explore small modular reactor technology as a clean energy option.

articles.title: UKAEA opens tritium fuel cycle facility training simulator
articles.summary: Developed in conjunction with Bilfinger UK, the UK Atomic Energy Authority's new and unique virtual simulator will provide operators of the UKAEA-Eni H3AT Tritium Loop Facility with the opportunity to undergo simulated training exercises in a safe and controlled environment.

articles.title: Duane Arnold restart underpins NextEra Energy and Google collaboration
articles.summary: NextEra and Google outlined a potential restart of Iowa's Duane Arnold plant and a 25-year power purchase arrangement.

articles.title: BWXT to design steam generators for Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR of the UK has signed a contract and memorandum of understanding with Canadian nuclear engineering firm BWX Technologies Inc to support future collaboration on the development of the Rolls-Royce SMR.

articles.title: Joint venture selected to deliver Cascade SMR facility
articles.summary: Energy Northwest has selected a joint venture of Aecon, Kiewit Nuclear Solutions Co and Black & Veatch to design and build the first phase of the Cascade Advanced Energy Facility near Richland, Washington.

articles.title: Regulatory milestone for Wyoming advanced reactor
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has completed its Environmental Impact Statement for TerraPower's Natrium project and recommended that a construction permit be issued for Kemmerer Unit 1.

articles.title: OPG secures government equity financing for SMR project
articles.summary: Two government agencies are to invest a total of CAD3 billion (USD2.1 billion) and take "meaningful" minority stakes in Ontario Power Generation's Darlington New Nuclear Project, helping to de-risk the construction and operation of the small modular reactors.

articles.title: Permitting of US fusion power plant progresses
articles.summary: Fusion energy developer Helion Energy has been granted a Conditional Use Permit by Chelan County, clearing the way for permitting and construction of the fusion generator building of its Orion fusion power plant in Malaga in Washington State.

articles.title: Palisades receives fuel ahead of restart
articles.summary: The Palisades nuclear power plant in Michigan has taken delivery of 68 new nuclear fuel assemblies as efforts to restart the plant later this year continue, Holtec International announced.

articles.title: South Korea to submit safeguards report for SMR design
articles.summary: South Korea's SMART100 small modular reactor design is set to become the first SMR in the world to formally submit a Safeguards Technical Report to the International Atomic Energy Agency, the Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute has announced.

articles.title: Urenco doubles expansion plans for uranium enrichment in the Netherlands
articles.summary: Urenco has announced plans to double the scale of its planned expansion at its Almelo uranium enrichment plant in the Netherlands.

articles.title: Newcleo and Oklo to partner on advanced fuel
articles.summary: France-based Newcleo and US-based Oklo have signed an agreement to develop advanced fuel fabrication and manufacturing infrastructure in the USA, with Sweden's Blykalla also considering investing in the project.

articles.title: Amazon updates SMR progress, with new images of proposed plant
articles.summary: Amazon has released a series of images of how its planned X-energy small modular reactor plant - to be named the Cascade Advanced Energy Facility - will look as it gave an update on progress a year after announcing its investment plans.

articles.title: US Army launches advanced reactor programme
articles.summary: The US Department of Army has announced the launch of the Janus Program, a next-generation nuclear power programme aimed at delivering "resilient, secure, and assured energy to support national defence installations and critical missions".

articles.title: Cold testing of Chinese SMR completed
articles.summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project under construction at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Contracts awarded for Sellafield infrastructure work
articles.summary: Sellafield Ltd has awarded contracts worth a total of GBP2.9 billion (USD3.8 billion) to a partnership comprising Morgan Sindall Infrastructure, Costain Limited, and HOCHTIEF (UK) Construction Ltd for non-nuclear infrastructure works at the Sellafield site in Cumbria, northwest England.

articles.title: Ukraine developing roadmap for new SMR capacity
articles.summary: A draft new law has been presented and a working group has met as part of the production of a draft action plan for the implementation of small modular reactors in Ukraine.

articles.title: Romania’s Feldioara to deliver uranium dioxide to Argentina
articles.summary: Feldioara Uranium Concentrate Processing Plant, part of Nuclearelectrica, has won an international tender it says will see it supply the uranium dioxide to cover the needs of Argentina’s nuclear power plants for a year.

articles.title: Fuel supply contracts signed for Sizewell C
articles.summary: Sizewell C has signed a six-year uranium enrichment services supply contract with Urenco and a long-term fuel fabrication contract with Framatome for fuel for the planned Sizewell C nuclear power plant in the UK.

articles.title: El Dabaa reactor support ring arrives, reactor vessel shipped
articles.summary: The 20-tonne reactor support ring will be installed at a height of 11 metres in the reactor shaft and will support the weight of the reactor vessel which could reach 1000 tonnes when combined with equipment and fluids.

articles.title: Fuel loading under way at second Zhangzhou unit
articles.summary: The process of loading 177 fuel assemblies into the core of unit 2 at China's Zhangzhou nuclear power plant has begun, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. The unit is the second of four Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors under construction at the site.

articles.title: IsoEnergy to acquire Toro, creating diversified uranium company
articles.summary: Canada-based IsoEnergy Ltd has announced it is to acquire Australian company Toro Energy to create a development-ready platform with a diversified uranium resource base with resources in Australia and North America.

articles.title: Advanced fuel material samples ready for irradiation testing
articles.summary: Capsules containing Lightbridge Fuel material samples of enriched uranium‑zirconium alloy have been loaded into an experimental assembly ready for irradiation testing, Lightbridge Corporation has announced.

links.label: the process to load the capsules

articles.title: Excavation works begin for Uzbekistan small modular reactor
articles.summary: About 1.5 million cubic metres of soil will be excavated during the digging of a pit 13 metres deep for the RITM-200N small modular reactor being built in Uzbekistan.

articles.title: Dismantling of Hamaoka 1 reactor under way
articles.summary: Japanese utility Chubu Electric Power Company announced it has removed the upper lid of the pressure vessel of unit 1 at its Hamaoka nuclear power plant as it begins to dismantle the reactor. Dismantling of the reactor of unit 2 at the plant began earlier this year.

articles.title: Paks II equipment supply approved, Rosatom says
articles.summary: Rosatom has said that an audit by Paks II and the Hungarian Atomic Energy Authority has certified that its machine-building division meets the requirements for the supply of nuclear steam generator equipment for the Paks II project.

articles.title: Technology licensing is landmark for US uranium remediation
articles.summary: Regulatory approval means Disa Technologies Inc's High-Pressure Slurry Ablation technology can be used to remediate abandoned uranium mine waste at inactive mine sites while opening the possibility of recycling uranium recovered from the waste.

articles.title: IAEA reviews Romanian research reactor ahead of potential extension
articles.summary: An International Atomic Energy Agency mission has said the operators of the TRIGA Mark II research reactor in Pitesti, Romania, have "continued to improve safety of the reactor by strengthening maintenance, implementing refurbishment and modernisation of systems and components, and ensuring safety of experiments".

articles.title: Construction set to start at Velvet-Wood project
articles.summary: The Utah Department of Oil, Gas and Mining has given Anfield Energy Inc approval to commence the advancement of its Velvet-Wood uranium-vanadium project in San Juan County, Utah, to construction.

articles.title: Deadline extended to allow wider participation in Indian small reactor RFP
articles.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd has added six months to the deadline for proposals from companies interested in using Bharat Small Reactors, and the names of six companies to have already formally submitted responses to Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd's Request for Proposals have been revealed.

links.label: update to the RFP, issued by NPCIL on 29…

articles.title: Fico signals Slovak-US agreement on Bohunice unit
articles.summary: Slovakia’s Prime Minister Robert Fico says his government has approved a proposed intergovernmental agreement with the USA on the construction of a new unit at the Bohunice nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Costain to reduce height of Trawsfynydd reactor buildings
articles.summary: Infrastructure solutions company Costain has been awarded a GBP70 million (USD94 million) contract to halve the height of the two reactor buildings at the shut-down Trawsfynydd Magnox nuclear power plant in Gwynedd, North Wales, UK.

articles.title: UK consultation begins on Rolls-Royce SMR design
articles.summary: The UK government has opened a public consultation on the Nuclear Industry Association's application for regulatory justification for Rolls-Royce SMR's small modular reactor design. Justification is an early regulatory step required for the operation of a new nuclear technology in the country.

articles.title: Belgian waste storage extension approved
articles.summary: Belgoprocess has received a permit to build and operate a new building on the Dessel site to store waste released during the final shutdown and dismantling of the country's nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Global Nuclear Fuel unveils new GNF4 product
articles.summary: Global Nuclear Fuel, a GE Vernova-led alliance with Hitachi, said the first lead use assemblies of the new generation GNF4 boiling water reactor fuel have been contracted for deployment in 2026, with full reload quantities from 2030.

articles.title: Ultrasonic monitoring system tested for BN-800 reactor core
articles.summary: Preliminary testing has taken place of an ultrasound system which is designed to provide an additional picture of the BN-800 fast neutron reactor core at Beloyarsk Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: Contract awarded for Sizewell C turbines
articles.summary: Sizewell C has awarded Arabelle Solutions a contract for the supply and installation of two complete turbine islands for the planned Sizewell C nuclear power plant in the UK. The EDF subsidiary is already supplying turbines for the sister project, Hinkley Point C.

articles.title: Momentum builds for micro-modular reactor developer
articles.summary: As well as working to speed up US licensing approval and commercialisation of its SOLO micro-modular reactor, Terra Innovatum Srl says its reactor can offer decentralised production of medical radioisotopes - and wants to engage with producers and distributors to bring them to market.

articles.title: Czech Republic seeks EC funding approval for second new nuclear unit
articles.summary: The Czech Republic, which already has European Commission approval for its financing plan for one new unit at Dukovany Nuclear Power Plant, has now formally sought approval for similar state support for the second new unit, which is part of the country's expanded new nuclear plans.

articles.title: Germany boosts funding for fusion research
articles.summary: The German cabinet has approved the federal government's action plan aimed at accelerating commercial fusion deployment in Germany. By 2029, more than EUR2 billion (USD2.3 billion) will be invested in fusion research, as well as the development of new research infrastructures and pilot projects.

articles.title: Belgium's Tihange 1 nuclear reactor ends 50 years of service
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Tihange nuclear power plant has been taken offline for the final time after 50 years of operation and disconnected from the grid. Its closure is in line with Belgium's nuclear phase-out policy, under which three other reactors have already been shut down.

articles.title: US companies selected for advanced fuel production
articles.summary: Four companies have been selected by the US Department of Energy for its new pilot programme to build advanced nuclear fuel lines. The announcement came as Standard Nuclear and Framatome announced a US-based TRISO nuclear fuel production joint venture.

articles.title: Micro modular reactor company Hadron Energy plans to go public
articles.summary: Hadron Energy Inc has announced plans to go public via a USD1.2 billion business combination with private-to-public equity company GigCapital7 Corp.

links.label: engagement with the NRC on pre-application…

articles.title: In pictures: Construction landmarks for BREST-OD-300
articles.summary: The last roofing truss has been moved into place on the turbine hall and the metal shell for the central cavity of the BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast neutron reactor has been installed.

articles.title: Construction of new Dutch research reactor formally begins
articles.summary: Anita van den Ende, Secretary General of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, has officially launched the construction of the Pallas research reactor in Petten, the Netherlands.

articles.title: Transatlantic partnership for SMR deployment
articles.summary: US advanced nuclear technology company Oklo Inc and Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla have announced a strategic partnership focused on technology collaboration, supply-chain coordination, and regulatory knowledge-sharing.

articles.title: Point Beach units cleared for 80 years of operation
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has renewed for a second time the operating licences of Point Beach units 1 and 2, clearing the way for an 80-year operating life for the two pressurised water reactors.

articles.title: Tribunal decision supports Orano in Somaïr dispute
articles.summary: An international tribunal has ruled in favour of Orano in its dispute over the sale of uranium produced from the Somaïr mine.

articles.title: Atucha I life extension work '44% completed'
articles.summary: During its first year of shutdown for work to extend its life by 20 years, the Atucha I nuclear power unit in Argentina has seen 44% of the project completed, Nucleoeléctrica Argentina has said.

articles.title: Cavendish, Amentum awarded follow-on Monju contract
articles.summary: British nuclear services company Cavendish Nuclear, together with its delivery partner USA-based engineering company Amentum, has been awarded the next phase of work by the Japan Atomic Energy Agency to support the decommissioning of the Monju Prototype Fast Reactor in Fukui Prefecture, Japan.

articles.title: Oklo tests fuel assembly at DOE lab
articles.summary: Advanced nuclear technology company Oklo Inc carried out full-scale flow testing of a prototypical fuel assembly at the Argonne National Laboratory, generating experimental data to validate computer models, demonstrate manufacturing parameters, and advance Oklo’s fuel assembly design towards production.

articles.title: Pacific Fusion to open facility in New Mexico
articles.summary: California headquartered pulsed magnetic fusion system developer Pacific Fusion has selected Albuquerque, New Mexico, as the site for its first Research and Manufacturing Campus.

articles.title: Uzbekistan plans two VVER-1000s and two SMRs
articles.summary: An agreement to expand the proposed new nuclear plant in Uzbekistan to include two gigawatt units and two RITM-200N small modular reactors was signed at the World Atomic Week International Forum held in Moscow.

links.label: on the first day of the event.

articles.title: Groundworks begin for second Bailong unit
articles.summary: Excavation work has started for the foundation of the nuclear island of the second of two CAP1000 pressurised water reactors planned as Phase I of the Bailong nuclear power plant in China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

articles.title: Study confirms feasibility of Xe-100 SMR for Alberta
articles.summary: The study by X-energy Canada has confirmed the feasibility and benefits of repurposing an existing thermal generation site in Alberta with X-energy's small modular reactors, and establishes a foundation for further planning and regulatory engagement to support future deployment.

articles.title: Twenty-year renewal sees Darlington become longest-licensed Canadian plant
articles.summary: As the refurbishment of the Darlington nuclear power plant nears completion, the Canadian nuclear regulator has announced it is authorising the plant to continue operating until 2045.

articles.title: New nuclear financing models need to be developed, says Putin
articles.summary: Russia’s President Vladimir Putin has told World Atomic Week in Moscow that he sees peaceful nuclear technologies "as the basis for international cooperation and bringing states closer together".

articles.title: IAEA issues fresh warning over drones near nuclear plants
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has said drones flew within a few hundred metres of the South Ukraine Nuclear Power Plant, underlining the continued risks to nuclear safety from the on-going war. Meanwhile Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant continues to have to rely on emergency diesel generators after a loss of off-site power.

articles.title: Framatome and ENEA aim to power Moon settlements
articles.summary: France's Framatome and the Italian Agency for New Technologies, Energy and Sustainable Development, ENEA, are to explore advanced technological solutions for nuclear reactors to power future settlements on the Moon.

articles.title: Orano-Zeno deal aims to power space batteries from recycled nuclear ‘waste’
articles.summary: Nuclear battery developer Zeno Power is to make a "multi-million dollar" investment to get priority access to americium-241 supplies from Orano's la Hague recycling site in France.

articles.title: Nuclearelectrica signs financing contracts for Cernavoda projects
articles.summary: Romania's nuclear energy giant Nuclearelectrica has signed a EUR540 million (USD634 million) financing contract with a banking syndicate led by JP Morgan for the refurbishment of Cernavoda Unit 1 and a EUR80 million loan for the next stage of the Cernavoda unit 3 and 4 project.

articles.title: Centrus announces plans for Piketon expansion
articles.summary: The major expansion of Centrus Energy's uranium enrichment plant in Ohio is expected to boost production of both low-enriched and high-assay low-enriched uranium.

articles.title: PM Modi inaugurates Mahi Banswara nuclear project
articles.summary: The four-unit Mahi Banswara plant is one of a host of central and state governmental projects ceremonially inaugurated by India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Rajasthan.

articles.title: Bulgaria discusses potential SMRs with GE Vernova
articles.summary: Bulgaria’s Prime Minister Rosen Zhelyazkov and Minister of Energy Zhecho Stankov are considering the potential installation of small modular reactors in the country as part of its aim to be a regional energy leader.

articles.title: Iran signs MoU for Russian small modular reactors
articles.summary: Russia's Rosatom and Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation have signed a memorandum of understanding for cooperation in the building of small modular reactors in Iran.

articles.title: Kansas looks at advanced reactor option
articles.summary: TerraPower, Evergy and the Kansas Department of Commerce are to explore siting TerraPower's Natrium reactor and energy storage system within Evergy's service territory in Kansas.

articles.title: Zaporizhzhia relying on diesel generators after losing off-site power
articles.summary: International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi has warned of the "fragile nuclear safety" situation at Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant as it was forced to again rely on back-up diesel generators for power.

articles.title: MoU signed for Brazil's planned multipurpose reactor
articles.summary: Brazil's National Nuclear Energy Commission has signed a memorandum of understanding with Argentina's Invap setting out the "terms, conditions and premises that will guide negotiations on the execution" of the Engineering, Procurement and Construction agreement for the Brazilian Multipurpose Reactor.

articles.title: Framatome launches Mumbai base ahead of bilateral task force meeting
articles.summary: The French nuclear company inaugurated a new operations base in India days ahead of the second meeting of a bilateral nuclear energy task force which saw the two countries reaffirm their continuing engagement in emerging technologies such as small modular reactors.

articles.title: TVA, Type One Energy collaborate on fusion commercialisation
articles.summary: The Tennessee Valley Authority is collaborating with fusion company Type One Energy on the potential deployment of fusion technology at the former Bull Run fossil plant site.

articles.title: Construction starts of Belgian disposal facility
articles.summary: Belgium's Prime Minister Bart De Wever has laid a foundation stone, marking the start of construction of a surface disposal facility for low- and intermediate-level, short-lived waste at the Dessel site in Belgium.

articles.title: Canadian SMR project shortlisted for federal fast-track
articles.summary: Ontario Power Generation's Darlington New Nuclear project has been named as one of the first projects to be reviewed by a new office set up by the federal government to help fast-track major projects.

articles.title: European SMR Industrial Alliance sets out action plan
articles.summary: The European Industrial Alliance on Small Modular Reactors has adopted its first Strategic Action Plan, outlining ten specific and targeted actions to deliver over the next five years.

articles.title: Russian developments in fast reactor fuels
articles.summary: The Fuel Division of Russian state nuclear corporation Rosatom has manufactured and accepted a unique OS-5 fuel assembly based on mixed nitride uranium-plutonium nuclear fuel with a liquid metal sublayer. Separately, the Mining and Chemical Combine is set to be the location of a MOX fuel plant to supply the BN-1200M fast reactor.

articles.title: Tepco, Sellafield extend cooperation agreement
articles.summary: Japanese utility Tokyo Electric Power Company and the UK's Sellafield Ltd have extended their agreement to cooperate in the field of nuclear decommissioning by up to another 10 years.

articles.title: Regulators unite for pre-licensing of European SMR design
articles.summary: A pre-licensing assessment of the EAGLES-300 lead-cooled small modular reactor has been launched by the Belgian, Italian and Romanian nuclear regulators. The International Atomic Energy Agency is supporting this project as a pilot project within its Nuclear Harmonisation and Standardisation Initiative.

articles.title: Cameco to supply Slovakian plants under long-term agreement
articles.summary: The long-term agreement between the Canadian uranium company and Slovenské elektrárne consists of uranium and conversion services to support operations at its nuclear plants until 2036.

articles.title: Contract awarded for parts of novel Chinese nuclear project
articles.summary: A contract has been awarded for the construction of the conventional islands of the three reactors that will comprise the first phase of the Xuwei nuclear power project in China. The plant will supply both industrial heating and electricity by coupling a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor with two pressurised water reactors.

articles.title: First nuclear Primary Coolant Pump tech transfer to India after landmark agreement
articles.summary: A strategic collaboration between Indian company CORE Energy Systems and Flowserve Corporation of the USA has been described as a landmark for India's nuclear sector and a first-of-its-kind technology transfer.

articles.title: Angra 1 used fuel being transferred to dry storage
articles.summary: Eletronuclear has begun a four month campaign of transferring used fuel from Angra nuclear power plant’s unit 1 to the Complementary Dry Storage Unit - a process which will increase by 20 years the life of the cooling pools.

articles.title: Key equipment for BREST-OD-300 reactor completes lengthy journey
articles.summary: The installation of the metal shell of the central cavity of the BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast neutron reactor is due to begin this month, following delivery of large-sized parts for it.

articles.title: Naarea advances development of molten salt reactor fuel
articles.summary: Naarea, a French developer of a molten salt fast neutron microreactor, announced it has successfully demonstrated an innovative proliferation-resistant pyrochemical method of producing sodium chloride-plutonium trichloride salt.

articles.title: Oklo announces plans for Tennessee fuel recycling plant
articles.summary: Oklo Inc has announced plans to design, build, and operate a facility at Oak Ridge in Tennessee to recycle used nuclear fuel into fuel for fast reactors like the company's own Aurora powerhouse, and is teaming up with TVA to look into recycling the utility's used fuel.

articles.title: Investment decisions needed to avoid fuel cycle supply gaps
articles.summary: Projections in the latest edition of World Nuclear Association's flagship fuel report see gaps opening up in the supply-demand picture over the coming years and investment decisions need to be taken now to fuel the forecast increase in nuclear power capacity, World Nuclear Symposium was told.

articles.title: Infrastructure work begins for Cernavoda 1 refurb project
articles.summary: Nuclearelectrica has started the civil construction works for the refurbishment project for Romania's Cernavoda nuclear power plant unit 1.

articles.title: KHNP contracts ConverDyn for conversion services
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a long-term supply contract for converted uranium with ConverDyn, the sole operator of a uranium conversion facility in the USA.

articles.title: Orano's long-term planning for post-'peak uranium' years
articles.summary: French nuclear fuel cycle company Orano is preparing for the rapid increase in demand when new nuclear energy capacity comes online in the coming decades - but is also looking to renew and expand its reprocessing and recycling facility for used fuel for the longer term, CEO Nicolas Maes told the World Nuclear Symposium in London.

articles.title: TVA, ENTRA1 Energy team up for SMR deployment
articles.summary: ENTRA1 Energy has signed a collaborative agreement with TVA to deploy up to 6 GW of NuScale SMR capacity at sites across TVA’s seven-state service region in south-eastern USA.

articles.title: Kairos, BWXT team up for commercial TRISO fuel production
articles.summary: The two companies have announced an agreement to collaboratively explore technical and process opportunities to optimise commercial production of TRISO nuclear fuel to supply Kairos Power's advanced reactor fleet and other potential customers.

articles.title: Yellowcake production begins at Kayelekera
articles.summary: Production of the first dried and drummed U3O8 is the final step in the commissioning of the process plant at Lotus Resources Inc's 85%-owned project in Malawi.

articles.title: US uranium company unveils conversion facility plans
articles.summary: Uranium Energy Corp has launched a new subsidiary to pursue the feasibility of developing a new US uranium refining and conversion facility.

articles.title: Funding allocated for UK plutonium disposal research
articles.summary: The UK's Nuclear Decommissioning Authority has been allocated GBP154 million (USD207 million) in government funding to develop specialised capabilities to enable plutonium disposal. The government announced earlier this year that the country's stockpile of plutonium will be immobilised and disposed of in a geological disposal facility.

articles.title: Inner containment construction set to begin for Leningrad’s seventh unit
articles.summary: The required specialist reinforcement and concreting works of the circular 'corridor' have been completed at Leningrad II’s unit 3 allowing the start of installation of the lower tier of the inner containment building.

articles.title: Tepco to remove fuel from Kashiwazaki-Kariwa 7
articles.summary: Japanese utility Tokyo Electric Power Company said it plans to remove fuel from unit 7 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata Prefecture due to delays in the reactor's restart.

articles.title: Aalo breaks ground for experimental reactor
articles.summary: Two weeks after being selected as one of the advanced reactor projects to receive support under the US Department of Energy's Nuclear Reactor Pilot Program, Aalo Atomics has broken ground at a site in Idaho to start construction of its first experimental extra modular nuclear reactor, the Aalo-X.

links.label: Reforming Nuclear Reactor Testing at the…

articles.title: Legislative proposals to lift Sweden's uranium mining ban
articles.summary: The Swedish government has announced a draft law that proposes amendments to the Environmental Code and the Minerals Act that would allow the extraction of uranium in the country. The legislative amendments are proposed to enter into force on 1 January 2026.

articles.title: Further proposal submitted for SMR plant in Norway
articles.summary: A proposal for an assessment programme for building a small modular reactor power plant in Grenland, southern Norway, has been submitted to the country's Ministry of Energy. Meanwhile, a project company has been established to investigate the construction of an SMR plant in the municipality of Vardø in Finnmark, north-eastern Norway.

articles.title: Site of Poland's first SMR selected
articles.summary: Poland's first small modular reactor is to be constructed in Włocławek, Orlen has announced. The site decision was announced as the state-owned power firm and Synthos Green Energy agreed on the operating model of their joint venture to build and operate SMRs.

articles.title: Kazatomprom, JUMCO sign agreement on Jordan mining project
articles.summary: Kazatomprom and Jordan's state-owned uranium mining company have signed a Heads of Agreement on the development of the Central Jordan Uranium Project.

articles.title: Heating SMR to be assessed for Cadarache site
articles.summary: French small modular reactor developer Calogena has signed a letter of intent with the French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission to consider the potential installation of a Calogena module at its Cadarache site, as well as its possible connection to the centre's heating network.

articles.title: Zimbabwe to evaluate deployment of Korean SMR
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed an agreement with Zimbabwe's Centre for Education, Innovation Research and Development to cooperate on a preliminary feasibility study for the deployment of a Korean-designed small modular reactor in the southern African country.

articles.title: Proposal submitted for SMR power plant in Lund
articles.summary: A proposal for an assessment programme for building a small modular reactor power plant in the municipality of Lund has been submitted to Norway's Ministry of Energy. Meanwhile, project companies have been established to investigate the construction of SMR plants in Øygarden and Narvik.

articles.title: Kazatomprom to lower uranium production in 2026
articles.summary: The national atomic company of Kazakhstan has announced plans for a roughly 10% cut in its uranium production in 2026, saying it does not view the current supply-demand balance and existing uncovered demand as sufficient to incentivise a return to its 100% levels at this time.

articles.title: Final assembly under way for Akkuyu 4’s reactor vessel
articles.summary: Fabrication of the control assembly for the reactor vessel has begun for the fourth unit at the Akkuyu nuclear power plant in Turkey. Rosatom said it will be the 250th nuclear reactor manufactured in Russia.

articles.title: Vattenfall to select between BWRX-300 and Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Sweden's Vattenfall says it has decided to choose small modular reactors for new nuclear capacity, with a shortlist of two: GE Vernova Hitachi's BWRX-300 and the Rolls-Royce SMR.

articles.title: BWXT launches advanced nuclear fuel subsidiary
articles.summary: BWXT Advanced Fuels, LLC will be dedicated to the commercialisation of advanced nuclear fuel, such as TRISO, and will pursue partnerships to deliver commercial nuclear fuel for advanced nuclear reactors.

articles.title: Steam generator marks milestone for Indian fleet construction
articles.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd and L&T Heavy Engineering have held a "flagging off" ceremony to mark the completion and dispatch of the steam generator for the second phase of the Gorakhpur nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Aalo Atomics secures funding to build its first reactor
articles.summary: With more than USD136 million of funding secured to date, the company's CEO says it now has the capital to build its first nuclear power plant, the Aalo-X.

articles.title: Assessment of Asse storage chamber conditions begins
articles.summary: An exploratory borehole is providing the first indications of the condition of the stored drums containing radioactive waste within Storage Chamber 12 at the former Asse II salt mine in the district of Wolfenbüttel, Lower Saxony, Germany.

articles.title: Companies join forces for possible US HALEU project
articles.summary: Advanced materials company ASP Isotopes, together with its Quantum Leap Energy LLC subsidiary, has signed an agreement with Fermi America to look into the development of a facility to produce high-assay low-enriched uranium using laser-based isotope separation technology in Texas.

articles.title: CORE Energy secures strategic investment
articles.summary: Indian engineering, procurement and construction company Core Energy Systems says the fundraise - equivalent to nearly USD23 million - reinforces its role in shaping India’s civil nuclear future.

articles.title: Steam generator installation begins at Haiyang 4
articles.summary: The first of two steam generators has been hoisted into place at unit 4 of the Haiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong province.

articles.title: Western Uranium focuses on Colorado mill
articles.summary: Western Uranium & Vanadium Corp confirmed it has begun delivering ore from its Sunday Mine Complex in Colorado for processing at Energy Fuels' White Mesa mill, but sees the development of its own Mustang processing facility as critical to its plans for in-house yellowcake production.

articles.title: Equinix signs further agreements with SMR developers
articles.summary: In a move to diversify its power supplies, data centre developer and operator Equinix has signed a preorder agreement for the purchase of 20 of Radiant's Kaleidos microreactors and intends to sign a power purchase agreement with Dutch nuclear energy development company ULC-Energy.

articles.title: US lab begins post-irradiation studies on high-burnup fuel
articles.summary: Researchers at the US Department of Energy's Pacific Northwest National Laboratory have begun post-irradiation studies on GE Vernova's high burnup fuel after it has spent six years in a commercial reactor.

articles.title: Legislative changes proposed to remove Swiss new reactor ban
articles.summary: Switzerland's Federal Council has presented draft legislation that would remove the country's ban on the construction of new nuclear power, which has been in place since 1 January 2018.

articles.title: Plans for SMR plant on Svalbard progress
articles.summary: An assessment programme has been submitted to the Governor of Svalbard for the construction of a small modular reactor power plant on the Norwegian Arctic archipelago, marking the first formal step towards building the facility.

articles.title: Presidential ceremony as Malawi mine approaches restart
articles.summary: The President of Malawi has officially inaugurated Lotus Resources' Kayelekera uranium mine as the project moves into the final stages of commissioning.

articles.title: EIL to assist in development of Indian SMR design
articles.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited has signed a memorandum of understanding with Engineers India Limited for the provision of engineering services towards the development of conceptual design and engineering of structures, systems and components of the Bharat Small Modular Reactor.

articles.title: DOE announces first selections for pilot reactor programme
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has announced its initial selection of 11 advanced reactor projects for the Nuclear Reactor Pilot Program, which aims to see at least three of them achieve criticality in less than one year from now.

links.label: Reforming Nuclear Reactor Testing at the…

articles.title: Entergy seeks approval for Waterford 3 uprate
articles.summary: Entergy has applied to the Louisiana Public Service Commission for approval to increase the power output of its Waterford 3 nuclear power plant by about 45 MWe. It is also seeking to recoup the USD68.7 million cost to carry out the uprate.

articles.title: NAC system deployed in Canadian decommissioning milestone
articles.summary: The successful completion of the shipping campaign to remove all the used nuclear fuel from Gentilly-1 using NAC International's OPTIMUS-H transportation packaging system is a valuable reference project for used fuel transportation, the company says.

articles.title: Construction gets under way of first unit at Jinqimen plant
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 1 at the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. It is the first of six Hualong One units planned for the plant.

articles.title: Radiant signs deal to supply microreactor for US military base
articles.summary: California-based Radiant said an agreement it has signed with the Defense Innovation Unit and the Department of the Air Force is the first-ever deal designed to deliver a mass-manufactured nuclear microreactor to a US military base.

articles.title: Detailed site survey begins at Dukovany
articles.summary: A ceremony has been held at the Dukovany nuclear power plant in the Czech Republic to mark the start of a detailed site survey in preparation for the construction of two Korean-supplied APR1000s there.

articles.title: Construction permit granted for new Chinese plant
articles.summary: China's National Nuclear Safety Administration has issued a construction licence for units 1 and 2 at the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, clearing the way for first concrete to be poured for the foundation of the reactor building of the first unit.

articles.title: Site surveys begin for first Kazakh nuclear power plant
articles.summary: A ceremony has been held near the village of Ulken in the Almaty region of Kazakhstan to mark the start of engineering surveys, the first step in establishing a large-scale nuclear power plant there. The surveys will determine the optimal site and prepare design documentation for the future plant.

articles.title: Uranium producers share market confidence in half-year roundups
articles.summary: Cameco, Kazatomprom and Orano have all confirmed their production outlook for the remainder of 2025 in recent first-half results announcements.

articles.title: Q&A: Working towards a closed nuclear fuel cycle
articles.summary: Mikhail Baryshnikov, Head of Innovative Products Development Department for Russia’s Tenex and former chairman of World Nuclear Association’s Used Nuclear Fuel working group, explains what a closed nuclear fuel cycle is, and how it is being developed.

articles.title: US uranium industry growth continues
articles.summary: As Uranium Energy Corp's Sweetwater Uranium Complex is designated for fast-tracked permitting by the US Government, the US Energy Information Administration has confirmed "significant" year-on-year growth in the nation's uranium industry, both in output and employment.

articles.title: Denver airport contemplating onsite reactor
articles.summary: Denver International Airport is considering the deployment of a small modular reactor as part of goal of becoming "the greenest airport in the world and to be energy independent".

articles.title: Turbogenerator for Russian fast reactor delivered
articles.summary: The turbogenerator for the BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast neutron reactor has been delivered to the construction site at the Siberian Chemical Combine site in Seversk, in the Tomsk Region of Russia.

articles.title: Third Korean reactor taken offline as licence renewal decision awaited
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has suspended operation of unit 4 at its Kori nuclear power plant pending a government decision to allow the country's reactors to operate beyond 40 years. Kori units 2 and 3 have already been taken offline following the expiry of their 40-year design lives.

articles.title: NextEra seeks to reconnect Duane Arnold to the grid
articles.summary: NextEra Energy has filed a request with the US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission seeking to reclaim interconnection rights that were previously transferred from the shut down Duane Arnold nuclear power plant in Iowa to a solar energy project.

articles.title: CEZ completing Temelin SMR boreholes survey
articles.summary: The Czech Republic's CEZ is completing a round of geological boreholes, with the results to be used in its site application for a small modular reactor at the Temelin nuclear power plant which it hopes to submit during 2026.

articles.title: DOE makes first pick for advanced fuel pilot project
articles.summary: Standard Nuclear has been announced as the first US company to be conditionally accepted into the Department of Energy's programme to establish a domestic nuclear fuel supply chain for testing new reactors.

articles.title: Polish research reactor permitted to continue operating
articles.summary: Poland's National Atomic Energy Agency has issued a new operating licence for the MARIA nuclear research reactor, operation of which was suspended after its previous licence expired at the end of March.

articles.title: Key equipment manufactured for BREST-OD-300 reactor
articles.summary: Six items weighing more than 1,000 tonnes have been manufactured for the BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast neutron reactor which is being built at the Siberian Chemical Combine site in Seversk, in the Tomsk Region of Russia.

articles.title: Tractebel, NRG-Pallas extend cooperation on research reactor
articles.summary: Belgian engineering firm Tractebel announced it has signed a new mutual agreement with NRG-Pallas to extend their long-standing collaboration on the construction of the Pallas research reactor in Petten, the Netherlands.

articles.title: Rolls-Royce SMR agreements with Škoda and Curtiss-Wright
articles.summary: UK-based Rolls-Royce SMR has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Czech firm Škoda JS to explore the production of key components for a global fleet of small modular reactors.

articles.title: Helion begins work on fusion power plant
articles.summary: Fusion energy developer Helion Energy announced it has begun initial earthwork and construction on the site of Orion power plant in Malaga, in the US state of Washington. The plant will provide electricity to technology company Microsoft.

articles.title: Pilot uranium processing plant launched in Tanzania
articles.summary: The pilot uranium processing plant has been commissioned by Rosatom subsidiary Mantra Tanzania Ltd at the Mkuju River project in southern Tanzania.

articles.title: Fermi America, Hyundai E&C team up for Texan reactors
articles.summary: US private energy developer Fermi America has signed a memorandum of understanding with South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction to plan and develop the nuclear component of what is designed to be the world's largest, first-of-its kind private grid to power next-generation AI.

articles.title: Newcleo to scale back UK operations
articles.summary: France-headquartered innovative reactor developer Newcleo announced it is suspending its programme to develop lead-cooled fast reactors in the UK and will substantially wind down its UK activities.

articles.title: Tomari 3 meets safety requirements, regulator concludes
articles.summary: Unit 3 of Hokkaido Electric Power Company's Tomari nuclear power plant - Japan's newest power reactor - has moved a step closer to restarting after the country's Nuclear Regulation Authority concluded the unit meets revised safety standards.

articles.title: Korean SMRs to be considered for Norwegian project
articles.summary: Norway's Trondheimsleia Kjernekraft AS and Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power are to conduct a feasibility study on the construction of a power plant based on multiple Korean-designed i-SMR reactors in the municipalities of Aure and Heim.

articles.title: ENEC and Samsung C&T to collaborate on global nuclear projects
articles.summary: The Emirates Nuclear Energy Company and Samsung C&T Corporation have signed a memorandum of understanding to jointly explore projects ranging from restarts in the USA, to small modular reactors in the UAE, to potential nuclear-powered hydrogen production in South Korea.

articles.title: Lightbridge fabricates enriched uranium advanced fuel sample
articles.summary: Lightbridge Corporation has fabricated coupon samples using enriched uranium-zirconium alloy representative of the fuel material alloy composition it plans to use in its commercial next-generation fuel.

articles.title: Fuel debris removal from Fukushima reactors delayed
articles.summary: The start of full-scale fuel debris removal from the damaged reactors at Japan's Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant is now expected to begin in 2037 at the earliest, instead of the early 2030s.

articles.title: Slovakia and Urenco sign enriched uranium supply contract
articles.summary: Slovenské elektrárne has signed a contract with Urenco Group for the supply of enriched uranium to its Bohunice and Mochovce nuclear power plants to the mid-2030s.
