articles.title: ENEC signs collaboration deals with Korea, USA
articles.summary: The Emirates Nuclear Energy Company and Hyundai Engineering & Construction are to jointly explore international nuclear energy opportunities. The announcement came days after ENEC signed an agreement with Westinghouse to accelerate the deployment of AP1000 reactors.

articles.title: Assembly of Taipingling 3 containment vessel begins
articles.summary: The bottom head of the containment vessel of unit 3 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant has been installed on the central raft foundation of the unit's nuclear island, China General Nuclear announced.

articles.title: Work starts on Pele microreactor core
articles.summary: Fabrication of the reactor core for the Project Pele prototype mobile microreactor - the first microreactor to be built and operated in the USA - has begun at BWX Technologies' Innovation Campus in Lynchburg, Virginia.

articles.title: Regulatory approvals pave way for Palisades restart
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved a series of licensing and regulatory actions that will allow fuel loading at Holtec's plant.

articles.title: There are now 127 different SMR designs, finds NEA report
articles.summary: The latest edition of the OECD Nuclear Energy Agency's Small Modular Reactor Dashboard reports growing interest around the world with 51 SMR designs involved in pre-licensing or licensing processes and 85 active discussions between SMR developers and site owners.

articles.title: BWXT set for production of advanced form of TRISO fuel
articles.summary: BWX Technologies Inc announced it has installed all the equipment required for the production of Uranium Nitride TRISO fuel for advanced reactors at its Technology Centre in Lynchburg, Virginia.

articles.title: Access to funding remains a major issue for fusion, says industry report
articles.summary: The fusion industry raised USD2.64 billion in private and public funding in the 12 months to July 2025, according to the latest annual Global Fusion Industry Report from the Fusion Industry Association. Total funding for the 53 fusion companies surveyed has reached a cumulative USD9.766 billion.

articles.title: Kansai considers Mihama site for new reactor
articles.summary: Japanese utility Kansai Electric Power Company plans to conduct surveys of the Mihama nuclear power plant site in Fukui Prefecture to determine if a new reactor could be build there as a replacement for unit 1, which was declared permanently shut down in 2015.

articles.title: Design work progresses for Russian molten salt reactor
articles.summary: The first stage of design work on a prototype molten salt reactor has been completed, Russian state nuclear corporation Rosatom has said.

articles.title: Darlington SMR to feature Arabelle Solutions turbine gear
articles.summary: EDF subsidiary Arabelle Solutions is to supply turbine island equipment for the first BWRX-300 small modular reactor project at the Darlington site in Ontario, Canada.

articles.title: OPG, OSGE enhance cooperation on SMR deployment in Poland
articles.summary: Poland's Orlen Synthos Green Energy has signed a letter of intent with Canada's Ontario Power Generation to collaborate on a framework for the commercial development and operation of BWRX-300 reactors in Poland.

articles.title: US seeks pilot production lines for advanced reactor fuel
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has announced the start of a new pilot programme to accelerate the development of advanced nuclear reactors and strengthen domestic supply chains for nuclear fuel.

articles.title: ČEZ and Rolls-Royce SMR sign Temelín early works agreement
articles.summary: The Czech Republic's ČEZ and UK-based Rolls-Royce SMR have signed an Early Works Agreement to start site-specific work for potential small modular reactors at the Temelin nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Framatome to supply nuclear fuel to UAE's Barakah plant
articles.summary: Framatome and the Emirates Nuclear Energy Company have signed an agreement for the supply of nuclear fuel assemblies and engineering services for the Barakah nuclear power plant in the United Arab Emirates.

articles.title: Westinghouse, Google aim to speed up reactor construction with AI
articles.summary: Westinghouse has announced it is to collaborate with Google Cloud to use artificial intelligence tools to streamline construction of new nuclear plants and enhance the operations of existing nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Kairos Power installs third test unit reactor vessel
articles.summary: Kairos Power has installed the reactor vessel for its third Engineering Test Unit, which is under construction in Oak Ridge, Tennessee. The non-nuclear prototype will be used to pilot new manufacturing techniques and construction processes to lower the cost of building the company's commercial reactor.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Xudabao 1
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 1 of the Xudabao nuclear power plant in China's Liaoning Province. It will be one of two CAP1000 reactors planned for the first plant, where two VVER-1200 reactors are also under construction.

articles.title: China's largest uranium mining project enters production
articles.summary: The National Uranium No.1 project began producing uranium concentrate in China, a year after work started.

articles.title: EU provides funding for fusion materials testing facility
articles.summary: The European Commission is to invest EUR202 million (USD236 million) in the IFMIF-DONES particle accelerator located in Granada, Spain, covering about 25% of the project's cost. The facility will test materials to be used in fusion power plants.

articles.title: PEJ seeks European Commission approval for nuclear project
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has officially notified the European Commission about its investment project involving Poland's first nuclear power plant, in accordance with its obligations under the Euratom Treaty.

articles.title: Modernisation of Zelenogorsk uranium enrichment production completed
articles.summary: The six-year modernisation project at the Electrochemical Plant in Zelenogorsk involved installing new generation gas centrifuges.

articles.title: Preparation stage begins for BN-1200M construction
articles.summary: The fast neutron BN-1200 reactor planned as Beloyarsk Nuclear Power Plant’s fifth unit has entered the preparation stage for construction.

articles.title: Energoatom signs Westinghouse and Holtec agreements
articles.summary: Energoatom is pushing ahead with plans with Westinghouse to create a plant for the production of fuel assemblies in Ukraine, and with Holtec for manufacturing plants for small modular reactors and for storage containers for used nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Final stage of IMSR graphite irradiation testing starts
articles.summary: Terrestrial Energy and NRG-Pallas are starting the final phase of the graphite irradiation testing programme for Terrestrial's molten salt reactor at the High Flux Reactor in Petten, the Netherlands.

articles.title: TerraPower awards Natrium supplier contracts
articles.summary: TerraPower has announced three more supplier contracts as part of the fifth round of procurement awards for the Natrium project in Kemmerer, Wyoming, in the USA.

articles.title: NANO Nuclear to help revive Argentinean uranium mining
articles.summary: US microreactor technology company NANO Nuclear Energy Inc has signed a memorandum of understanding with Buenos Aires-based private uranium exploration company UrAmerica Ltd to help modernise and develop Argentina's nuclear fuel supply chain.

articles.title: Supplementary agreements signed for El Dabaa project
articles.summary: Egypt's President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi held meetings to discuss progress on the El Dabaa nuclear power plant with Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev, before an amendment to the intergovernmental agreement between Egypt and Russia was signed.

articles.title: Newcleo offered site for MOX fuel plant
articles.summary: Paris-headquartered Newcleo has received a favourable opinion from the council of the Aube Department region of eastern France to sell a plot of land in the Nogentais area, which could host the fast neutron reactor developer's mixed-oxide fuel manufacturing facility.

articles.title: Gentilly 1 declared free from nuclear fuel
articles.summary: Canadian Nuclear Laboratories announced it has completed the transfer of used fuel from the Gentilly-1 Waste Management Facility site in Québec to the Chalk River Laboratories site in Ontario ahead of schedule.

articles.title: Restart and extended operation of Belgian reactor approved
articles.summary: Belgium's Federal Agency for Nuclear Control has given the go-ahead for the restart of unit 3 at the Tihange nuclear power plant following a maintenance outage in preparation for the unit's operation for a further ten years.

articles.title: Pallas reactor ready to enter construction phase, minister says
articles.summary: The Netherlands' outgoing Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport Daniëlle Jansen has informed the House of Representatives that the project to construct the Pallas research reactor in Petten is ready to enter the next phase.

articles.title: Brazil and China energy agreements include uranium focus
articles.summary: Brazil's Ministry of Mines and Energy and China General Nuclear Power Group have signed a letter of intent to cooperate on energy transition efforts, sustainability "and the peaceful and sustainable use of nuclear mineral resources in Brazil".

articles.title: South Tortkuduk uranium project fully operational
articles.summary: France's Orano and Kazakhstan's Kazatomprom and their Katco joint venture have announced the full implementation of operations at the South Tortkuduk uranium mining site.

links.label: A guide: Uranium and the nuclear fuel cycle

articles.title: Baltic Shipyard says robot welding to speed up construction
articles.summary: Russia's Baltic Shipyard has demonstrated the use of a collaborative robot and a welding robot with machine vision, which it says will be an important part of the plant's modernisation programme.

articles.title: US regulator accelerates review of Natrium permit
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission now expects to complete its review of TerraPower's construction licence application for the Natrium advanced reactor demonstration project by the end of 2025, ahead of the original August 2026 date.

articles.title: Korean accident-resistant fuel begins in-reactor testing
articles.summary: A demonstration accident-resistant nuclear fuel assembly has been loaded into the core of unit 6 of the Hanul nuclear power plant, marking the first time in Korea that such a fuel assembly has been loaded into a reactor, Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power announced.

articles.title: Google signs up for power from future fusion plant
articles.summary: Google has signed an investment and offtake agreement with Commonwealth Fusion Systems for 200 MW of power from its first ARC commercial fusion plant which is to be built in Virginia.

articles.title: Early works agreement for BWRX-300 SMRs in Finland and Sweden
articles.summary: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy and Fortum are to work on pre-licensing and engineering activities for site adaptation in Finland and Sweden aiming for deployment of BWRX-300 small modular reactors in the 2030s.

articles.title: Alliance appointed for Sizewell C construction
articles.summary: Construction firms Balfour Beatty, Laing O'Rourke and Bouygues Travaux Publics have signed a Programme Alliance Agreement with Sizewell C to deliver the main civil works at the new nuclear power plant in the UK.

articles.title: Hungary says US sanctions exemption will help Paks II project
articles.summary: Hungary's Foreign Affairs and Trade Minister Peter Szijjarto has said US President Donald Trump sees Hungary as a friend and "it was in this spirit that the US administration lifted the sanctions related to the Paks nuclear plant project".

articles.title: Kalinin's first unit gets 19-year life extension
articles.summary: Russia's nuclear regulator Rostekhnadzor has issued an operating licence to the Kalinin nuclear power plant's unit 1 to June 2044.

articles.title: Centrus reaches HALEU production milestone
articles.summary: The company's American Centrifuge Operating, LLC subsidiary has met the 900 kg production target for the second phase of its three-phase contract to supply the US Department of Energy with high-assay, low-enriched uranium.

articles.title: Reactor internals installed at Haiyang 4
articles.summary: The reactor internals have been successfully hoisted into position at unit 4 of the Haiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong province.

articles.title: UK looks to robots to assist in waste management tasks
articles.summary: The UK's Nuclear Decommissioning Authority has announced a partnership which will see innovative technology deployed for the first time on a nuclear site to remotely and autonomously sort and segregate radioactive waste.

articles.title: JEK2 spatial planning consultation being launched
articles.summary: Slovenia is due to begin a three month public consultation as part of the spatial planning process for proposed JEK2 new nuclear capacity at the Krško nuclear power plant.

articles.title: UK and Japan deepen fusion energy cooperation
articles.summary: A memorandum of cooperation has been signed between the UK and Japan for partnership on fusion energy - as companies in the two countries announce new collaborations.

articles.title: Companies partner on AI platform to speed up nuclear deployments
articles.summary: Software development company Palantir Technologies Inc is partnering with The Nuclear Company to develop and deploy an AI-driven, real-time software system that they say will transform the construction of nuclear reactors.

articles.title: Decommissioning of oldest Korean reactor approved
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission has approved the decommissioning of unit 1 at the Kori nuclear power plant near Busan. The unit was permanently shut down in June 2017, becoming the first South Korean reactor to enter decommissioning.

articles.title: Crane Clean Energy Centre on track for ahead-of-schedule restart
articles.summary: Unit 1 at the plant could restart as early as 2027 with the approval of an early interconnection request by grid operator PJM, Constellation said as it held a celebration of progress at the plant in Pennsylvania.

links.label: published last September by the Pennsylvania…

articles.title: World Bank and IAEA backing new nuclear for development
articles.summary: The World Bank has taken its first step since ending its ban on funding nuclear energy projects by partnering with the International Atomic Energy Agency to support countries that choose to include nuclear energy in their development strategies.

articles.title: Italian cement manufacturers to evaluate Newcleo reactors
articles.summary: France-headquartered innovative reactor developer Newcleo has signed a memorandum of understanding with Federbeton, the Italian cement association, to explore Newcleo's technologies and potential synergies with the cement industry.

articles.title: ABS approves second Korean floating SMR plant design
articles.summary: Maritime classification society the American Bureau of Shipping has issued approval in principle to HD Hyundai Heavy Industries and HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering for a concept of a floating small modular reactor-powered power module.

articles.title: SMR considered for deployment in southern Sweden
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla has signed a letter of intent with Hörby Municipality to jointly investigate the possibility of siting a SEALER reactor in Stavröd in Skåne County, southern Sweden.

articles.title: Norwegian SMR project development firm launched
articles.summary: A new company has been established with the goal of developing a nuclear power plant near the Mongstad oil refinery in Norway. Meanwhile, Norsk Kjernekraft has partnered with France's Hexana to explore opportunities for joint deployment of advanced nuclear technologies in Norway.

articles.title: Mali and Russia sign agreement on peaceful use of nuclear energy
articles.summary: The agreement creates a legal basis for cooperation between Russia and Mali and follows on from a roadmap for developing ties on peaceful uses of nuclear energy signed last year.

articles.title: Regulator lifts construction curbs at Paks II
articles.summary: Hungary's Atomic Energy Authority has granted permission to resume construction activity in the entire working pit area of the planned first new unit at the Paks II nuclear power plant project.

articles.title: Centrus HALEU contract extended
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has exercised an option to extend the contract for the production of high-assay, low-enriched uranium until 30 June 2026, but additional options could allow for continued production for up to eight more years.

articles.title: Regulator completes preliminary assessment of Steady Energy's SMR concept
articles.summary: The Finnish Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority says the draft concept assessment for Steady Energy's proposed LDR-50 plant found that "nuclear and radiation safety, security arrangements, emergency arrangements and nuclear material safeguards solutions are such that they can be designed to meet safety requirements".

articles.title: INB signs Brazil microreactor contracts
articles.summary: Industrias Nucleares do Brasil has signed a contract with the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation and the Financing Agency for Studies and Projects for the development and testing of critical technologies applicable to Brazil's planned microreactor.

articles.title: TerraPower welcomes new investors to support SMR plans
articles.summary: The venture capital arm of multinational technology company NVIDIA is among investors in the USD650 million capital raise, which TerraPower says will support the first Natrium plant as well as the company’s plans to rapidly deploy additional units in the US and abroad.

articles.title: Newcleo and Nextchem sign joint venture agreement
articles.summary: Maire S.p.A subsidiary Nextchem and France-based innovative reactor developer Newcleo are creating the NextCleo joint venture to develop the conventional island and balance of plant of nuclear power plants based on Newcleo's 200 MW advanced modular reactors.

articles.title: European alliance to develop lead-cooled SMR
articles.summary: Four European nuclear technology organisations have launched the Eagles Consortium to develop and commercialise the EAGLES-300 next-generation lead-cooled small modular reactor with the aim of delivering a first demonstration by 2035.

articles.title: First Westinghouse nuclear fuel delivered to Dukovany
articles.summary: The first Westinghouse nuclear fuel assemblies have arrived at the Dukovany Nuclear Power Plant, as the Czech Republic continues to diversify its supplies.

articles.title: Kazakhstan selects Rosatom for first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Russia's Rosatom has been selected as the leader of an international consortium to build Kazakhstan's first planned nuclear power plant - with China being lined up to build a second one.

articles.title: EU says EUR241 billion investment needed to deliver nuclear plans
articles.summary: The European Commission has assessed that lifetime extensions and new large-scale reactors planned by member states will need investment of EUR241 billion (USD279 billion) by 2050 - with more needed for small modular reactors and advanced modular reactors.

articles.title: World Bank ends ban on funding nuclear energy
articles.summary: The World Bank is ending its long-standing ban on providing funding for nuclear energy projects - and will be open to supporting efforts to extend the life of existing reactors and accelerate the potential of small modular reactors in developing countries.

articles.title: Utah to host NuCube test reactor
articles.summary: US innovative microreactor developer NuCube Energy has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Utah San Rafael Energy Lab to collaborate on the siting of a test reactor at the laboratory.

articles.title: New supply agreement expands Talen-Amazon partnership
articles.summary: Talen Energy Corporation has entered into a new agreement for the long-term supply of 1,920 MWe of electricity from its Susquehanna nuclear power plant to support Amazon Web Services' data centres, as well as looking into building SMRs and capacity uprates.

articles.title: SMR plant proposed for remote Norwegian region
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla and Norwegian nuclear project developer Norsk Kjernekraft are to launch a joint project company to develop an SMR power plant on the Norwegian Arctic archipelago of Svalbard.

articles.title: Construction under way of third Taipingling unit
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 3 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant in Guangdong province. It is the third of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

articles.title: Fuel loading under way at Kashiwazaki-Kariwa unit 6
articles.summary: Japanese utility Tokyo Electric Power Company announced that it has begun loading fuel assemblies into the core of unit 6 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant ahead of its restart. The unit looks likely to be restarted before unit 7, into which fuel was loaded last year.

articles.title: KHNP and Thailand's EGAT to explore SMR options
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand for cooperation on small modular reactors and exploring their feasibility for future projects.

articles.title: Official proposal lodged for Halden SMR plant
articles.summary: Halden Kjernekraft has submitted a proposal to Norway's Ministry of Energy for an assessment of the construction of both a power plant based on multiple small modular reactors as well as a radioactive waste storage facility at Halden, in southeast Norway.

articles.title: Communications plays pivotal role in power plant performance, WANO gathering hears
articles.summary: The World Association of Nuclear Operators hosted the third Global Nuclear Communications Forum, with WANO CEO Naoki Chigusa saying the event "made clear that communications is not just a support function - it’s a strategic driver of progress across the nuclear sector".

articles.title: Pilot operation begins for TVS-5 nuclear fuel
articles.summary: Rosatom says that its fifth generation nuclear fuel assemblies have been loaded into the VVER-1200 reactor core of Novovoronezh unit 6 as part of developments to involve VVER reactors in closing the nuclear fuel cycle.

articles.title: Rolls-Royce SMR named as UK's selected technology
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR was named preferred technology partner for the UK's planned first SMR programme, subject to approvals and contracting.

articles.title: Newcleo reactor design accepted for UK assessment
articles.summary: France-headquartered innovative reactor developer Newcleo announced that its LFR-AS-200 small modular lead-cooled fast reactor design has been accepted to enter the UK's Generic Design Assessment process.

articles.title: Zaporizhzhia security, restart and US fuel discussed in IAEA-Russian talks
articles.summary: In the latest meeting between International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi and Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev the two sides discussed the on-going security situation and issues relating to any future restart of the plant's units.

articles.title: Argentina aiming for SMR and uranium developments
articles.summary: Plans for the deployment of four ACR-300 small modular reactors and restarting uranium mining and enrichment were among the priorities outlined as Argentina's National Atomic Energy Commission celebrated its 75th anniversary.

articles.title: Canada begins public engagement on siting of second repository
articles.summary: Canada's Nuclear Waste Management Organization is seeking public input to "confirm and refine" its proposed approach ahead of the planned 2028 launch of the site selection process for a second radioactive waste repository.

articles.title: Allseas aims for rapid SMR deployment
articles.summary: Dutch offshore construction engineering contractor Allseas has launched a five-year plan to design, develop and deploy a small modular reactor tailored for integration into offshore vessels and for onshore use.

articles.title: Czech-KHNP Dukovany contract signed after court lifts injunction
articles.summary: The contract with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power for new nuclear capacity at the Dukovany site in the Czech Republic has been signed - hours after the Supreme Administrative Court annulled a regional court's injunction to stop it happening.

articles.title: Meta, Constellation sign 20-year clean power deal
articles.summary: A 20-year power purchase agreement between Meta and Constellation will secure the long-term operation of Constellation's Clinton Clean Energy Center, while the tech company is also moving forward with its process to develop nuclear capacity at new US locations.

articles.title: New Mexico uranium projects selected for permitting fast-track
articles.summary: Two of Laramide Resources Ltd's advanced-stage uranium development projects - Crownpoint-Churchrock and La Jara Mesa - have been designated FAST-41 Covered Projects by the US Federal Permitting Improvement Steering Council.

links.label: according to the US Government's Permitting…

articles.title: Collaboration aims to develop Swedish uranium deposits
articles.summary: Australian mineral company Aura Energy and Neu Horizon Uranium Limited plan to enter into a strategic collaboration agreement to develop Sweden's uranium resources should the country remove its prohibition on uranium mining.

articles.title: NRC says no environmental impact from Palisades restart
articles.summary: The US nuclear regulator has issued its final environmental assessment and finding of no significant impacts for Holtec's request to return the Palisades Nuclear Plant to an operational status.

articles.title: Uprated NuScale SMR design gets US approval
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved the 77 MWe version of NuScale Power's NuScale Power Module small modular reactor design. The regulator had previously approved a 50 MWe version of the design.

articles.title: Korea to evaluate proposed Ugandan nuclear power plant site
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has been contracted by Uganda's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Development to carry out an evaluation at a proposed site in the Buyende region for the construction of the country's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: EDF 'just seeking to ensure Czech project meets EU rules'
articles.summary: French company EDF says the goal of its legal challenge to the decision to award the contract for new nuclear capacity in the Czech Republic to Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power is to ensure it is "in accordance with European regulatory rules".

links.label: which was when the result of the tender was…

articles.title: Darlington SMR contract awarded to Candu Energy
articles.summary: Ontario Power Generation has awarded AtkinsRéalis company Candu Energy Inc a CAD450 million (USD325 million) execution contract for the first of the four planned small modular reactor units at the Darlington New Nuclear Project.

articles.title: Oklo, KHNP to cooperate on SMR projects
articles.summary: California-based liquid metal fast reactor developer Oklo Inc has signed a memorandum of understanding with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power aimed at promoting collaboration on the development of small modular reactor technology.

articles.title: Construction of new Korean reactor begins
articles.summary: First safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 3 at the Shin Hanul nuclear power plant in South Korea. The APR1400 unit is scheduled to be completed in 2032.

articles.title: Swiss nuclear fuel contract for Framatome
articles.summary: France's Framatome is to supply ATRIUM 11 fuel assemblies to the Leibstadt nuclear power plant in Switzerland following the signing of a long-term contract with operator Kernkraftwerk Leibstadt AG.

articles.title: Go-ahead for Columbia plant uprate
articles.summary: The Bonneville Power Administration has given the go-ahead to a USD700 million project which, together with planned energy efficiency upgrades, will add a total 186 MWe of capacity to the only operating nuclear power plant in the USA's Pacific Northwest region by 2031.

articles.title: Norwegian firms select partners for uranium, decommissioning
articles.summary: Norwegian nuclear project developer Norsk Kjernekraft is to cooperate with Aurum Green Energy, a private company exploring for uranium resources in Norway. Meanwhile, Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning has selected Amentum for the next phase of Norway's nuclear clean-up programme.

articles.title: Fast-tracked US uranium project receives federal approval
articles.summary: The US Department of the Interior has approved Anfield Energy Inc's Velvet-Wood uranium-vanadium project in San Juan County, Utah, after the Bureau of Land Management completed its review of the project in less than 14 days.

articles.title: Westinghouse fuel arrives at Temelin nuclear power plant
articles.summary: The Czech Republic has taken delivery of the first 30 fuel assemblies for the Temelin nuclear power plant from Westinghouse as it replaces its previous supplier from Russia.

articles.title: Canada's first SMR project: How is CAD20.9 billion cost calculated?
articles.summary: The go-ahead has been given for Ontario Power Generation to begin construction of the first of four small modular reactors at the Darlington New Nuclear Project site - the total projected cost is CAD20.9 billion (USD15.1 billion), but what does that figure include?

articles.title: Date set for Taiwan referendum on nuclear restart
articles.summary: A motion to hold a referendum on restarting the recently shut-down Maanshan nuclear power plant was passed in Taiwan's Legislative Yuan, and the Central Election Commission has now approved the proposal.

articles.title: Russia 'ready to keep supplying enriched uranium to USA'
articles.summary: Rosatom Director General Alexey Likhachev has said the USA continues to buy enriched uranium from Russia and "in the context of the ongoing negotiations between the US and the Russian Federation ... we can expand the agenda of this cooperation".

articles.title: Estonia starts planning process for SMR plant
articles.summary: The Government of Estonia has announced the start of the spatial planning process and Strategic Environmental Impact Assessment for Fermi Energia's proposed 600 MWe nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Westinghouse, First Nations sign MoU to look at SMR opportunities
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company's agreement with the Pabineau and Eel River Bar First Nations is to promote Westinghouse technology for new-build projects at the Port of Belledune in New Brunswick, with an initial focus on exploring AP300 small modular reactor opportunities for local developers.

articles.title: Referendum proposed for restart of Taiwan's Maanshan nuclear power plant
articles.summary: A proposal to hold a referendum on restarting the recently shut-down Maanshan nuclear power plant has been passed in Taiwan's Legislative Yuan.

articles.title: Orano begins production of LEU+ transport cylinders
articles.summary: Orano has begun serial production of ten 30B-10 cylinders designed for the transport of LEU+ - uranium hexafluoride enriched up to 10% uranium-235.

articles.title: First RITM-400 reactor unit manufactured for new generation icebreaker
articles.summary: The manufacture of the first RITM-400 reactor unit has been completed for the Rossiya, which is scheduled to feature two of the reactors and become the world's most powerful nuclear-powered icebreaker.

articles.title: Study validates borehole disposal concept for TRISO fuel
articles.summary: Working with advanced reactor company Kairos Power, nuclear waste disposal technology company Deep Isolation has demonstrated the feasibility and potential commercial readiness of its system for managing used TRISO nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Czech-EU agreement 'to act quickly' to clarify nuclear tender issues
articles.summary: The Czech Republic's Minister of Industry and Trade Lukáš Vlček held talks with French Energy Minister Marc Ferracci and European Commissioner Stéphane Séjourné about the new nuclear planned at Dukovany, and losing bidder EDF's objections to the tender process.

articles.title: TVA submits first US BWRX-300 construction application
articles.summary: The Tennessee Valley Authority has submitted an application to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for a permit to build a GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy BWRX-300 small modular reactor at Clinch River.

articles.title: First phase of US enrichment plant expansion starts up
articles.summary: Production of enriched uranium has begun in the first new gas centrifuge cascade installed as part of Urenco USA's expansion of its plant in New Mexico.

articles.title: Kyushu considering 'next-gen innovative reactor' options
articles.summary: Japan's Kyushu Electric Power Co says it is currently considering designs including innovative light-water reactors, small modular reactors and high-temperature gas reactors as it aims to develop a "next-generation innovative reactor".

articles.title: Reactor closure marks Taiwan's nuclear exit
articles.summary: Taiwan disconnected its final operating nuclear reactor, Maanshan 2, from the grid as its licence expired.

articles.title: Funding secured for Kazakh sulphuric acid plant
articles.summary: Kazakhstan's national atomic company Kazatomprom has secured a credit facility for the construction of a new 800,000 tonnes per year sulphuric acid plant in Taikonur, in the Turkestan region.

articles.title: Belgium begins consultation on SMR design
articles.summary: Belgium's Nuclear Research Centre and the national nuclear regulator have announced the start of a formal preliminary consultation on an innovative small modular reactor using lead-cooled technology.

articles.title: Nova Scotia lifts uranium ban, issues request for proposals
articles.summary: The Canadian province has updated its critical minerals list to include uranium and issued a request for proposals for uranium exploration and research in areas with known uranium deposits after repealing legislation that banned uranium exploration and mining.

articles.title: Brazil and Russia preparing to develop SMR options
articles.summary: Brazil's Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira has reportedly said he expects the development of a small modular reactor project with Russia in the near future.

articles.title: Utah uranium project fast-tracked under US emergency procedures
articles.summary: The US Department of the Interior has announced it will expedite the permitting review of Anfield Energy's Velvet-Wood mine in Utah under newly established emergency procedures, with a completion timeline of 14 days for an accelerated environmental review by the Bureau of Land Management.

articles.title: First steel cast for Uzbekistan's SMR
articles.summary: A 205-tonne ingot of special alloy steel to be used in the production of the planned small modular reactor in Uzbekistan has been cast at AEM-Special Steels in Saint Petersburg.

articles.title: Costain wins design contract for Urenco HALEU facility
articles.summary: Infrastructure company Costain has been selected by Urenco to carry out the front-end engineering design for the UK's first high-assay low-enriched uranium advanced fuels facility.

articles.title: Vietnam and Russia 'to expedite' nuclear power plant talks
articles.summary: Following bilateral talks a joint statement says the two countries have "agreed to expedite negotiations and the signing of intergovernmental agreements on the construction of nuclear power plants in Vietnam".

articles.title: Venice exhibition includes model of Newcleo reactor
articles.summary: A full-scale model of innovative reactor developer Newcleo's TL-40 lead-cooled fast reactor for maritime applications is being displayed at the 19th International Architecture Exhibition of the Venice Biennale. Newcleo said the exhibit is aimed at "redefining the image of nuclear energy".

articles.title: Construction contract awarded for Darlington SMR
articles.summary: Aecon Kiewit Nuclear Partners has been awarded a construction contract for the execution phase of Ontario Power Generation's Darlington New Nuclear Project, which received provincial approval on Thursday.

articles.title: Foundation in place for new Dutch research reactor
articles.summary: The construction pit and foundation have been completed for the reactor building of the Pallas research reactor in Petten, the Netherlands. Preparations are now under way for the start of construction of the reactor building itself.

articles.title: Construction of second Shidaowan Hualong One begins
articles.summary: China Huaneng has announced the pouring of first concrete for the second Hualong One reactor of Phase I (units 1 and 2) at the Shidaowan nuclear power plant site in China's Shandong Province.

articles.title: Metal cutting begins for nuclear icebreaker Stalingrad
articles.summary: The first metal has been cut for the seventh nuclear-powered icebreaker in Russia's Project 22220 series. The Stalingrad is scheduled to be completed and delivered in December 2030.

articles.title: First concrete for US advanced reactor
articles.summary: Kairos Power began placing safety-related concrete for the Hermes low-power demonstration reactor in Oak Ridge.

articles.title: OPG gets go-ahead to build first SMR in Canada
articles.summary: The Province of Ontario has approved Ontario Power Generation to start construction of the first of four small modular reactors planned at the Darlington New Nuclear Project site.

articles.title: Supplier contracts signed relating to KHNP Czech project
articles.summary: Nine contracts and three memorandums of understanding have been signed between South Korean and Czech companies relating to the proposed new nuclear capacity planned at Dukovany.

articles.title: Installation begins of overhead crane at BREST-OD-300
articles.summary: The 223.5-tonne crane is being installed in the turbine hall of the BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast neutron reactor at the Siberian Chemical Combine site in Seversk, in the Tomsk Region of Russia.

articles.title: Chinese Candu reactor sets operating records
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Qinshan Phase III nuclear power plant near Shanghai in China's Zhejiang province was taken offline on 1 May after 738 days of continuous operation. It has set a new record for the longest uninterrupted operation of a power reactor in China as well as a world record for an operating run for a Candu-6 reactor.

articles.title: EDF court injunction blocks Czech-KHNP contract signing
articles.summary: A regional court in the Czech Republic has issued a preliminary injunction prohibiting Wednesday's expected signing of a contract with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power for the construction of new nuclear units at Dukovany nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Pilot non-nuclear SMR plant to be built in Finnish coal-fired plant
articles.summary: Finnish small modular reactor developer Steady Energy is to build a non-nuclear pilot facility at the decommissioned Salmisaari B coal power station in central Helsinki to demonstrate the maturity and safety of its LDR-50 reactor for district heating.

articles.title: Expansion of Garoña used fuel store approved
articles.summary: Spain's nuclear regulator has approved an expansion of the on-site interim dry storage facility for used fuel at the Garoña nuclear power plant, which shut down in 2012. The expansion is required to accommodate all the fuel storage needs of the plant during its decommissioning.

articles.title: New agreements put Utah at heart of regional SMR ecosystem
articles.summary: As the governors of Utah, Idaho, and Wyoming sign a cooperation agreement towards building a regional "energy corridor" underpinned by advanced nuclear technology, small modular reactor developer Holtec International has signed a tripartite cooperation agreement to support its plans for the deployment of SMR-300s in Utah and the broader Mountain West region.

articles.title: Agreement waiver to enable INL to receive used fuel
articles.summary: The State of Idaho and the US Department of Energy have signed a targeted waiver of the 1995 Settlement Agreement, allowing Idaho National Laboratory to bring in a high-burnup nuclear fuel cask and limited amounts of used fuel from US university research reactors.

articles.title: Nordic Investment Bank to help finance Olkiluoto upgrades
articles.summary: Finnish utility Teollisuuden Voima Oyj has signed a EUR75 million (USD85 million) loan agreement with the Nordic Investment Bank to finance safety upgrades at units 1 and 2 of the Olkiluoto nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Regulator agrees Japan's Tomari 3 meets safety requirements
articles.summary: The Nuclear Regulation Authority has approved a draft report that concludes unit 3 of the Tomari nuclear power plant on Japan's northern Hokkaido island meets the new regulatory safety standards, a prerequisite for its restart.

links.label: a draft of the review document

articles.title: Separation of Doel 3 used fuel pool waste begins
articles.summary: The first container has been filled with long-lived low- and intermediate-level waste from the used fuel pools of unit 3 at Belgium's Doel nuclear power plant, which was shut down in September 2022 and is now being decommissioned.

articles.title: Partnership to accelerate development of Blykalla SMR
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla and Norway's Institute of Energy Technology have entered into a strategic collaboration to accelerate the technical development of Blykalla's SEALER reactor.

articles.title: Beloyarsk issued with licence for BN-1200 reactor
articles.summary: Russia's nuclear regulator Rostechnadzor has given the go-ahead for the Beloyarsk nuclear power plant's planned fifth unit - a fast neutron BN-1200 reactor. Preparatory construction works are expected to start this year.

articles.title: Agreement signed to continue work on Polish project
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe and the Westinghouse-Bechtel Consortium have signed the recently-agreed Engineering Development Agreement, which ensures the continuity of the implementation of Poland's first nuclear power plant project.

articles.title: Ten new reactors approved in China
articles.summary: China's State Council approved five nuclear power projects involving ten reactors, including eight Hualong One units.

articles.title: Project development firm created for Norwegian SMR plant
articles.summary: A new company, Trondheimsleia Kjernekraft AS, has been founded in partnership between the future host municipalities of Aure and Heim, local energy company NEAS and Norsk Kjernekraft to develop a power plant based on multiple small modular reactors.

articles.title: What might an SMR look like in Minecraft?
articles.summary: Slovakia's Slovenské elektrárne has announced the results of a contest for school students to build small modular reactors in the Minecraft video game world.

articles.title: EPC contract awarded for Indian reactors
articles.summary: NPCIL selected Megha Engineering & Infrastructure for an engineering and construction contract on Kaiga 5 and 6.

articles.title: US companies reapply for USD800 million SMR fund
articles.summary: A Tennessee Valley Authority-led coalition including BWRX-300 developer GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy has submitted an application for the revised federal funding to support the US deployment of small modular reactors. Holtec has also announced its application to the USD800 million programme.

articles.title: US uranium enrichment startup emerges from stealth
articles.summary: General Matter says it will use a novel, scalable, cost-competitive technology to address a "commercial bottleneck" in the US nuclear fuel cycle and will be shipping enriched uranium by the end of the decade.

links.label: Information submitted to the NRC alongside…

articles.title: Owner's engineer sought for UK SMR projects
articles.summary: Great British Nuclear, the arms-length body set up to oversee the UK's plans for new nuclear, is to launch a tender to procure up to two owner's engineers as part of its small modular reactor programme.

articles.title: US regulator approves microreactor fuel qualification methodology
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued its final safety evaluation approving the Fuel Qualification Methodology Topical Report for the advanced fuel design to be used in NANO Nuclear Energy Inc's KRONOS micro modular reactor energy system.

articles.title: Belarus nuclear plant could switch to longer fuel cycle
articles.summary: Russia's nuclear fuel company TVEL has said it is ready to work with Belarus to extend the time between fuel reloading at the country's first nuclear power plant to 18-24 months.

links.label: it has a number of pilot and trials in place

articles.title: Reconstruction of Italian waste store begins
articles.summary: Work has started to demolish and subsequently reconstruct an interim storage facility for low-level radioactive waste at the Caorso nuclear power plant site. The new facility will meet the most recent safety standards required by industry regulations and legislation.

articles.title: Framatome opens new fuel fabrication facility
articles.summary: Framatome has inaugurated a new workshop at its site in Romans-sur-Isère in the Drôme department of southeastern France, dedicated to the fabrication of fuel for research reactors and targets for medical isotopes.

articles.title: TVA to submit SMR construction permit application
articles.summary: The Tennessee Valley Authority intends to submit the Construction Permit Application for the Clinch River small modular reactor to the US regulator by June.

articles.title: Korean-led consortium awarded US research reactor contract
articles.summary: A consortium led by the Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute has been awarded a USD10 million contract by the University of Missouri for the design and licensing of its planned new research reactor.

articles.title: TerraPower begins UK design assessment process
articles.summary: TerraPower has formally notified UK regulators that it plans to begin the generic design approval process for its Natrium sodium-cooled fast reactor, a first step towards deploying the technology in an international market.

articles.title: First main pump installed in Chinese SMR
articles.summary: The first of four main pumps has been installed at the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project, under construction at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Uzbekistan SMR project sees start of auxiliary buildings construction
articles.summary: Preparatory work on the buildings required to support construction and administration of the planned small modular reactor project in the Jizzakh region of Uzbekistan has begun.

articles.title: Third tender submitted in UK SMR selection process
articles.summary: Holtec has announced that it has submitted its final tender response to Great British Nuclear as part of the UK's ongoing small modular reactor technology selection competition. GE Hitachi and Rolls-Royce SMR earlier confirmed they had submitted final tenders.

articles.title: Kazatomprom signs uranium supply deal with ČEZ
articles.summary: A seven-year agreement to supply natural uranium concentrate for the Czech Republic's ČEZ is described by Kazakhstan's Kazatomprom as "a significant expansion of its presence in Europe".

articles.title: Assembly of Lufeng 1 containment vessel starts
articles.summary: The bottom head of the containment vessel of unit 1 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant has been installed on the central raft foundation of the unit's nuclear island, China Nuclear Construction Corporation 22 announced.

articles.title: Westinghouse's LEU+ fuel loaded into Vogtle 2
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company's lead test assemblies with LEU+ fuel have been loaded into Unit 2 of the Vogtle nuclear power plant - a first for such fuel in a commercial reactor in the USA.

links.label: Read More: A guide to uranium and the…

articles.title: First uranium product shipped from Dobrovolnoye deposit
articles.summary: JSC Dalur, part of Rosatom, has completed construction and commissioning of facilities at the pilot industrial site and shipped the first batch of uranium product from the Dobrovolnoye deposit in the Kurgan region of Russia.

links.label: Read More: A guide - Uranium and the nuclear…

articles.title: Tenders submitted in UK SMR selection process
articles.summary: Two of the four shortlisted small modular reactor vendors - GE Hitachi and Rolls-Royce SMR - have announced they have submitted their final tender responses as part of Great British Nuclear's ongoing SMR selection competition.

articles.title: Suppliers shortlisted for Kazakh nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Kazakhstan has officially shortlisted four reactor vendors for the country's first nuclear power plant following a "competitive dialogue process with potential technology suppliers".

articles.title: Proposal for Norwegian SMR power plant progresses
articles.summary: The Norwegian government has commissioned several agencies to develop an Environmental Impact Assessment programme for the proposed power plant based on multiple small modular reactors in the municipalities of Aure and Heim.

articles.title: 'Great opportunities ahead' for fuel cycle
articles.summary: It is a time of great opportunity for nuclear - but fuel cycle players must work together to seize the moment and make sure the fuel cycle is ready to support a global tripling of nuclear energy. This was the message from the opening session of the World Nuclear Fuel Cycle 2025 conference.

articles.title: DOE selects first recipients of HALEU
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has made conditional commitments to five advanced reactor developers to receive the first allocations of high-assay low-enriched uranium from its HALEU Availability Program.

articles.title: Production starts of Paks 6 reactor vessel
articles.summary: The forging of parts of the reactor pressure vessel for unit six of Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant - the second unit of the Paks II project - has begun in Russia.

articles.title: Invest now to secure long-term uranium future, Red Book says
articles.summary: The trend of declining uranium exploration and mine development expenditure has been reversed - but substantial investment in new mining projects will be essential to meet nuclear power generation projections to 2050 and beyond, according to the latest edition of the key OECD/IAEA joint report.

links.label: A guide: Uranium and the nuclear fuel cycle

articles.title: ČEZ selects Amentum to support SMR programme
articles.summary: US-based engineering company Amentum has been selected by Czech utility ČEZ to support its new nuclear programme by advancing plans for two small modular reactors.

articles.title: UK government provides funding for fusion development
articles.summary: The UK government has announced GBP20 million (USD25.5 million) to kickstart Starmaker One – a British private fusion investment fund that it says will help fusion businesses and start-ups in the sector grow and commercialise at scale.

articles.title: A guide: Uranium and the nuclear fuel cycle
articles.summary: The nuclear fuel cycle is the series of industrial processes that turns uranium into electricity. Claire Maden takes a look at the steps that make up the cycle, the major players and the potential pinch-points.

articles.title: Canadian regulator issues SMR construction licence
articles.summary: The Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission has announced its decision to authorise Ontario Power Generation to construct a BWRX-300 reactor at the Darlington New Nuclear Project site in Clarington, Ontario.

articles.title: Assembly starts of SPARC, as ITER cryopumps completed
articles.summary: US private fusion company Commonwealth Fusion Systems has installed the disc-shaped stainless steel cryostat base, marking the start of the assembly of the SPARC tokamak. Meanwhile, Fusion for Energy has completed the manufacture of the eight torus and cryostat cryopumps for the ITER tokamak.

articles.title: Zaporizhzhia restart timetable suggested, Ukraine rejects plan
articles.summary: Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant has been under Russian military control since March 2022 and its director has said he expects Russian licences for operation of all units to be obtained by the end of 2027. Ukraine's Energoatom says any talk of restarting the units is a violation of nuclear and radiation safety standards.

articles.title: US uranium production reaches six-year high
articles.summary: Last year saw the highest US production of uranium concentrate since 2018, spurred by a sustained period of higher uranium prices, according to the US Energy Information Administration.

articles.title: Agreement to build microreactor on US university site
articles.summary: US microreactor technology company NANO Nuclear Energy Inc has signed a strategic collaboration agreement with the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign to construct the first research KRONOS micro modular reactor on the university's campus.

articles.title: Teaming agreement signed for Estonian SMR project
articles.summary: Estonia's Fermi Energia and South Korea's Samsung C&T Corporation Engineering & Construction Group have signed a teaming agreement to collaborate on the deployment of two BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Estonia.

articles.title: New agreement enables continued development of Polish plant
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe and the Westinghouse-Bechtel Consortium have agreed the terms and conditions of an Engineering Development Agreement for Poland's first nuclear power plant after a previous agreement expired.

articles.title: Eletronuclear used fuel storage unit gets extended licence
articles.summary: Brazil's National Nuclear Energy Commission has given an extendable 40-year authorisation for the operation of the Complementary Dry Storage Unit for Spent Fuel at the Angra nuclear power plant site.

articles.title: Beloyarsk BN-600 fast neutron reactor gets 15-year extension
articles.summary: Russian nuclear regulator Rostekhnadzor has approved a 15-year life extension to 2040 for the Beloyarsk nuclear power plant's unit 3, a BN-600 fast neutron reactor.

articles.title: Italian government eyes investment in Newcleo
articles.summary: Innovative reactor developer Newcleo said it has "deep appreciation" for the Italian government's "strategic interest and support for the company" after two ministers said the government plans to invest in the company as part of the country's reintroduction of nuclear energy.

articles.title: Pre-licensing milestone for eVinci
articles.summary: US Nuclear Regulatory Commission approval of the Principal Design Criteria Topical Report is a key milestone towards licensing Westinghouse's eVinci microreactor in the USA.

articles.title: Application lodged for construction of Texas SMR plant
articles.summary: Industrial giant Dow and X-Energy Reactor Company have submitted a construction licence application to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for the proposed advanced nuclear project at Dow's Seadrift site in Texas.

articles.title: First main pump for Chinese SMR shipped
articles.summary: The first of four main pumps for China's ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project has passed factory acceptance tests and been shipped to the construction site at the Changjiang on the island province of Hainan.

articles.title: President signs bill on funding for Polish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: President Andrzej Duda has signed a bill that designates funds from the national budget for the construction of Poland's first nuclear power plant. Under the bill, Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe is set to receive PLN60.2 billion (USD15.5 billion) in public funding between 2025 and 2030.

articles.title: Minister announces funds for new reactor as Safari-1 turns 60
articles.summary: As South Africa's Safari-1 research reactor marks its 60th anniversary, Minister of Electricity and Energy Kgosientso Ramokgopa has announced a budget allocation of ZAR1.2 billion (USD66 million) towards a new multipurpose reactor at Pelindaba.

articles.title: German nuclear association calls for restart of reactors
articles.summary: German nuclear technology association Kerntechnik Deutschland e.V. says that restarting the country's nuclear power plants "offers a safe, economically viable and climate-friendly alternative to the current energy policy". It says that up to six shut down reactors could technically resume operation.

articles.title: Proposed reactor designs 'seem suitable', Dutch regulator concludes
articles.summary: A review of the feasibility studies submitted by EDF, Westinghouse and Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power for two new reactors in the Netherlands suggests that all three designs would meet necessary safety requirements, the country's nuclear regulator announced. Last week, KHNP indicated it is withdrawing from the technology selection process.

articles.title: Eighth NuScale SMR simulator opened
articles.summary: NuScale Power Corporation has announced the opening of an Energy Exploration Centre at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in Troy, New York. The centre will augment undergraduate courses through the integration of hands-on experiences that complement theoretical concepts.

articles.title: Uprated Chinese reactor returns to grid
articles.summary: Unit 2 of Phase II of the Qinshan nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province has been reconnected to the grid following a refuelling and maintenance outage during which the unit's net electrical power has been increased by 33 MW.

articles.title: US DOE re-issues SMR funding solicitation
articles.summary: The USD900 million solicitation to support the deployment of small modular reactors has been re-issued to better align with President Donald Trump's agenda on unleashing American energy and AI dominance, the Department of Energy said.

articles.title: Namibian parliament makes uranium exploration recommendation
articles.summary: Rosatom's Namibian operating company said it "acknowledges and appreciates" a recommendation that uranium exploration activities at the Wings in-situ recovery uranium project should continue.

articles.title: NANO reactor core block ready for testing
articles.summary: NANO Nuclear Energy Inc has assembled the first reactor core hardware of its ZEUS solid core battery reactor for initial non-nuclear testing.

articles.title: Hot hydro testing begins at Mochovce 4
articles.summary: Slovenské elektrárne has launched the hot hydro testing of Mochovce unit 4, following the completion of cold hydro tests.

articles.title: SMR developers engage with US regulators
articles.summary: Oklo Inc and Deep Atomic Inc are embarking on pre-application engagements with US nuclear regulators for their respective projects: Oklo Inc is engaging with the regulator ahead of an application to construct and operate an Aurora Powerhouse at Idaho National Laboratory, while Deep Atomic is planning to apply for design certification of its MK60 small modular…

articles.title: NRG-Pallas to test fuel and materials for Kairos SMR
articles.summary: NRG-Pallas - operator of the High Flux Reactor at Petten in the Netherlands - has been contracted by Kairos Power of the USA to perform irradiation demonstrations and qualifications of fuels and materials that will be used in its small modular reactor.

articles.title: Reactor vessel assembled for El Dabaa's first unit
articles.summary: The 10-day process has been completed of welding the closing seam of the reactor vessel being manufactured for the first unit at Egypt's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: IAEA will support Zaporizhzhia, whatever agreement is reached
articles.summary: International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi says they "stand ready" to support the implementation of any future agreement regarding Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant, after its status was included in ceasefire talks.

articles.title: Finnish university to test safety of SMR designs
articles.summary: Finland's Lappeenranta-Lahti University of Technology is to build two new test facilities at its nuclear engineering laboratory on its Lappeenranta campus for research into the safety of small modular reactors.

articles.title: Urenco to supply fuel for Westinghouse microreactor
articles.summary: Westinghouse and Urenco have signed a long-term fuel enrichment agreement under which Urenco will provide enrichment of high-assay low-enriched uranium to Westinghouse for five years of deployment for the company's eVinci microreactor.

articles.title: KHNP pulls out of Dutch reactor project
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power is withdrawing from the technology selection process for two new reactors at the Borssele nuclear power plant site in the Netherlands. It follows the company's recent withdrawal from similar reactor selection processes in Sweden and Slovenia.

articles.title: Fresh stage of tests for VVER-S and MOX fuel
articles.summary: Russia's A.I. Leypunsky Institute of Physics and Power Engineering has begun tests to study the neutron-physical characteristics of the VVER-S reactor with MOX fuel.

articles.title: Deal finalised for Belgian reactor restarts in November
articles.summary: The Belgian government and French utility Engie have closed the agreement covering the extension of the operation of the Tihange 3 and Doel 4 nuclear power reactors by 10 years and on all obligations related to radioactive waste.

articles.title: Dismantling of Hamaoka 2 reactor starts
articles.summary: Japanese utility Chubu Electric Power Company announced it has removed the upper lid of the pressure vessel of unit 2 at its Hamaoka nuclear power plant in Shizuoka prefecture as it begins to dismantle the reactor. It becomes the first commercial power reactor in Japan to enter dismantling.

articles.title: India welcomes newest Rajasthan unit to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 7 at the Rajasthan Atomic Power Project is the third 700 MWe indigenous pressurised heavy water reactor to be connected to the Indian grid.

articles.title: UK government-funded project milestone for borehole disposal
articles.summary: A multi-year project in collaboration with the UK Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre (AMRC), NAC International, Inc, and the University of Sheffield has culminated in the manufacture of a first-of-its-kind disposal canister prototype and elevated Deep Isolation's technology readiness level.

articles.title: Lukashenko wants second Russian nuclear power plant in Belarus
articles.summary: Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko said the country had "asked the Russians, if possible, to build a second power plant", according to the official Belta news agency's report on a speech made to the Federation Council during his official visit to Russia.

articles.title: INB signs contract with Internexco GmbH for conversion and enrichment of uranium
articles.summary: Indústrias Nucleares do Brasil has signed a contract with Russia's Internexco for the temporary export for conversion and enrichment of 275,000 kilograms of uranium concentrate (U3O8) produced at the Uranium Concentration Unit in Caetité, Bahia.

articles.title: Ukraine's president signs law to facilitate the purchase of Belene equipment
articles.summary: The two part-built units at the Khmelnitsky nuclear power plant could be finished with unused equipment from Bulgaria's discontinued Belene nuclear power plant project, with President Volodymyr Zelensky signing into law the legal framework for the acquisition.

articles.title: First fast reactor fuel safety tests in decades carried out at INL
articles.summary: Tests carried out on high burnup fast reactor fuel as part of a collaboration between the USA and Japan are the first of their kind carried out in more than 20 years, and will provide crucial new data to support future fuel development and qualification.

articles.title: Newcleo plans fuel development centre
articles.summary: Innovative reactor developer Newcleo has acquired a site in Chusclan in the Gard department in southern France on which it will build an R&D innovation and training centre supporting the development of its future fuel assembly manufacturing facility in France.

articles.title: Dutch province considers SMR deployment
articles.summary: A study by NRG-Pallas has identified four regions in the Dutch province of Gelderland as suitable for hosting a small modular reactor. The province aims to designate two locations for an SMR in 2027.

articles.title: Westinghouse, Enusa extend partnership agreement
articles.summary: Westinghouse and Spanish nuclear fuel manufacturer Enusa, which are celebrating 50 years of cooperation, have signed a new technology agreement that extends the current licensing agreement for 10 years.

articles.title: Grid connections in Turkey and Bangladesh among Rosatom's 2025 priorities
articles.summary: The director general of Russian state nuclear corporation Rosatom has said that generating the first kilowatt-hours from the new nuclear power plants in Turkey and Bangladesh - plus pouring first concrete for Leningrad II's fourth unit and putting the first new Kursk unit into commercial operation - are priorities for the current year.

articles.title: New funding to advance Thorizon molten salt reactor development
articles.summary: Thorizon of the Netherlands announced it has secured EUR20 million (USD22 million) in funding to accelerate the development of its advanced small modular molten salt reactor, Thorizon One. It said the funding will be used to advance prototyping, licensing and demonstration of Thorizon One's cartridge fuel system.

articles.title: Minister updates parliament on Indian SMR project
articles.summary: The first two lead units of a 55 MW variant of the Bharat small modular reactor will be built at a Department of Atomic Energy site by 2033, Minister of State Jitendra Singh has told parliamentarians.

articles.title: HD Hyundai to help commercialise TerraPower SMR
articles.summary: TerraPower has announced a strategic collaboration with South Korean conglomerate HD Hyundai to expand the global manufacturing supply chain for Natrium small modular reactors, supporting the rapid commercialisation of the advanced nuclear technology.

articles.title: Contracts signed for first two Bailong units
articles.summary: A total of nine major contracts have been signed for the construction of units 1 and 2 of the Bailong nuclear power plant in China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, the Shanghai Nuclear Engineering Research and Design Institute announced.

articles.title: EU funding for French enrichment plant expansion
articles.summary: The European Investment Bank and Orano have signed a loan agreement for EUR400 million (USD434 million) to partly fund the project to extend the Georges Besse II uranium enrichment plant in Tricastin in southern France. The project will increase the plant's capacity by more than 30%.

articles.title: Jordan sees uranium as key for sustainable growth
articles.summary: Jordan is working on a feasibility study that will support its efforts to secure funding for commercial-scale uranium mining, according to the head of the Jordan Atomic Energy Commission's investment arm.

links.label: an interview with The Jordan Times

articles.title: UKAEA, Eni partner for tritium fuel cycle facility
articles.summary: The United Kingdom Atomic Energy Authority and Italian multinational energy company Eni SpA have entered into a collaboration agreement to jointly conduct research and development activities in the field of fusion energy. The collaboration primarily starts with the construction of the world's largest and most advanced tritium fuel cycle facility.

articles.title: Commissioning milestone for WIPP ventilation facility
articles.summary: The new, state-of-the-art, large-scale ventilation system at the USA's repository for the disposal of transuranic waste has now been fully commissioned and is expected to be fully operational later this year.

articles.title: KHNP to collaborate with Kazakhstan on uranium research
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed two agreements to collaborate with Kazakhstan on the utilisation of uranium resources dissolved in seawater and groundwater.

articles.title: Orano and Energoatom sign enrichment services agreement
articles.summary: France's Orano has signed an agreement to supply enrichment services for Ukraine's Energoatom through to 2040.

articles.title: Myanmar and Russia sign SMR cooperation agreement
articles.summary: An intergovernmental agreement signed during a state visit to Russia covers cooperation on the development of a 110 MW small modular reactor project in Myanmar.

articles.title: Amentum awarded Sizewell C project management contract
articles.summary: US-based engineering company Amentum has been selected as sole programme and project management delivery partner for the planned Sizewell C nuclear power plant in the UK.

articles.title: Thorcon applies to build Indonesia's first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: PT Thorcon Power Indonesia has submitted documents to Indonesia's nuclear regulator, initiating the licensing process for the construction of a power plant based on its advanced molten salt reactor technology. A site at Kelasa Island, located in Central Bangka, is being investigated to host the plant.

articles.title: ANSTO begins decommissioning Australia's first reactor
articles.summary: Work has started on the first stage of decommissioning HIFAR, Australia's first nuclear reactor, which shut down in 2007 after nearly 50 years in operation.

articles.title: Dutch province provides funding for MSR development
articles.summary: The province of Noord-Brabant in the south of the Netherlands announced it will invest EUR4 million (USD4.2 million) in the further development of molten salt reactors.

articles.title: Court rules Oyster Creek fuel storage casks are permanent
articles.summary: A New Jersey court has ruled that used nuclear fuel storage casks at the former Oyster Creek nuclear power plant are permanent fixtures and therefore taxable as real estate property.

articles.title: Three Mile Island restart project 'ahead of schedule'
articles.summary: Constellation reported early progress on preparations to restart Three Mile Island 1, renamed the Crane Clean Energy Center, under its Microsoft power deal.

articles.title: Siemens Energy to supply turbines for Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR of the UK has selected Germany-based energy technology company Siemens Energy as its global turbine systems partner for its small modular reactor. The final contract, detailing all specifics, is expected to be completed by the end of 2025.

articles.title: UK's SMR selection process 'into final stage'
articles.summary: GE Hitachi, Holtec, Rolls-Royce SMR and Westinghouse have been issued with an Invitation to Submit Final Tenders, with Great British Nuclear saying it remains on track to select the chosen technology before the summer.
