articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at first Lianjiang unit
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 1 of the Lianjiang nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It will be one of two CAP1000 reactors planned for the first phase of the plant.

articles.title: Last Energy plans Texan microreactor plant
articles.summary: US microreactor developer Last Energy has announced plans to construct 30 microreactors in Haskell County in northwest Texas to serve American data centre customers across the state.

articles.title: Bruce 4 defuelled in record time
articles.summary: The unit's 5,761 fuel bundles were removed in just 24 days, making it the most efficient Candu reactor defuel ever, according to Bruce Power.

articles.title: Seaborg 'ready to start licensing activities in South Korea'
articles.summary: Denmark's floating compact molten salt reactor developer Seaborg Technologies has raised DKK200 million (USD28 million) from existing investors and appointed a new chairman, and said it is now planning for its first reactor to be ready in the first half of the 2030s.

articles.title: Transport disruptions reflected in Energy Fuels' 2024 output
articles.summary: US uranium producer Energy Fuels' 2024 output was affected by the suspension of ore transports from the Pinyon Plain Mine in northern Arizona to the White Mesa Mill in southern Utah from early August until February.

articles.title: Chernobyl shelter fire still smouldering two weeks after drone strike
articles.summary: More than 400 people have been working in shifts since the damage was caused to the giant shelter structure covering the area of Chernobyl's unit 4. International Atomic Energy Agency experts report that radiation levels remain normal.

articles.title: Curtiss-Wright wins Natrium contracts
articles.summary: Curtiss-Wright Corporation has been awarded two contracts to design and supply plant simulation and digital control solutions for TerraPower's Natrium advanced nuclear reactor.

articles.title: Holtec and Hyundai E&C target 10 GW SMR fleet after Palisades
articles.summary: Holtec International has officially launched its Mission 2030 project for two of its small modular reactors at the Palisades site in Michigan - and signed an expanded construction agreement with South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction.

articles.title: Kazakhstan nuclear power plant project moving ahead
articles.summary: The Zhambyl district of Almaty region has been selected by the Kazakhstan government as the location for its proposed nuclear power plant, with ministers saying the aim is to select a technology supplier this year.

articles.title: Nordic partnership for SEALER SMR deployment
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla and Norwegian nuclear project developer Norsk Kjernekraft have signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate on the deployment of Blykalla's SEALER in Scandinavia.

articles.title: Niger grants permit for Moradi uranium mine
articles.summary: A draft decree adopted by Niger's Council of Ministers grants Niger-owned Compagnie Minière de Recherche et d'Exploitation (COMIREX SA) a permit for the Moradi uranium mine.

articles.title: Ceremony to mark start of Brazilian Multipurpose Reactor infrastructure works
articles.summary: Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation, Luciana Santos, was present for a ceremony to mark the start of infrastructure works for the construction of the Brazilian Multipurpose Reactor in Iperó.

articles.title: Construction starts on Lufeng unit 1
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 1 at the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It is the third unit to begin construction at the site, which will eventually house six reactors.

articles.title: Another Swedish municipality named as SMR candidate site
articles.summary: Kärnfull Next announced it will conduct feasibility studies on hosting small modular reactor power plants at two properties located in Karlshamn municipality in Blekinge county, southern Sweden.

articles.title: Belgian nuclear extension financing plans approved by EU
articles.summary: The European Commission has concluded its in-depth investigation and approved revised plans for Belgium's proposed financing of the lifetime extensions of Doel 4 and Tihange 3 nuclear power units.

articles.title: Western Australians support lifting uranium ban, poll finds
articles.summary: With a new poll showing that the majority of West Australians support lifting the state's ban on uranium mining, Australia's national mining association is calling on the state's Labor Party to let voters know if it would consider overturning the ban if it retains power in the upcoming general election.

articles.title: Milestone for Wyoming uranium operation
articles.summary: Uranium Energy Corp's Irigaray Central Processing Plant has produced its first dried and drummed uranium concentrates since the resumption of in-situ recovery operations at the company's Christensen Ranch project.

articles.title: European partnerships for fast reactor development
articles.summary: France's Hexana has formed a strategic partnership with Belgian engineering firm Tractebel to support the development of its sodium-cooled fast neutron reactor energy platform. Meanwhile, Swedish and French lead-cooled fast reactors developers Blykalla and Newcleo are to jointly research and develop materials for such reactors.

articles.title: Nova Scotia bill proposes lifting uranium exploration ban
articles.summary: Legislation has been introduced in the parliament of Nova Scotia calling for the end of a ban on uranium exploration and mining in the Canadian province. However, if passed, it would only allow government research on uranium resources within the province.

articles.title: Kazakhstan, Jordan team up for uranium studies
articles.summary: Kazakhstan's national atomic company Kazatomprom has signed a memorandum of understanding and cooperation with Jordan Uranium Mining Company.

articles.title: Texas partnership evaluates SMR use for water desalination
articles.summary: Natura Resources has entered into a memorandum of understanding with Texas Tech University and Abilene Christian University to evaluate integrating Natura's molten salt small modular reactor technology with water desalination systems.

articles.title: Bolivia's first nuclear research reactor hosts IAEA mission
articles.summary: A team of International Atomic Energy Agency experts has visited the RB-01 research reactor under construction in Bolivia to verify agency safety standards are being followed, and to recommend further measures.

articles.title: Kärnfull Next progresses with Swedish SMR project
articles.summary: Small modular reactor project development company Kärnfull Next has secured land rights for the project to build a power plant based on SMRs in the municipality of Valdemarsvik in Östergötland county in southeastern Sweden.

articles.title: Reactor pressure vessel delivered for Lianjiang 1
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel for unit 1 of the Lianjiang nuclear power plant has arrived at the construction site in China's Guangdong province. It will be the first of two CAP1000 reactors planned for the first phase of the plant.

articles.title: Belgium retires oldest nuclear power reactor
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Doel nuclear power plant has been taken offline for the final time after 50 years of operation and disconnected from the grid. Its closure is in line with Belgium's 2003 nuclear phase-out policy, under which two other reactors have already been shut down.

articles.title: Swiss nuclear plants to be fuelled by Kazakh uranium
articles.summary: Kazakhstan's national atomic company Kazatomprom has signed its first-ever contract to supply uranium to Swiss nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Newcleo seeks to buy land for demonstration SMR
articles.summary: Innovative reactor developer Newcleo announced it has started the land acquisition process for its demonstration LFR-AS-30 small modular reactor in Indre-et-Loire in the Chinon Vienne et Loire community of municipalities in western France.

articles.title: Studies continue into SMR deployment in Lund
articles.summary: A new company is being established to further investigate the possibility of establishing a nuclear power plant based on small modular reactors in the municipality of Lund in the southern Norwegian county of Rogaland.

articles.title: Proposal to reverse Spain's nuclear phase-out approved by parliament
articles.summary: The Plenary Session of the Spanish Congress has approved a proposal calling for the government to implement a series of measures that would reverse the country's decision to phase out nuclear power. Under current plans, Spain's power reactors are all scheduled to shut by 2035.

articles.title: Milestone for metallic fuel fabrication
articles.summary: Lightbridge Corporation has hailed the co-extrusion demonstration of a coupon sample with uranium-zirconium alloy and cladding at Idaho National Laboratory as a significant milestone in the development of its innovative next-generation nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Korean SMR-powered container ship design revealed
articles.summary: South Korea's HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering has unveiled a nuclear-powered container ship model utilising small modular reactor technology.

articles.title: French-Japanese MOX fuel recycling studies expanded
articles.summary: Japan's Federation of Electric Power Companies has announced that a total of 400 tonnes of used nuclear fuel, instead of the originally planned 200 tonnes, will now be transported to Orano in France for research on the reprocessing of used mixed oxide fuel.

articles.title: Ukraine's parliament approves reactor equipment purchase from Bulgaria
articles.summary: Ukraine's parliament, the Verkhovna Rada, has backed the plan to purchase unused equipment from Bulgaria's cancelled Belene nuclear power plant project to complete Khmelnitsky nuclear power plant's units 3 and 4.

articles.title: India and France sign SMR and AMR partnership letter of intent
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron and India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi have agreed a Declaration of Intent for establishing a partnership on advanced modular reactors and small modular reactors after talks in France. They also visited the multinational ITER nuclear fusion project.

articles.title: Progress in environmental permitting of Polish SMR projects
articles.summary: Orlen Synthos Green Energy can begin environmental and siting research for its planned small modular reactor projects in Włocławek and Ostrołęka after Poland's General Director for Environmental Protection issued the scope of the environmental reports for the projects.

articles.title: Centrus CEO eyes fuel cycle 'void'
articles.summary: The US uranium enrichment company is uniquely positioned to deliver a "made-in-America solution" to fill an approaching "void" in nuclear fuel supplies as momentum builds in the nuclear industry, Centrus President and CEO Amir Vexler said in the company's 2024 results announcement.

articles.title: Brazil's INB gets approval to seek export of enriched uranium
articles.summary: The National Nuclear Energy Commission has given authorisation for Indústrias Nucleares do Brasil to seek an international buyer for 5.7 tonnes of U3O8 enriched to 3.2% uranium-235.

articles.title: EU project seeks to develop new research reactor fuel
articles.summary: A new European research project, named EU-CONVERSION, has been launched with the aim of accelerating the conversion of high-performance research reactors by testing candidate low-enriched uranium fissile materials.

articles.title: Vietnam looks to accelerate construction of nuclear power plants
articles.summary: Vietnam's Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh has instructed two state-owned groups, Electricity of Vietnam and Vietnam Oil & Gas Group, to complete the construction of two nuclear power plants in Ninh Thuan province by the end of 2030.

articles.title: Dismantling of Swedish reactors reaches milestone
articles.summary: The dismantling of a reactor pressure vessel at the Oskarshamn nuclear power plant marks the completion of a project to dismantle the RPVs of four decommissioned reactors in Sweden.

articles.title: Centrus awarded Korean contract for enriched uranium
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a 10-year enriched uranium supply contract with US-based nuclear fuel supplier Centrus Energy Corporation. The contract follows the signing of a Letter of Intent a year ago.

articles.title: Four SMR developers aim to build reactors at Texas A&M University site
articles.summary: Kairos Power, Natura Resources, Terrestrial Energy and Aalo Atomics have signed agreements to bring their reactors to Texas A&M-RELLIS, a 2400-acre technology campus in Bryan in Texas in the USA.

articles.title: Third Bruce unit begins refurbishment
articles.summary: The start of the Major Component Replacement outage at Bruce 4 marks the middle of the project to renew six units as part of Bruce Power's plan to extend the operating life of the Ontario plant.

articles.title: Briefing: The SMR Regulators’ Forum
articles.summary: The introduction of regulatory regimes focused on small modular reactors is something many countries are wrestling with. It is something that the SMR Regulators' Forum was set up to help with, as this World Nuclear News Briefing on its history and work explains.

articles.title: Blykalla starts work on non-nuclear prototype SMR
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla has broken ground for the construction of an electrical small modular reactor pilot facility near Oskarshamn to test proof of concept of its SEALER technology.

articles.title: Kairos Power fabricates and installs test unit reactor vessel
articles.summary: The central component for the second-iteration test unit for Kairos Power's Hermes reactor is the first reactor vessel to be fabricated in-house at Kairos Power’s Manufacturing Development Campus in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

articles.title: GE Vernova to invest in North Carolina fuel operations
articles.summary: GE Vernova has announced plans to invest more than USD50 million in GE Hitachi's Wilmington site in North Carolina as part of USD600 million of investments across its US factories and facilities over the next two years.

articles.title: Partnership to promote nuclear projects in Norway
articles.summary: Nuclear project developer Norsk Kjernekraft has signed a letter of intent with Nordic consultancy company Norconsult to promote the development of nuclear power in Norway. The partners said their cooperation could "result in concrete projects".

articles.title: Sizewell C reports project progress to parliament
articles.summary: The Sizewell C nuclear power plant project in the UK is "on time and on budget" and is "the best prepared nuclear project in modern nuclear history", MPs have been told in the first annual progress update on the project.

articles.title: Landmark agreement clears way for restart of uranium transport
articles.summary: Energy Fuels Inc expects shipments of ore from its Pinyon Plain Mine in northern Arizona to the White Mesa Mill in southern Utah will restart in February following the signature of an agreement with Navajo agencies on the transport of uranium ore along federal and state highways crossing the Navajo Nation.

links.label: According to the US Environmental Protection…

articles.title: Höganäs to help Blykalla develop materials for SMR
articles.summary: Lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla has announced a strategic partnership with Swedish powdered metal producer Höganäs to develop specialised materials and manufacturing processes for Blykalla's SEALER technology.

articles.title: Westinghouse and EDF in running for Slovenia unit, KHNP not bidding
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company and EDF are each to conduct a Technical Feasibility Study for GEN energija assessing the deployment of their reactors at the proposed new nuclear power plant next to the existing Krško site.

articles.title: UK's search for geological disposal site narrows potential locations
articles.summary: Nuclear Waste Services says that it has selected areas for detailed studies of suitability within each of the three communities involved in the process of selecting a site for the permanent deep burial of nuclear waste material.

articles.title: Core Power, Glosten team up to power US ports
articles.summary: Naval architecture and marine engineering consultancy Glosten has been commissioned by Core Power to develop the operational concept and design of a floating nuclear power plant to provide power to US ports.

articles.title: NextEra initiates regulatory process to restart Duane Arnold
articles.summary: NextEra Energy has filed a licensing change request for its Duane Arnold nuclear power plant in Iowa with the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission. This marks the first step toward seeking approval to restart the plant, which was taken out of service in 2020.

articles.title: Hungary's foreign minister sees SMR cooperation with UK
articles.summary: Hungarian Foreign Minister Péter Szijjártó has said strategic cooperation with the UK on nuclear energy has been launched, with a specific focus on small modular reactors.

articles.title: Canada, Poland sign nuclear energy cooperation agreement
articles.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau has concluded a trip to Warsaw, Poland, with the signing of an agreement on cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy.

articles.title: PULSAR consortium designs nuclear power system for lunar missions
articles.summary: The PULSAR research project, led by Belgian engineering firm Tractebel, has unveiled the conceptual design of a plutonium-238-fuelled radioisotope power system for lunar space missions.

articles.title: Major contracts awarded for OPG SMR and life extension projects
articles.summary: BWXT received major Canadian contracts involving the Darlington BWRX-300 reactor pressure vessel and Pickering steam generators.

articles.title: Lightbridge and Oklo aim to co-locate fuel fabrication facilities
articles.summary: Advanced nuclear fuel company Lightbridge and nuclear power plant developer Oklo have signed a memorandum of understanding for a feasibility study into co-locating their planned fuel fabrication facilities and to explore potential for collaboration in recycling nuclear waste.

articles.title: Second NuScale SMR steam generator tube contract for Alleima
articles.summary: Sweden's Alleima announced it has been awarded a second order from South Korea's Doosan Enerbility for approximately 200 kilometres of steam generator tubes for NuScale Power's small modular reactors.

articles.title: Feasibility results announced for Zambia uranium project
articles.summary: GoviEx Uranium is forecasting production from the Muntanga project in 2028, and envisages a quick start-up from shallow open-pit mining operations.

articles.title: Uranium production resumes at Inkai
articles.summary: Uranium production at the Kazatomprom-Cameco operation was suspended on 1 January but has now resumed, the joint venture partners have announced.

articles.title: TVA names contractors for Clinch River SMR project
articles.summary: The Tennessee Valley Authority's collaborative contractors Bechtel, Sargent & Lundy and GE Hitachi will use an integrated approach as they carry out initial planning for a potential small modular reactor at Clinch River in Tennessee.

articles.title: OPG awards major contract for Pickering refurbishment
articles.summary: Ontario Power Generation has awarded a contract for works associated with the refurbishment of four units at its Pickering plant to a joint venture of AtkinsRéalis company Candu Energy Inc and Aecon Group Inc.

articles.title: Czech minister says KHNP contract timetable still on track
articles.summary: Minister of Industry and Trade Lukáš Vlček said he had discussed with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power CEO Joo-ho Whang about finalising the EPC contract and the involvement of Czech companies in the country's new nuclear project.

articles.title: KHNP to cooperate with Scandinavian SMR project developers
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power announced it has signed memorandums of understanding on cooperation with Norway's Norsk Kjernekraft and Sweden's Kärnfull Next to "strengthen its foothold in the European market with its innovative SMR (i-SMR)".

articles.title: Expansion of test programme for MOX fuel for VVER reactors
articles.summary: The third cycle of tests of MOX fuel in the MIR research reactor is to begin following the successful completion of the second phase of the programme which aims to substantiate the safety of MOX fuel for use in VVER-type reactors.

articles.title: AECL, CNL gauge interest in use of small reactor designs
articles.summary: Atomic Energy of Canada Limited and Canadian Nuclear Laboratories have issued a Request for Expression of Interest to better understand market interest in licensing AECL's Slowpoke and Nuclear Battery reactor technologies for commercialisation opportunities.

articles.title: US companies join forces to accelerate SMR deployment
articles.summary: A TVA-led coalition including BWRX-300 developer GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy is applying for federal funding to support the US deployment of small modular reactors. Subsidiaries of American Electric Power are also seeking funding for the early stages of SMR development at sites in Indiana and Virginia.

articles.title: Investment agreement signed for Mongolian uranium project
articles.summary: The agreement between the Orano Group and the Mongolian government for the development and operation of the Zuuvch Ovoo uranium mine has been signed at a ceremony in Ulaanbaatar.

articles.title: Westinghouse reaches agreement on IP with Korean companies
articles.summary: Westinghouse, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power and Korea Electric Power Cooperation plan to collaborate on the deployment of new nuclear reactors around the world after agreeing to settle their intellectual property dispute.

articles.title: French-Italian collaboration on SMR deployment
articles.summary: France's EDF, its Italian subsidiary Edison and Italy's nuclear research organisation ENEA have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to collaborate on the industrial applications of small modular reactors.

articles.title: Funding aims to scale-up medical use of UK nuclear 'waste'
articles.summary: A project to develop the case for scaling-up the harvesting of lead-212 from reprocessed uranium for use in treating cancer has been selected for funding by UK Research and Innovation.

articles.title: Funding boost for UK fusion R&D
articles.summary: The UK government has announced a GBP410 million (USD500 million) investment to accelerate development of fusion energy. The announcement came as five construction and engineering consortiums have been shortlisted to build the country's STEP prototype fusion plant.

articles.title: Russia's floating nuclear power plant passes one billion kWh
articles.summary: The Akademik Lomonosov floating nuclear power plant in Russia's Arctic Chukotka region has generated its first billion kilowatt hours, as it approaches five years since entering commercial operation.

articles.title: Sweden breaks ground for used fuel repository
articles.summary: Ground work has begun for the construction of a final repository for used nuclear fuel in Forsmark, in Östhammar municipality, radioactive waste management company Svensk Kärnbränslehantering AB announced.

articles.title: Wyoming approves permit for demo Natrium plant
articles.summary: TerraPower has received approval from the Wyoming Industrial Siting Council on its permit for the Natrium demonstration plant near a retiring coal-fired plant at Kemmerer. The permit covers all construction and operational activities on the plant that are not under the jurisdiction of the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

articles.title: Reactor vessel shipped for Kudankulam's sixth unit
articles.summary: The 320-tonne VVER-1000 reactor vessel is travelling by sea from Russia to India's Kudankulam nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Fermi Energia kicks off SMR site selection process
articles.summary: Estonia's Fermi Energia has submitted an application to the country's Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications to begin the state spatial planning process for a 600 MW nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Partnership to develop pumps for Swedish SMR design
articles.summary: Lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla has signed a letter of intent with Swedish pump and valve manufacturer KSB to develop specialised pumps for Blykalla's SEALER technology.

articles.title: Angra 2 agreement targets radiopharmaceutical production
articles.summary: Operator Eletronuclear and the Brazilian Society of Nuclear Medicine have signed an agreement aimed at producing radioisotopes at Angra nuclear power plant's second unit.

articles.title: Lawsuit challenges NRC on SMR regulation
articles.summary: The States of Texas and Utah and microreactor developer Last Energy Inc are challenging the US regulator over its application of a rule it adopted in 1956 to small modular reactors and research and test reactors.

articles.title: Kazakh-China fuel plant reaches nameplate capacity
articles.summary: The Ulba-FA LLP fuel assembly plant, which produces nuclear fuel for Chinese nuclear power plants, has reached its design capacity of 200 tonnes of low-enriched uranium in the form of fuel assemblies.

articles.title: Permit granted for used fuel storage facility at El Dabaa nuclear plant
articles.summary: Egypt's Nuclear Power Plants Authority has been given the go ahead by the Nuclear and Radiological Regulatory Authority to establish a storage facility for used nuclear fuel at the El Dabaa nuclear power plant site.

articles.title: EDF simplifies Nuward SMR design
articles.summary: EDF subsidiary Nuward has relaunched the development of its small modular reactor after announcing last year that it planned to optimise the design.

articles.title: Site identified for proposed Halden SMR power plant
articles.summary: Norway's Halden Kjernekraft AS has entered into a letter of intent with the owner of a plot of land in Halden identified as a possible location for the construction of a nuclear power plant based on small modular reactors.

articles.title: BREST-OD-300 fuel fabrication facility begins pilot operation
articles.summary: The unit for fabrication/refabrication of nuclear fuel for the BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast neutron reactor has been put into pilot operation, Rosatom has announced.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at third Akkuyu unit
articles.summary: The assembly of the reactor has been completed at unit 3 of Turkey's Akkuyu nuclear power plant. Meanwhile, the fuel to be used in the second unit has also been delivered to the site.

articles.title: Constellation to supply US federal sector under record contract
articles.summary: The ten-year, USD840 million contract to supply electricity to federal facilities is the first-ever long-term multi-agency purchase of electricity by the US General Services Administration, and will support licence extensions and capacity uprates at Constellation's nuclear plants.

articles.title: Work starts on Taiwanese fuel storage facility
articles.summary: A groundbreaking ceremony has been held to mark the long-delayed start of construction of an outdoor dry storage facility for used nuclear fuel at Taiwan's shut down Kuosheng nuclear power plant.

articles.title: India's NPCIL seeks proposals for privately funded small reactor projects
articles.summary: India's nuclear power operator has issued a Request for Proposals from 'visionary Indian industries' to finance and build a proposed fleet of 220 MW Bharat Small Reactors to help decarbonise Indian industry.

articles.title: Zhangzhou unit 1 enters commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province - the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned at the site - has been put into commercial operation, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Westinghouse signs agreement to diversify fuel supply for Bulgarian plant
articles.summary: The company has signed a contract with Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant to conduct safety analysis for licensing a new nuclear fuel assembly design for Kozloduy unit 6.

articles.title: Government inquiry recommends lifting Swedish uranium ban
articles.summary: Sweden should remove its prohibition on uranium mining to allow it to be exploited like other natural resources regulated under the Minerals Act, a government inquiry has concluded.

articles.title: France's Flamanville EPR starts supplying power
articles.summary: The long-delayed Flamanville 3 EPR reactor in Normandy in northern France has begun delivering electricity to the grid, EDF announced.

articles.title: Final German nuclear power plant enters dismantling phase
articles.summary: Dismantling work at the shut down Brokdorf nuclear power plant has officially begun, PreussenElektra announced. The plant was the last nuclear power plant in Germany that was not yet being dismantled.

articles.title: Wyoming uranium project returns to production
articles.summary: Production operations at the Lance project have officially commenced after a five-year hiatus, with the first dry yellowcake product expected in March.

articles.title: KHNP, Candu Energy and Ansaldo Nucleare sign Cernavoda 1 refurb deal
articles.summary: Romania's Nuclearelectrica has ceremonially signed the engineering, procurement and construction contract for the estimated EUR1.9 billion (USD1.97 billion) refurbishment of Cernavoda unit 1 with a consortium of Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power, AtkinsRealis's Candu Energy, Canadian Commercial Corporation and Ansaldo Nucleare.

articles.title: Joint venture planned for commercialisation of Newcleo SMR
articles.summary: France-based innovative reactor developer Newcleo is to create a joint venture with Italy's NextChem to develop a new generation commercial-scale power plant, based on Newcleo's LFR-AS-200 small modular lead-cooled fast reactor.

articles.title: EU examines Polish state aid for nuclear power plant
articles.summary: The European Commission has launched an investigation into whether the planned public support for Poland's first nuclear power plant complies with EU rules on state aid.

articles.title: Oklo signs power agreement with data centre developer
articles.summary: In what is claimed to be "one of the largest corporate power agreements in history", US nuclear power plant developer Oklo has signed a non-binding Master Power Agreement with data centre designer, builder and operator Switch to deploy 12 GW of Oklo Aurora powerhouse projects by 2044.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Xudabao 4
articles.summary: The reactor vessel has been installed in its design position at Xudabao 4, Rosatom has announced.

articles.title: Virginia site selected to host fusion power plant
articles.summary: US private fusion company Commonwealth Fusion Systems has announced plans to independently finance, construct, own and operate a commercial-scale fusion power plant in Chesterfield County, Virginia.

articles.title: Licensing of Newcleo's fuel facility progresses
articles.summary: Innovative reactor developer Newcleo has submitted its Safety Option File to France's nuclear safety regulator, the Autorité de Sûreté Nucléaire, for its fuel assembly testing facility.

articles.title: Preferred site identified for new INL experimental reactor facility
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has identified land at Idaho National Laboratory as a potential site for Aalo Atomics to build a new experimental reactor facility to advance the company’s commercial Aalo-1 microreactor design.

articles.title: Partnership to develop UK fusion power plant designs
articles.summary: Two British public sector entities - the UK Atomic Energy Authority and the Science and Technology Facilities Council's Hartree Centre - have teamed up with US-headquartered technology firm IBM to design future experimental fusion power plants.

articles.title: Last used nuclear fuel removed from Gremikha naval base
articles.summary: The process of removing the used uranium-beryllium fuel from former nuclear submarine reactors at the Russian naval base Gremikha has concluded after more than a decade.

articles.title: Russia starts decommissioning plutonium-producing reactor
articles.summary: Decommissioning of the ADE-2 water-cooled uranium-graphite thermal neutron reactor has begun at the Mining and Chemical Combine in Zheleznogorsk, in the Krasnoyarsk region of Russia, Rosatom has announced.

articles.title: France supports financing of Polish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: France's Bpifrance Assurance Export and Sfil have joined the growing list of overseas financial institutions expressing interest in helping to finance Poland's first nuclear power plant project. Meanwhile, a poll shows record public support for nuclear energy in Poland.

articles.title: AtkinsRéalis selected for Energy Northwest SMR project
articles.summary: Energy Northwest has selected AtkinsRéalis Group Inc as the Owner's Engineer for its small modular reactor development project in Washington state.

articles.title: Rosatom starts reactor tests aiming to increase nuclear fuel enrichment
articles.summary: Russia's Rosatom is testing VVER nuclear fuel containing the neutron absorber erbium and uranium enriched to about 5%. It says such fuel could significantly increase the economic efficiency of nuclear power plants.

articles.title: USA selects suppliers for low-enriched uranium contracts
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has selected six companies which will be able to compete for contracts to supply low-enriched uranium. It follows June's request for proposals to purchase LEU from domestic sources.

articles.title: Firms selected to evaluate SMR deployment in Halden
articles.summary: US-based engineering company Amentum and Norwegian consulting firm Multiconsult Norge AS have been appointed by Halden Kjernekraft AS to evaluate the potential for constructing a small modular reactor at Halden in southeast Norway, where a research reactor once operated.

articles.title: UK to develop transport capability for HALEU
articles.summary: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority subsidiary Nuclear Transport Solutions has been awarded funding by the UK government to spearhead the development of transport capabilities for the UK's future use of high-assay low-enriched uranium.

articles.title: Canada considers financing for Polish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe announced it has received a letter of intent from Export Development Canada, for up to CAD2.02 billion (USD1.45 billion) to potentially support Poland's first nuclear power plant project.

articles.title: Preliminary design completed on Russian prototype fusion reactor
articles.summary: The preliminary design of Russia's proposed TRT tokamak nuclear fusion reactor has been completed by JSC NIIEFA.

articles.title: Samsung C&T teams up with Swedish SMR project developer
articles.summary: South Korean construction firm Samsung C&T has signed a memorandum of understanding with Swedish small modular reactor project development company Kärnfull Next to advance the deployment of SMRs in Sweden.

articles.title: Framatome to share fast reactor experience with Japan
articles.summary: France's Framatome has signed a Design Cooperation Implementation Arrangement for the development of sodium-cooled fast reactors with the Japan Atomic Energy Agency, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Mitsubishi FBR Systems.

articles.title: Bruce Power signs long-term Master Services Agreement
articles.summary: Kinectrics Inc will continue to support Bruce Power's reactor operations, life extension programme and radioisotope production activities under a CAD2.5 billion (USD3.2 billion), 10-year agreement. Meanwhile, a new process data reconciliation/data validation and reconciliation system is improving the output of the Bruce nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Tractebel to help develop Steady Energy's heating SMR
articles.summary: Finland's Steady Energy has signed a contract with Tractebel to provide engineering services to develop its district heating-focused LDR-150 small modular reactor.

articles.title: Orano contracted to make MOX fuel for Japanese reactors
articles.summary: France's Orano has signed two mixed-oxide fuel manufacturing contracts with Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries for a total of 64 MOX fuel assemblies for use in two Japanese nuclear power reactors.

articles.title: Final cycle of REMIX nuclear fuel trial under way
articles.summary: The third 18-month phase of the pilot operation of innovative REMIX fuel has begun at Russia's Balakavo nuclear power plant's first unit. The aim is to be able to close the fuel cycle for VVER reactors.

articles.title: Backfilling of Gorleben mine starts
articles.summary: Backfilling has begun of the former salt mine in Gorleben, Lower Saxony - previously considered a possible site for geological disposal of Germany's high-level radioactive waste.

articles.title: Newcleo submits SMR design for UK assessment
articles.summary: France-headquartered innovative reactor developer Newcleo has submitted an application to the UK Department of Energy Security and Net Zero for approval to enter the Generic Design Assessment for its LFR-AS-200 small modular lead-cooled fast reactor.

articles.title: LANL researchers complete HALEU criticality experiment
articles.summary: The Deimos experiment at Los Alamos National Laboratory is the first criticality experiment using high assay low-enriched uranium fuel to be carried out in the USA in more than 20 years, and will help to develop public data and criticality benchmarks for the material.

articles.title: Denison collaborates on uranium exploration as Wheeler River environmental approval progresses
articles.summary: Denison Mines Corp has filed its final Environmental Impact Statement for the Wheeler River uranium project with the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission following completion of the federal technical review. The company has also agreed to form three uranium exploration joint ventures in the eastern Athabasca Basin.

articles.title: First Zhangzhou unit begins supplying power
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province has been connected to the grid, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced. The unit is the first of four Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors under construction at the site.

articles.title: Canada selects location for used nuclear fuel repository
articles.summary: Fourteen years after beginning its consent-based siting process, Wabigoon Lake Ojibway Nation and the Township of Ignace have been selected as the host communities for Canada's proposed deep geological repository.

articles.title: Slovenia's GEN to intensify study of SMR options
articles.summary: In the wake of the cancellation of a planned referendum on new nuclear in Slovenia, the Director General of GEN energija, Dejan Paravan, has said that alongside continuing work on the proposed JEK2 project they will also be seeking more detailed information from small modular reactor companies.

articles.title: Westinghouse, Core Power join forces for floating nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company and Core Power are to work together on the design and development of a floating nuclear power plant using the eVinci microreactor.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Haiyang 4
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been successfully hoisted into position at unit 4 of the Haiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong province.

articles.title: Brazil's Angra 1 approved for 20-year life extension
articles.summary: Eletronuclear's Angra 1 nuclear power unit has been authorised by Brazil's National Nuclear Energy Commission to operate to 2044 - extending its life to 60 years.

articles.title: Hermes 2 construction permits approved by US Nuclear Regulatory Commission
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has voted to issue construction permits to Kairos Power for the Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant.

articles.title: Centrus to restart centrifuge manufacturing, expand capacity
articles.summary: Centrus Energy Corp is to resume centrifuge manufacturing activities and expand capacity at its facility in Tennessee as well as investing an additional USD60 million over the next 18 months for the effort to support a potential large-scale expansion of uranium enrichment at its American Centrifuge Plant in Piketon, Ohio.

articles.title: Norway SMR options to be explored with X-energy
articles.summary: Norsk Kjernekraft has signed a memorandum of understanding with high-temperature gas-cooled pebble-bed nuclear reactor developer X-energy to explore the deployment of small modular reactors in Norway.

articles.title: Russia places 'tit-for-tat' ban on US uranium exports
articles.summary: Russia has announced restrictions on exports of enriched uranium to the USA. The temporary ban is in response to US restrictions on imports of Russian uranium products which came into force earlier this year.

links.label: said in a filing to the US Securities and…

articles.title: Development and funding milestones for microreactor project
articles.summary: As it prepares to test a prototype of its Kaleidos microreactor at Idaho National Laboratory's DOME facility, Radiant Industries has secured USD100 million in Series C funding bringing the company's total venture funding to USD160 million.

articles.title: Framatome's ATF reaches new operational milestone
articles.summary: Framatome's PROtect Enhanced Accident Tolerant Fuel chromium-coated M5Framatome cladding has become the world's first ATF technology to operate with full length fuel rods at a burnup rate above 60 GWd/tU.

articles.title: Orano starts construction of thorium-228 facility
articles.summary: Orano subsidiary Orano Med has laid the foundations for its Advanced Thorium Extraction Facility plant in Bessines-sur-Gartempe in Haute-Vienne, western France. This facility is the world's first industrial plant dedicated to the production of thorium-228, a precursor of lead-212, for radioligand therapies.

articles.title: Key Cernavoda 3 and 4 engineering contract signed
articles.summary: The engineering, procurement and construction management contract for the completion of Romania's Cernavoda units 3 and 4 has been signed with the FCSA Joint Venture including Fluor, AtkinsRéalis, Ansaldo Nucleare and Sargent & Lundy Energie.

articles.title: Laurentis to support study on SMR deployment in Poland
articles.summary: Canada's Laurentis Energy Partners has signed an agreement with Orlen Synthos Green Energy to support the preparation of the Preliminary Safety Analysis Report for deploying GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy's BWRX-300 small modular reactor in Poland. The agreement is valued at up to CAD40 million (USD28.5 million).

articles.title: UK SMR negotiations begin with GE Hitachi, Holtec, Rolls-Royce SMR and Westinghouse
articles.summary: Great British Nuclear says that all four remaining technology providers are "viable options for development" as it prepares to make its choice for the UK's official small modular reactor programme.

links.label: interview earlier this year for the World…

articles.title: Second Japanese BWR set to restart next month
articles.summary: Chugoku Electric Power Company has announced that it plans to resume operation of unit 2 at its Shimane nuclear power plant on 7 December. The 789 MWe boiling water reactor has been offline since January 2012.

articles.title: TVEL and AllWeld cooperation agreement on decommissioning and waste management
articles.summary: Russia's TVEL and South Africa's AllWeld Nuclear and Industrial have signed a memorandum of cooperation in the field of decommissioning and radioactive waste management.

articles.title: Fuel debris sample extracted from Fukushima Daiichi reactor
articles.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company announced it has successfully completed the trial removal of a sample of fuel debris from the primary containment vessel of unit 2 at the damaged Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Urenco and ČEZ sign supply agreement into 2030s
articles.summary: The Czech Republic's nuclear power plant operator ČEZ has signed a new contract with Urenco for the supply of enriched uranium which will be used in nuclear fuel for the Dukovany and Temelin nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Japanese used nuclear fuel store starts operating
articles.summary: Japan's Nuclear Regulation Authority has granted an operating licence for an off-site interim dry storage facility for used nuclear fuel in Mutsu, Aomori prefecture. It is the first such facility in the country.

articles.title: Engineering contract for Bulgarian units signed with Hyundai E&C and Westinghouse
articles.summary: Hyundai Engineering & Construction, Westinghouse and Kozloduy NPP - New Builds have signed an engineering contract for new capacity at Bulgaria's Kozloduy nuclear power plant.

articles.title: China's first CAP1400 begins supplying power
articles.summary: The first of two demonstration Guohe One (CAP1400) reactors at Huaneng Group's Shidaowan site in China's Shandong province has been connected to the grid. The 1400 MWe pressurised water reactor design is intended to be deployed in large numbers across the country, as well as for export.

articles.title: Regulator rejects amended Susquehanna power agreement
articles.summary: The US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has issued an order rejecting the amended Susquehanna Interconnection Service Agreement between PJM Interconnection, PPL Electric Utilities and Talen Energy Corporation proposing to increase the load capacity of Amazon's data centre at the Susquehanna nuclear power plant in Pennsylvania.

articles.title: Candu Energy begins planning for Monark pre-licensing design review
articles.summary: AtkinsRéalis company Candu Energy Inc has announced it is entering into a special project with Canadian nuclear regulators to plan for a Pre-Licensing Design Review of the new Candu Monark reactor's suitability to be licensed and built in Canada.

articles.title: IAEA says leak was detected in Zaporizhzhia reactor coolant pump support system
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has reported that "a small water leakage was detected from an impulse line - essentially a small pipe - connected to" Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant's first unit’s primary circuit, with repairs taking place and no "immediate issue for nuclear safety".

articles.title: Holtec highlights its used fuel assembly repairs at Angra
articles.summary: Holtec International said it repaired 125 damaged used fuel assemblies as part of the successful completion of its recent loading campaign of 480 used nuclear fuel assemblies into 15 HI-STORM FW dry storage casks at Angra unit 2 in Brazil.

articles.title: Blykalla and ABB team up on SMR development
articles.summary: Global engineering company ABB has signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate with Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla. They will initially concentrate on constructing an electrical SMR pilot facility near Oskarshamn to test proof of concept before expanding to future plants.

articles.title: UK now aiming for SMR and Sizewell C decisions in spring 2025
articles.summary: Key decisions on which small modular reactor technologies to select and on a Final Investment Decision on Sizewell C will be taken in spring 2025, according to timelines set out in the government's Budget documents.

articles.title: TerraPower, ASP working on HALEU supply agreement
articles.summary: TerraPower has signed a term sheet with ASP Isotopes Inc for the construction of a uranium enrichment facility in South Africa and a supply agreement for fuel delivery for the Natrium small modular reactor.

articles.title: Fuel loading under way at Japanese BWR ahead of restart
articles.summary: The process of loading fuel assemblies into the core of unit 2 at the Shimane nuclear power plant ahead of its planned restart in December began today, Chugoku Electric Power Company announced. It is set to become the second Japanese boiling water reactor (BWR) to be restarted.

articles.title: First nuclear fuel produced for Bolivia's research reactor
articles.summary: The nuclear fuel for the first load at the research reactor being built in Bolivia has been manufactured and accepted, with delivery of the first batch of fuel assemblies planned for 2025.

articles.title: Alliance calls for support from next European Commission
articles.summary: Member countries of the European Nuclear Alliance have called upon the next European Commission to recognise the contributions of both nuclear and renewables in Europe's decarbonisation in its upcoming programme, covering the period 2024-2029.

articles.title: DOE signs off on Oklo fuel fabrication facility design
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has approved the Conceptual Safety Design Report for Oklo Inc's Aurora Fuel Fabrication Facility at Idaho National Laboratory. The facility will fabricate fuel for the Aurora "powerhouse" liquid metal-cooled fast reactor plant which is to be located at the same site.

articles.title: Framatome gets further Trillo fuel supply contract
articles.summary: Spain's Centrales Nucleares Almaraz-Trillo has awarded a contract for fuel assembly deliveries and related services from 2026-2035 for the Trillo nuclear power plant's unit 1 to France's Framatome.
articles.url: https://www.world-nuclear-news.org/articles/Framatome gets further Trillo fuel supply contract

articles.title: US startup aims for shipyard SMR construction
articles.summary: Blue Energy says its modular, reactor-agnostic power plant architecture can be centrally manufactured in existing shipyards, slashing both costs and build time, and has completed a USD45 million Series A fundraise.

articles.title: Zap starts up demo fusion power plant system
articles.summary: Fusion power developer Zap Energy, based near Seattle, has begun operations of Century, its first fully-integrated demonstration of three major plant-relevant technologies operating at up to 100 kilowatts of input power.

articles.title: US DOE awards contracts to spur HALEU supply chain
articles.summary: Six companies have been awarded contracts worth a minimum of USD2 million each to provide deconversion services, a critical part of the supply chain for high-assay low-enriched uranium.

articles.title: Core catcher installation begins at El Dabaa 3
articles.summary: A ceremony has been held to mark the start of work on installing the core catcher for unit 3 of the El Dabaa nuclear power plant which is being built in Egypt.

articles.title: Moltex reactor can consume used fuel, research confirms
articles.summary: Moltex Energy Canada says new research demonstrates "the unique capability" of its Stable Salt Reactor - Wasteburner (SSR-W) to consume used nuclear fuel, supporting its ongoing development of a reactor that can "significantly reduce nuclear waste while producing clean energy".

articles.title: Kairos Power begins work on New Mexico salt production facility
articles.summary: The Salt Production Facility at the company's new Manufacturing Development Campus near Albuquerque will produce high-purity, molten salt coolant for its advanced reactors.

articles.title: Work begins on El Dabaa 2's inner containment building
articles.summary: The inner containment building for unit 2 of Egypt's El Dabaa nuclear power plant has begun to take shape, with work also under way on the reactor vessel for the fourth unit.

articles.title: US Administration finalises financial support for Palisades restart
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has finalised a USD1.52 billion loan guarantee for Holtec International's project to recommission the single-unit pressurised water reactor, and the Department of Agriculture has issued USD1.3 billion in grants to two rural electric cooperatives that will purchase power from the restarted plant.
articles.url: https://www.world-nuclear-news.org/articles/US Administration finalises financial support for Palisades restart

articles.title: Fourth unit at Zhangzhou under construction
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 4 at the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in Fujian province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. The plant will eventually house six Hualong One reactors.

articles.title: South Korean SMR design approved by regulator
articles.summary: The SMART100 small modular reactor design has been granted standard design approval by South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission.

articles.title: GE Hitachi, Holtec, Rolls-Royce SMR and Westinghouse enter UK SMR negotiations
articles.summary: Great British Nuclear has announced that there are four companies remaining in the contest to select technology for the UK's proposed small modular reactor programme, with NuScale missing out.

links.label: interview earlier this year for the World…

articles.title: Work starts at US prototype microreactor site
articles.summary: The US Department of Defense has broken ground at Idaho National Laboratory for the Project Pele prototype mobile microreactor. It will become the USA's first electricity-generating Generation IV reactor as early as 2026.

articles.title: US updates import tariffs as domestic uranium production grows
articles.summary: US uranium production continues to grow, with 2024's year-to-date production already more than triple that recorded for the whole of 2023, according to the latest figures from the US Energy Information Administration (EIA). Meanwhile, as press reports suggest US concern that its ban on Russian uranium might be being circumvented, the Office of the United States…

articles.title: Bechtel, Westinghouse welcome Polish funding announcement
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company and Bechtel said they welcome the announcement by the Polish government of its intention to allocate PLN60 billion (USD15.7 billion) to fund the country’s first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Third cycle of accident-tolerant nuclear fuel pilot under way
articles.summary: The third 18-month cycle of operation of accident tolerant fuel has begun at Rostov nuclear power plant unit 2, Rosatom has announced.

articles.title: Argentina aims to join international research reactor centres scheme
articles.summary: The National Atomic Energy Commission (CNEA) of Argentina says the country is aiming to contribute its experience and facilities to collaborate with countries interested in adopting nuclear technologies for peaceful purposes.

articles.title: Rajasthan unit reaches first criticality
articles.summary: Rajasthan Atomic Power Plant unit 7 - India's third indigenously designed 700 MWe pressurised heavy water reactor - achieved first criticality on 19 September after receiving clearance from the Indian nuclear regulator.

articles.title: Constellation to restart Three Mile Island unit, powering Microsoft
articles.summary: Constellation signed a 20-year Microsoft power purchase agreement supporting a proposed restart of Three Mile Island unit 1.

articles.title: South Yorkshire chosen for Holtec's proposed UK SMR factory
articles.summary: USA-based Holtec International has selected South Yorkshire in England as the preferred site for its proposed UK small modular reactor factory. It has also signed memorandums of understanding with two British research centres to support SMR manufacturing and testing.

articles.title: Palisades on schedule for repowering, NRC considers restart regulations
articles.summary: The programme to restart the Palisades nuclear power plant in Michigan is now in the inspections and maintenance phase and remains on schedule, Holtec International said in its latest update. Meanwhile, the US regulator has been petitioned to codify regulations for restarting shuttered nuclear power plants.

links.label: entry in the US Federal Register

articles.title: Czech Republic selects Rolls-Royce SMR for small reactors project
articles.summary: The Czech Republic has chosen UK firm Rolls-Royce SMR after assessing seven potential technology suppliers for its proposed small modular reactor programme.

articles.title: Loading of dummy fuel into Rooppur 1 begins
articles.summary: The construction project for Bangladesh's first nuclear power plant has hit a fresh landmark with dummy fuel assemblies being loaded into unit 1 of the Rooppur nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Construction permit granted for molten salt research reactor
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a licence to Abilene Christian University for the construction of a molten salt research reactor on its campus in Abilene, Texas. This marks the first construction permit for a liquid-fueled advanced reactor and only the second for any advanced reactor issued by the NRC.

articles.title: Front-end design milestone for Westinghouse micoreactor
articles.summary: The company has submitted the Preliminary Safety Design Report for its eVinci reactor to the US Department of Energy's National Reactor Innovation Center (NRIC). Westinghouse is the first of the three microreactor developers supported by NRIC to reach this milestone towards testing at Idaho National Laboratory.

articles.title: Generator stator in place at Chinese SMR
articles.summary: The generator stator has been hoisted into place at the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Protocol signals start of work at Uzbek reactor site
articles.summary: The signature of a protocol by UzAtom's Directorate for Construction of a Nuclear Power Plant and JSC Atomstroyexport - the engineering division of Russia's Rosatom - means work can begin at the site of Uzbekistan's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: GE Hitachi signs four MoUs focusing on UK SMR plans
articles.summary: GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy has signed memorandums of understanding with Aecon, AtkinsRéalis, Jacobs and Laing O'Rourke as part of its preparations in the UK's on-going small modular reactor selection contest.

articles.title: Decommissioning of Hunterston B approved
articles.summary: The UK's Office for Nuclear Regulation has approved EDF Energy's application to start decommissioning the Hunterston B nuclear power plant in Scotland. This decision comes after a public consultation and a detailed assessment by ONR specialist inspectors of EDF Energy's environmental statement.

articles.title: What are the fuel cycle challenges of tripling nuclear capacity?
articles.summary: Leading figures from across the fuel cycle say they are ready to meet increased demand, but set out areas where change is required to help make it happen, in a World Nuclear Symposium session.

articles.title: Construction permit granted for new Korean APR1400 units
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission has issued a licence to Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power for the construction of units 3 and 4 of the Shin Hanul nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Russia to consider restricting uranium exports, Putin says
articles.summary: Russia's President Vladimir Putin has said the country should consider whether to bring in some restrictions on exports of raw materials such as uranium, titanium and nickel, in response to sanctions limiting imports of certain goods.

articles.title: First Hinkley Point B reactor free of fuel
articles.summary: The defueling of the first of two advanced gas-cooled reactors at the Hinkley Point B nuclear power plant in Somerset, the UK, has been completed.

articles.title: NRC amends non-power reactor licensing regulations
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has amended its regulations for licensing non-power production or utilisation facilities to reflect the limited risk such facilities pose to public safety. At the same time, it is also revising the definition of a testing facility to a more risk-informed standard than the current power-based definition.

articles.title: Newcleo, Saipem team up for offshore SMR applications
articles.summary: Italian multinational oilfield services company Saipem has signed a cooperation agreement with UK-headquartered Newcleo to study offshore applications of Newcleo's innovative reactor technology.

articles.title: Reactor internals in place at Chinese SMR
articles.summary: The lower part of the reactor internals has been installed at the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: US regulator issues environmental assessment for two-unit test reactor
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has published its final environmental assessment and finding of no significant impact for Kairos Power's construction permit application for the dual unit Hermes 2 test reactor project.

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Tianwan 8
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been moved into place at unit 8 of the Tianwan plant in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: Joint preparatory review for Thorizon One reactor
articles.summary: Thorizon of the Netherlands has announced that the Dutch and French nuclear regulators are to collaborate on a preparatory review of its Thorizon One molten salt reactor to streamline the pre-license applications expected next year.

articles.title: Fuel loading begins ahead of Onagawa 2 restart
articles.summary: Tohoku Electric Power Company announced it has started loading fuel assemblies into the reactor of unit 2 at its Onagawa nuclear power plant in Japan's northeastern Miyagi Prefecture. The reactor has been offline since November 2010 and will become the 13th Japanese reactor to be restarted.

articles.title: EDF begins start up process for Flamanville EPR
articles.summary: Workers at the Flamanville EPR have begun the process required for achieving the first nuclear reaction in the reactor following approval from the French nuclear regulator. The reactor is expected to be connected to the grid in the coming months.

articles.title: Westinghouse fuel loaded into Loviisa reactor
articles.summary: The first batch of VVER-440 fuel assemblies supplied by Westinghouse has been loaded into unit 2 of Finland's Loviisa nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Cleanup milestone for East Tennessee site
articles.summary: The completion of soil remediation at the East Tennessee Technology Park is the culmination of 20 years of cleanup at the site which was once home to Manhattan Project and Cold War-era uranium enrichment facilities. The remaining federally owned parcels of land at the site can now be transferred to the community.

articles.title: Fresh phase completed of fuel moved to Angra's dry storage facility
articles.summary: Brazil's Eletronuclear says the first phase of the second campaign to move used fuel from Angra 2 to its on-site used fuel dry storage facility has been successfully completed, with 480 used fuel elements transferred.

articles.title: Pilot fuel elements produced for MBIR fast neutron research reactor
articles.summary: A pilot batch of fuel elements has successfully passed acceptance tests for compliance with the technological and design documentation for Russia's MBIR multipurpose sodium-cooled fast neutron research reactor.

articles.title: US, Ghanaian firms sign commercial agreement for SMR deployment
articles.summary: The agreement between Nuclear Power Ghana and Regnum Technology Group to deploy a single NuScale VOYGR-12 small modular reactor plant was signed during the second annual US-Africa Nuclear Energy Summit.

articles.title: Trial run at Finnish repository starts
articles.summary: Finnish waste management company Posiva announced it has begun a trial run of placing disposal cannisters in the Onkalo used nuclear fuel repository. No actual nuclear fuel is being used in the trial run.

articles.title: Funding and commercial agreements grow for Last Energy
articles.summary: US microreactor developer Last Energy announced it has raised USD40 million for its Series B round of funding, bringing total capital raised to USD64 million since the company's founding in 2019. It also said it has now reached commercial agreements for 80 of its microreactors.

articles.title: Deep Fission unveils underground reactor concept
articles.summary: California-based nuclear startup company Deep Fission, which is proposing to place microreactors deep underground, announced its emergence from stealth mode and a USD4 million pre-seed investment round.

articles.title: Norway taps South Korean expertise in SMR plant study
articles.summary: Norsk Kjernekraft has signed a memorandum of understanding with South Korea's DL Energy and DL E&C to study the feasibility of constructing a nuclear power plant at the Mongstad oil refinery in Norway.

articles.title: Kishida looks to restart Kashiwazaki-Kariwa units
articles.summary: Japan's Prime Minister Fumio Kishida announced he will hold a ministerial meeting next week to discuss measures needed to gain local consent for the restart of reactors at Tokyo Electric Power Company's Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata Prefecture.

articles.title: IAEA's Grossi warns of risks at Kursk nuclear power plant
articles.summary: International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi, speaking after visiting Russia's Kursk nuclear power plant, said military action near the plant was a cause for concern.

articles.title: Westinghouse SMR design accepted for UK review
articles.summary: The UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero has approved Westinghouse's AP300 small modular reactor to enter the Generic Design Assessment process.

articles.title: TVA approves further funding for Clinch River SMR
articles.summary: The Tennessee Valley Authority Board of Directors has approved a further USD150 million in additional advanced funding to support the development of potential small modular reactors at the Clinch River site near Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

articles.title: Kazatomprom lowers 2025 uranium production expectations
articles.summary: Kazatomprom has cut its uranium production guidance for 2025 by 5000 tU, citing uncertainties in sulphuric acid supply - but 2025 production is still expected to be higher than 2024.

articles.title: Brazil to resume uranium exploration
articles.summary: Brazilian fuel cycle company Indústrias Nucleares do Brasil has announced it is to resume exploration for uranium in the country after a 40-year hiatus.

articles.title: Fuel debris removal attempt halted at Fukushima Daiichi
articles.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company has suspended the first attempt to extract fuel debris from within the primary containment vessel of unit 2 at the damaged Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant after an error in the setup of the debris retrieval device was identified.

articles.title: UK research contracts awarded into new decommissioning techniques
articles.summary: The Nuclear Decommissioning Authority has awarded GBP30 million (USD39.1 million) to four-year projects to drive "new techniques to deliver safe, sustainable and cost-effective decommissioning".

articles.title: Germany's Krümmel gets decommissioning and dismantling permit
articles.summary: Germany's Krümmel nuclear power plant has been given the regulatory go-ahead to move from post-operation to decommissioning, with dismantling work scheduled to take about 15 years.

articles.title: Reactor vessel in place at second San'ao unit
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel for unit 2 of the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province has been installed within the reactor building, CGN Cangnan Nuclear Power announced.

articles.title: Agency sees progress and challenges for EU fuel supply chain
articles.summary: Deliveries of natural uranium and other nuclear services to the EU, including imports from Russia, increased in 2023 as utilities continued to diversify their sources of nuclear fuel. But there are still supply chain challenges to face, according to the latest annual report from the Euratom Supply Agency.

articles.title: Westinghouse accident tolerant fuel in US licensing 'first'
articles.summary: In a first for the USA, the country's nuclear regulator has approved an increase in the burnup limit for Westinghouse's Encore accident tolerant fuel design, paving the way for longer and more economic fuel cycles.

articles.title: Rwanda signs agreement with NANO Nuclear
articles.summary: US microreactor technology company NANO Nuclear Energy Inc has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Rwanda Atomic Energy Board that could lead to the deployment of small modular reactors and microreactors in the African nation.

articles.title: Water leak within Fukushima Daiichi 2 reactor building
articles.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company announced the discovery on 9 August of a water leak at unit 2 of the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant involving an estimated 25 tonnes of water from the used fuel cooling system pump room and the heat exchanger room.

articles.title: Decommissioning milestone at Oak Ridge reactor
articles.summary: The lower section of the reactor vessel of the Oak Ridge Research Reactor has been removed and transferred to a cask for eventual shipment and disposal. The reactor was an isotope production and irradiation facility from 1958 and was permanently shut down in July 1987.

articles.title: Sizewell A demolition work approved
articles.summary: Nuclear Restoration Services has been given planning consent to demolish the turbine hall and electrical annexe at the decommissioned Sizewell A Magnox nuclear power plant in Suffolk, England.

articles.title: Russian research reactor gets 15-year service life extension
articles.summary: The IVV-2M water-moderated research reactor was commissioned in 1966 and has now been given the go-ahead to operate until the end of 2040.

articles.title: Westinghouse starts production of ADOPT fuel pellets
articles.summary: Westinghouse has produced the first of its nuclear fuel pellets that contain higher enrichment levels than what is currently used in commercial reactors. The Low Enriched Uranium Plus Advanced Doped Pellet Technology fuel pellets are aimed at boosting both the performance and safety of nuclear power plants.

articles.title: Contracts support Candu refurbishment projects in China and Canada
articles.summary: Candu Energy Inc has agreed with Third Qinshan Nuclear Power Company Limited to support the ongoing 30-year life extension of the two Candu reactors at the Qinshan Nuclear Generating Station, while Bruce Power has awarded a CAD700 million (USD510 million) contract to replace steam generators at Bruce units 5, 7 and 8 to the AECON-led Steam Generator Replacement…

articles.title: IsoEnergy reopens US underground uranium mine
articles.summary: The main decline at the Tony M mine in Utah was successfully reopened on 26 July, and work has begun to rehabilitate the underground workings.

articles.title: Work begins on first US Gen IV reactor
articles.summary: Kairos Power has announced the start of site work and excavation for the Hermes Low-Power Demonstration Reactor, the first non-light-water reactor to be permitted in the USA in over 50 years.

articles.title: Construction starts on two new Chinese units
articles.summary: The pouring of first concrete has been announced for both unit 5 at the Ningde nuclear power plant in Fujian Province and unit 1 of the Shidaowan plant in Shandong Province. Both units will feature Hualong One reactors.

articles.title: KHNP starts contract negotiations for Czech reactors
articles.summary: One week after being selected as the preferred bidder, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power said it has begun contract negotiations for at least two new nuclear power units in the Czech Republic. The aim is for the contract to be signed in March 2025.

articles.title: RoPower and Fluor sign FEED 2 contract for SMR project
articles.summary: Romania's Nuclearelectrica and project company RoPower Nuclear have signed the Front-End Engineering and Design Phase 2 contract with Fluor Corporation for the Doicești small modular reactor project.

articles.title: El Dabaa project reports on construction progress
articles.summary: Egypt's first nuclear power plant is pushing ahead - with the core catcher for unit 3 now on site, a 2000-tonne capacity crane installed and Rosatom reporting that 75% of the blanks to be used for unit 1's reactor equipment now produced.

articles.title: Construction starts on Xudabao 2
articles.summary: The first batch of concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 2 at the Xudabao nuclear power plant in China's Liaoning Province, marking the official start of construction of the unit.

articles.title: Construction begins on China's largest uranium mining project
articles.summary: China began work on a major in-situ uranium mining development in Inner Mongolia, intended to support domestic nuclear-fuel security.

articles.title: Construction begins on China's largest uranium mining project
articles.summary: The project in Ordos in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is being developed by China National Nuclear Corporation, with work beginning on Friday, according to the China Atomic Energy Authority.

articles.title: Final permit issued for Mauritanian uranium mine
articles.summary: Australia-based mineral company Aura Energy Limited announced it has received from the Mauritanian government the last outstanding material permit to allow the construction and operation of the Tiris uranium project in the West African country.

articles.title: Construction of Leningrad 7 'running ahead of schedule'
articles.summary: Rosatom says that the work on the reactor building is currently running two and a half months ahead of schedule, with concreting of the foundation completed.

articles.title: President Biden signs ADVANCE Act into law
articles.summary: The bipartisan Accelerating Deployment of Versatile, Advanced Nuclear for Clean Energy (ADVANCE) Act aims to incentivise and support the development and deployment of new advanced nuclear technologies, including measures to streamline the regulatory approvals process.

articles.title: Further Norwegian town signs up for nuclear studies
articles.summary: A second municipality in southern Norway's Agder county, Lyngdal, has entered into a cooperation agreement with Norsk Kjernekraft regarding the investigation of a possible future nuclear power plant in the area.

articles.title: Uzbekistan SMR plant construction preparations under way
articles.summary: Infrastructure work for a six-unit small modular reactor nuclear power plant in Uzbekistan is expected to begin in the autumn, after the signing of a protocol on the entry into force of the construction contract signed last month.

articles.title: DOE seeks domestic LEU supply contracts
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has issued a request for proposals to purchase low-enriched uranium from domestic sources. The request is supported by USD2.7 billion from President Joe Biden's Investing in America agenda to boost the domestic nuclear fuel supply chain.

articles.title: Work starts on first phase of Myrrha
articles.summary: A groundbreaking ceremony has been held at the Minerva particle accelerator construction site in Mol, Belgium, marking the start of the first of three phases of the development of the Myrrha accelerator-driven research reactor.

articles.title: Fuel assemblies with 3D-printed bottom nozzles tested
articles.summary: Four lead test assemblies supplied by Westinghouse featuring 3D-printed bottom nozzles have been used at Southern Nuclear's Farley nuclear power plant in Alabama. Westinghouse says the components improve debris capture and fuel endurance within its fuel assemblies.

articles.title: SMR power plant planned for Swedish site
articles.summary: Small modular reactor project development company Kärnfull Next has announced the municipality of Valdemarsvik in Östergötland county in southeastern Sweden as a new candidate site to host up to six reactors.

articles.title: Kozloduy used fuel storage licence updated
articles.summary: Bulgaria's Nuclear Regulatory Agency has issued a fresh non-time-limited licence to operate the used fuel storage facility at the Kozloduy nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Construction of WIPP ventilation system complete
articles.summary: Now that construction of the new large-scale ventilation system at the Waste Isolation Pilot Plant is complete, the US Department of Environmental Management is aiming for it to be fully operational in 2026.

articles.title: Paladin acquires Fission, creating multi-asset uranium company
articles.summary: Australia-headquartered Paladin Energy Limited is to acquire Canadian uranium project developer Fission Uranium Corp in a transaction the companies say will create a "globally significant uranium company" listed on Australian and Canadian stock exchanges and will help advance Fission's Patterson Lake South project towards production.

articles.title: Construction of Pallas foundation pit progresses
articles.summary: The installation of 380 foundation piles - each 33 metres in length - has been completed in the construction pit for the Pallas research reactor in Petten, the Netherlands. Pallas is planned to replace the existing High Flux Reactor.

articles.title: EU funding Framatome VVER-440 fuel development
articles.summary: The EUR10 million (USD10.7 million) contribution from the European Union under the Euratom Research and Training Programme targets the "swift and secure development and deployment of a European fuel solution" for VVER reactors.

articles.title: Niger revokes mining permit for Imouraren project
articles.summary: France's Orano has announced that Nigerien authorities have withdrawn the operating permit for the Imouraren uranium mine, which was issued to its subsidiary Imouraren SA in 2009.

articles.title: South Korea plans SMR industrial complex
articles.summary: President Yoon Suk Yeol has announced plans to create a small modular reactor industrial hub in the city of Gyeongju in the southeastern corner of South Korea's North Gyeongsang Province. The government also aims to establish a hub for the hydrogen industry in the province.

articles.title: Uranium recovery starts at Finnish mine
articles.summary: Finnish mining company Terrafame has begun recovering natural uranium as a by-product of zinc and nickel production at its Sotkamo mine in Talvivaara in the north-east of the country.

articles.title: First fuel delivered for new Kursk nuclear power plant
