articles.summary: The first of the freshly delivered fuel assemblies is expected to be loaded into Kursk II's unit 1 later this year.

articles.title: Finnish research reactor decommissioned
articles.summary: Dismantling of the Finnish Reactor 1 research reactor at Aalto University's Otaniemi campus in Espoo has been completed, marking the first nuclear reactor to be decommissioned in Finland. The experience gained will serve as a model for decommissioning commercial nuclear reactors in the country.

articles.title: Saskatchewan to evaluate Westinghouse reactor technology
articles.summary: Saskatchewan Power Corporation, Westinghouse Electric Company and Cameco Corporation will evaluate the potential deployment of Westinghouse nuclear reactor technology - and a Saskatchewan-based nuclear supply chain - for Saskatchewan’s future clean power needs.

articles.title: SMR partnership targets Swedish district heating
articles.summary: Swedish small modular reactor project development company Kärnfull Next has formed a strategic partnership with Finnish SMR developer Steady Energy to introduce SMRs for district heating in Sweden.

articles.title: Nuclear industry sets expectations of next European Commission
articles.summary: Leaders from across the European nuclear industry have published a manifesto outlining their priorities for the new European Commission. Nuclear energy, they note, plays a crucial role in providing the EU with secure and affordable energy.

articles.title: Uranium production resumes at Texas project
articles.summary: The start-up of production at Alta Mesa - a joint venture of enCore Energy and Boss Energy - sees enCore become the only US uranium producer with multiple production facilities currently in operation and is the second start-up in eight weeks for Boss Energy. The first shipment of yellowcake is expected in 60-90 days' time.

articles.title: Ontario minister marks completion of first phase of SMR preparations
articles.summary: Newly appointed Minister of Energy and Electrification Stephen Lecce visited Ontario Power Generation's Darlington New Nuclear site to mark the completion of the first phase of site preparation for the province's first small modular reactor and recent trade missions to Romania and France.

articles.title: Nuclear power plant proposed for north-eastern Norway
articles.summary: Norsk Kjernekraft has submitted a proposal to Norway's Ministry of Energy for an assessment into the construction of a power plant based on multiple small modular reactors in the county of Finnmark. The company said it marks the first step in the formal process to establish a nuclear power plant there.

articles.title: Cernavoda 1 refurb project framework agreement signed
articles.summary: Romania's Nuclearelectrica and Canadian Nuclear Partners have signed a long-term framework agreement to provide project management services for the refurbishment of Cernavoda nuclear power plant's unit 1.

articles.title: Bulgaria's Kozloduy using first Westinghouse fuel
articles.summary: Following its annual scheduled shutdown, Kozloduy unit 5 has been restarted with 43 Westinghouse-produced cartridges loaded into the reactor as part of its transition from Russian-supplied fuel.

articles.title: Vattenfall narrows search for SMR supplier
articles.summary: Sweden's Vattenfall has shortlisted Rolls-Royce SMR and GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy as potential suppliers of small modular reactors for its Ringhals site. Meanwhile, the country's nuclear regulator has proposed making the early evaluation of new reactor technology possible to make the permitting process more efficient and predictable.

articles.title: Works begins on Romania's tritium removal facility
articles.summary: Nuclearelectrica and Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power have held a ceremony to mark the start of work on what will become Europe's first tritium removal facility, at Romania's Cernavoda nuclear power plant.

articles.title: UK SMR contest deadline pushed back two weeks
articles.summary: A fortnight's extension - until after the general election - has been given for the submission of documentation by the six contenders in the UK's small modular reactor selection process.

articles.title: US uranium purchases show year-on-year increase: EIA
articles.summary: US utilities purchased 27% more uranium in 2023 than 2022, according to the US Energy Information Administration's latest annual report. Most of this came from foreign suppliers - US-origin material accounted for 5% of total deliveries, the same percentage as 2022.

articles.title: SMR planned for Yakutia may become two-unit project
articles.summary: The regional and federal ministries are "actively working" to change the existing plans for Russia's first land-based small modular reactor project in Yakutia into a two-reactor scheme, after assessing likely future energy demands.

articles.title: Guinea signs floating nuclear power plants MoU with Russia
articles.summary: The Republic of Guinea and Rosatom have signed a memorandum of understanding to cooperate on the development of floating power units to supply electricity to the African country.

articles.title: Construction of Finnish pilot SMR plant to start in 2025
articles.summary: Steady Energy said it is set to start construction of its first LDR-50 district heating reactor pilot plant in Finland next year, with potential sites including the Finnish capital Helsinki and two other cities.

articles.title: Burkina Faso signs fresh nuclear-focused MoUs with Russia
articles.summary: Memorandums of understanding covering education and training, infrastructure development and public opinion have been signed in the next stage of Burkina Faso and Russia's cooperation on peaceful uses of nuclear technology.

articles.title: EBRD Chernobyl funding plan ratified by Ukraine's parliament
articles.summary: Members of Ukraine's parliament have backed a law approving the framework agreement between Ukraine and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development for funding aimed at projects to boost safety measures at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant site and exclusion zone.

articles.title: Inaugural ISL tests completed at third Canadian uranium deposit
articles.summary: A test programme at the Midwest uranium project in Saskatchewan has validated that the Midwest Main deposit possesses the characteristics necessary for an in-situ leach operation, Denison Mines Corp has announced.

articles.title: Rosatom announces novel used fuel processing technology
articles.summary: Russian state nuclear corporation Rosatom announced it has developed an innovative crystallisation refining technology for the purification and separation of nuclear materials from used nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Construction of containment completed for Taipingling 1
articles.summary: The concreting has been completed of the outer dome of the containment building of unit 1 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant. China General Nuclear said it marks the completion of the main structure of unit 1, the first of six Hualong One units planned at the site in China's Guangdong province.

articles.title: USA announces new cooperation to support Ghana SMR plans
articles.summary: The signature of two key arrangements facilitated by the US Foundational Infrastructure for the Responsible Use of Small Modular Reactor Technology Program to advance deployment of a small modular reactor in Ghana and establish the country as a regional SMR hub were announced at the Africa Nuclear Business Platform meeting in Accra on May 28.

articles.title: Saskatchewan SMR to be located in Estevan
articles.summary: SaskPower has identified two potential sites for Saskatchewan's first small modular reactor to begin detailed site analysis ahead of a final site selection in 2025. Both sites are in the Estevan area in the south-east of the province.

articles.title: Framatome, TerraPower announce plans for HALEU metallisation plant
articles.summary: Framatome and TerraPower have agreed to design and develop a high-assay low enriched uranium metallisation pilot plant at Framatome’s nuclear fuel manufacturing facility in Richland, Washington.

articles.title: Contract for refurbishment of Loviisa turbines
articles.summary: Finnish utility Fortum has awarded a contract to Doosan Škoda Power to modernise the low-pressure turbines at its Loviisa nuclear power plant as part of lifetime extension-related investments. The modernisation of the turbines will also increase the total capacity of the Loviisa power plant by about 38 MWe.

articles.title: Argentina's CAREM SMR project to have Critical Design Review
articles.summary: The Critical Design Review for Argentina's CAREM small modular reactor should be completed within 60 days, the new president of the National Atomic Energy Commission, Germán Guido Lavalle, has said.

articles.title: US companies join up to lower nuclear investment costs
articles.summary: Duke Energy, Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Nucor have signed agreements on proposed tariffs that would lower the costs of investing in clean energy technologies like new nuclear as they explore new and innovative approaches to support carbon-free energy generation and help utilities serve the future energy needs of large businesses in North Carolina and South…

articles.title: First Westinghouse fuel loaded at Bulgaria's Kozloduy
articles.summary: Bulgarian Prime Minister Dimitar Glavchev was among those marking the loading of Westinghouse VVER fuel into the country's Kozloduy nuclear power plant's unit 5, part of its supply diversification process.

articles.title: SMR developers enlist French nuclear expertise
articles.summary: Thorizon of the Netherlands has signed a cooperation agreement with France's EDF R&D to advance the Thorizon One molten salt reactor design. Meanwhile, Blue Capsule has signed a partnership agreement with the French Alternative Energies & Atomic Energy Commission, from which it was spun off, for the development of its small modular reactor.

articles.title: Russia set to build SMR nuclear power plant in Uzbekistan
articles.summary: An agreement between Uzbekistan and Russia will see a six-unit small modular reactor nuclear power plant built in the Jizzakh region of Uzbekistan, with construction work due to begin as early as this summer.

articles.title: Contract for expansion of Rolls-Royce submarine site
articles.summary: International infrastructure group Balfour Beatty has been selected by Rolls-Royce as its non-fissile construction partner to help expand its Raynesway site in Derby, UK, to meet the growth in demand from the Royal Navy, and as a result of last year's AUKUS announcement.

articles.title: Fuel loading completed at France's Flamanville 3 EPR
articles.summary: The process of loading fuel assemblies into the core of the Flamanville 3 EPR reactor in France has been completed ahead of its start-up. The 1650 MWe (gross) pressurised water reactor is expected to reach 100% output before the end of the year.

articles.title: Belarus ratifies updates to nuclear power plant agreement with Russia
articles.summary: The Belarus council of ministers has ratified protocol amendments which allow extension of the warranty period from those in the original 2011 intergovernmental agreement with Russia for the construction of the country's nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Study to assess benefits of Hartlepool SMR plant
articles.summary: X-energy and Cavendish Nuclear have commissioned Teesside University to undertake a study of the potential regional benefits and economic impacts of a proposed power plant in Hartlepool, UK, based on X-energy's Xe-100 high temperature gas-cooled reactor.

articles.title: Control room commissioned at Chinese SMR
articles.summary: The main control room of the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, has officially been put into operation, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: MHI awarded additional contract for ITER fusion machine
articles.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries has been awarded a contract to supply a further 12 outer vertical targets for the divertor to be used in the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor. The Japanese company has already delivered six of the components.

articles.title: Facility to demonstrate Rolls-Royce SMR module production
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR has announced plans for a facility in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, UK, to manufacture and test prototype modules for its small modular reactors.

articles.title: Norsk Kjernekraft focuses on off-grid SMR projects
articles.summary: Under a new business plan, Norwegian nuclear project developer Norsk Kjernekraft says it plans to construct off-grid small modular reactors in industrial areas where both reliable power and access to heat are needed.

articles.title: Uganda looks to potential uranium production
articles.summary: The Government of Uganda is hosting an International Atomic Energy Agency Integrated Uranium Production Cycle Review mission as it reviews its potential to produce uranium to support its plans for 24,000 MWe of nuclear capacity.

articles.title: Reactor vessel and steam generators shipped for Tianwan 8
articles.summary: The reactor vessel and two steam generators, with a combined weight of more than 1000 tonnes, will travel by road, river and sea from Russia to the Tianwan site in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: Holtec outlines progress towards Palisades restart
articles.summary: The return of some former staff, the revamping of training facilities including the control room simulator, the submission of regulatory documents and the ordering of new fuel are all highlighted as part of steps taken towards the repowering of the shuttered Palisades nuclear power plant in the USA.

articles.title: Dutch regulator issues permit for Urenco waste store
articles.summary: The Authority for Nuclear Safety and Radiation Protection has granted the final permit to Urenco for the construction and operation of a new radioactive waste storage facility at its Almelo site. The uranium enrichment company was last year granted permission to build the facility prior to the permit being issued.

articles.title: US President signs uranium import prohibition
articles.summary: The act prohibiting the importation into the USA of unirradiated, low-enriched uranium that is produced in the Russian Federation or by a Russian entity has been signed into law by President Joe Biden.

articles.title: US Q1 uranium production highest since 2018
articles.summary: US production of 82,533 pounds U3O8 (32.1 tU) in the first quarter of 2024 was the highest Q1 production since 2018 and almost 80% more than production for the whole of 2023.

articles.title: Post-irradiation testing of high-burnup fuel under way at ORNL
articles.summary: High burnup fuel rods manufactured by GE Vernova's Global Nuclear Fuel are being examined at the US Department of Energy's Oak Ridge National Laboratory after spending six years in a commercial nuclear power reactor.

articles.title: Would-be producers making the most of the uranium market
articles.summary: NexGen Energy Ltd has said its newly announced strategic purchase of 2.7 million pounds U3O8 (1039 tU), together with a recent share placement, "will significantly assist the company in funding the anticipated capital needs to develop the Rook I Project" in Canada. Denison Mines Corp intends to use its physical uranium investment to support future project…

articles.title: IAEA warns against attacks on, or from, Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant
articles.summary: International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi has restated that "there must be no attack of any kind from or against this major nuclear facility".

articles.title: South Bruce signs hosting agreement with NWMO
articles.summary: The agreement between the municipality of South Bruce and Canada's Nuclear Waste Management Organization was signed following a vote by the municipality's council on 1 May. The area is one of two potential host sites for a deep geologic repository selected in a process launched by the organisation in 2010.

articles.title: EU sets out terms of approved Czech nuclear state aid
articles.summary: The European Commission has approved the Czech Republic's proposed public support package for new nuclear - after a series of modifications were made to address their concerns during an inquiry which began in June 2022.

articles.title: Forging work begins for Paks II project reactor vessel
articles.summary: The mayor of Paks in Hungary was among those present in Russia to see the start of forging of blanks for the reactor vessel of the first unit at the Paks II nuclear power plant, which Rosatom is building.

articles.title: Construction starts of second Lianjiang unit
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 2 at the Lianjiang nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It is the second of two CAP1000 units planned as the initial phase of the plant, which will eventually house six such reactors.

articles.title: Ten-yearly overhaul begins at Bruce B vacuum building
articles.summary: Work has started on a three-week, CAD190 million (USD138 million) overhaul of a crucial part of the safety systems at Bruce B in Canada. Inspections and maintenance to the vacuum building must be carried out once every decade, but can only take place when all four of the plant's operating units are offline.

articles.title: First Westinghouse fuel at Bulgaria's Kozloduy nuclear power plant
articles.summary: A permit has been issued to begin the transition to Westinghouse fuel after the first of its supply was delivered for use in unit 5 of the Kozloduy nuclear power plant, as Bulgaria moves away from past reliance on Russian supplies.

articles.title: China starts mass production of carbon-14 isotope
articles.summary: The carbon-14 isotope is being produced at the Qinshan nuclear power plant, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Production to begin of innovative fuel for German research reactor
articles.summary: France's Framatome and Germany's Technical University of Munich have agreed to establish the industrialisation process for the manufacture of monolithic molybdenum-uranium fuel for the university's FRM II research reactor. Framatome noted this low-enriched fuel will benefit from the highest uranium fuel density ever realised in Europe for research reactor…

articles.title: Energoatom and Holtec sign agreement for SMR manufacturing facilities
articles.summary: The agreement provides for the creation in Ukraine of manufacturing capabilities for components for small modular reactors, plus storage and transportation systems for used nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Framatome signs 'multi-billion euros' contracts with Sizewell C
articles.summary: Framatome says it "has signed contracts worth multi-billion euros" with Sizewell C Ltd for key equipment for the two reactors from the design phase up to commissioning. It has also signed a long-term fuel supply agreement.

articles.title: New Chinese reactor begins supplying power
articles.summary: Fangchenggang unit 4 - the second demonstration Hualong One (HPR1000) reactor at the site in China's Guangxi Autonomous Region - has been connected to the grid, China General Nuclear announced.

articles.title: Digital control system installation begins at Chinese SMR
articles.summary: Installation of the digital control system has begun at the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Second CGN Hualong One starts up
articles.summary: Unit 4 of the Fangchenggang nuclear power plant in China's Guangxi Autonomous Region has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the second of two demonstration CGN-designed Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors at the site.

articles.title: Fourth Korean APR-1400 begins commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 2 of the Shin Hanul nuclear power plant in South Korea has entered commercial operation, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power announced. The unit is the second of two APR-1400 reactors at the site, with a further two planned.

articles.title: Loan guarantee for Palisades restart
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy Loan Programs Office has conditionally committed up to USD1.52 billion for a loan guarantee to Holtec Palisades for its project to bring the Palisades plant, which ceased operations in May 2022, back online. If the project proceeds, it will be the first nuclear power plant in the USA to return to commercial operations after being…

articles.title: Flamanville EPR aiming for summer 2024 grid connection
articles.summary: France's nuclear regulator has launched a three-week public consultation on its draft decision to authorise the commissioning of the Flamanville EPR reactor, which has a summer 2024 target for connection to the grid.

articles.title: Floating nuclear power plant plan for Russia's Far Eastern coast
articles.summary: Rosatom and the government of Primorsky Krai have signed an agreement for a feasibility study and location options for floating nuclear power units off its coast.

articles.title: Work to expand Dutch enrichment plant begins
articles.summary: Uranium enrichment services provider Urenco has broken ground on an expansion of its plant in Almelo in the Netherlands. The move came as the company signed a new long-term supply contract with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power.

articles.title: Chamber calls for Western Australia to overturn uranium ban
articles.summary: Restarting uranium mining in Western Australia could create up to 9000 jobs and produce uranium worth more than AUD1 billion a year, a 12-month inquiry by the state's Chamber of Commerce and Industry has found. It recommends that the state overturn its ban on uranium mining to unlock significant economic benefits.

articles.title: Laser enrichment company declines HALEU opportunity, moves forward with testing
articles.summary: Global Laser Enrichment has decided not to submit a proposal in response to a US Department of Energy request for the acquisition of high-assay low-enriched uranium enrichment, its 51%-owner Silex Systems has announced. The company has also received regulatory approval to load uranium hexafluoride for the start of testing to demonstrate the technology it plans…

articles.title: KAERI completes irradiation tests for high-density research reactor fuel
articles.summary: The Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute's successful irradiation tests and positive inspection of high-density uranium silicide fuel signal potential for high-enriched uranium to low-enriched uranium conversion of high-performance research reactors, aiming to bolster international nuclear non-proliferation efforts upon commercialisation.

articles.title: Fourth Barakah unit connected to grid
articles.summary: The UAE's fourth Barakah reactor connected to the electricity grid, taking the complex closer to full commercial operation.

articles.title: South Africa aims to be global supplier of HTR fuel
articles.summary: As well as preparing to issue a Request for Proposals for 2500 MW of new nuclear "this calendar year", the Nuclear Energy Summit was told that South Africa is developing its Pebble Bed Modular Reactor technology and "deserves the opportunity to implement the complete nuclear fuel cycle for peaceful uses".

articles.title: Permit issued for dismantling of Isar 2
articles.summary: Germany's PreussenElektra has received approval from the Bavarian State Ministry for the Environment and Consumer Protection for the dismantling of the Isar 2 nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Korea gears up for advanced reactor development
articles.summary: South Korea's Ministry of Science & ICT has signed a memorandum of understanding with eight Korean companies to cooperate on the development of next-generation nuclear reactors.

articles.title: France awards grants for molten salt reactor R&D
articles.summary: Molten salt reactor developers Thorizon and Stellaria, both in consortium with Orano, have been selected by the French government to receive funding through the France 2030 national investment plan.

articles.title: Canadian township signs potential repository hosting agreement
articles.summary: The agreement between the Township of Ignace and Canada's Nuclear Waste Management Organization outlines the community's role and potential benefits, and is the next step in the ongoing process to select a site for a repository for the nation's used nuclear fuel.

articles.title: Contract for removal of Mühleberg reactor vessel
articles.summary: A consortium of German companies has been awarded a contract to dismantle and package the reactor pressure vessel, including the vessel head and insulation, at the Mühleberg nuclear power plant in Switzerland.

articles.title: Extrusion demo is milestone for Lightbridge Fuel fabrication
articles.summary: The extrusion of samples of an alloy of depleted uranium and zirconium at Idaho National Laboratory is a critical step in the process to qualify Lightbridge Corporation's advanced nuclear fuel technology.

articles.title: In Quotes: NexGen Energy's Leigh Curyer on uranium project's potential
articles.summary: Innovative approaches to the licensing and permitting side Our approach has been, first of all, understanding what is required to be permitted. So even before we submitted our original project description, we put a lot of work into understanding the permitting process in Canada, the level of validation required around the technical, the environmental and the…

articles.title: X-energy opens first training centre for SMR operators
articles.summary: The centre includes a full-scale plant control room simulator, Reactor Protection System prototype, and virtual reality experience as well as offices and classrooms, and will be used to train future operators of X-energy's Xe-100 advanced small modular reactors.

articles.title: Germany aims to build fusion power plant
articles.summary: A new funding programme for nuclear fusion research has been announced by Germany's Federal Research Minister Bettina Stark-Watzinger aimed at paving the way for the first fusion power plant to be constructed in Germany by 2040.

links.label: Fusion 2040 - Research on the way to a…

articles.title: Transatlantic collaboration on SMR regulation expanded
articles.summary: A trilateral memorandum of cooperation has been signed between the British, Canadian and US nuclear regulators to collaborate on technical reviews of advanced reactor and small modular reactor technologies.

articles.title: El Dabaa: Installation of first unit's inner containment starts
articles.summary: Work has begun on the first tier of the inner containment building for the first unit of the El Dabaa nuclear power plant in Egypt.

articles.title: Darlington New Nuclear Project reaches early milestone
articles.summary: Early-phase site preparation works at Ontario Power Generation's project have been completed on time and on budget, clearing the way for the main site preparation work to begin.

articles.title: Italian firms assess advanced reactor deployment
articles.summary: Italy's Enel and Ansaldo Nucleare have agreed to jointly examine and evaluate new technologies and business models for the generation of nuclear energy - such as small modular reactors and advanced modular reactors - and their industrial applicability.

articles.title: UK-Polish partnership for SMR deployment in Poland
articles.summary: Polish industrial group Industria has signed a letter of intent with UK-based zero emissions energy and technology developer Chiltern Vital Group to collaborate on the deployment of Rolls-Royce small modular reactors in Poland.

articles.title: Fluor to design laser fusion power plant
articles.summary: California-based Longview Fusion Energy Systems has contracted US engineering and construction firm Fluor Corporation to design the world's first commercial laser fusion power plant.

articles.title: Reflector tank lifted for installation in Argentina's RA-10 research reactor
articles.summary: The RA-10 reflector tank was manufactured by INVAP over 32 months at the Bariloche Atomic Centre. It is made of zirconium alloy and weighs 2540 kilograms, is 2 metres in diameter and 1.4 metres tall.

articles.title: BN-600 reactor at Beloyarsk aims for further life extension
articles.summary: Rosenergoatom is to seek approval to extend the life of the BN-600 fast neutron reactor following an inspection of the condition of the reactor vessel, heat exchanger supports and other equipment.

articles.title: First uranium shipped from enCore's Rosita plant
articles.summary: EnCore Energy Corp has announced the first shipment of uranium from its Rosita Central Processing Plant in South Texas, which was returned to operation in November last year. The company also announced the signing of its fifth long-term supply contract.

articles.title: Orano signs uranium enrichment services contract with ČEZ
articles.summary: In a contract signed during a visit to the Czech Republic by French President Emmanuel Macron, Orano will supply uranium enrichment services, which will be used at ČEZ's Dukovany nuclear power plant.

articles.title: SKB begins construction of Forsmark geology building
articles.summary: Sweden's radioactive waste management company Svensk Kärnbränslehantering AB has announced the breaking of ground for its new geology building, which will be a centre for the collection and evaluation of data from surveys and site monitoring on the Forsmark peninsula.

articles.title: Holtec and Hyundai E&C partner with British firms to advance UK SMR bid
articles.summary: South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction, the USA's Holtec International and British construction company Balfour Beatty and engineering firm Mott McDonald have agreed to cooperate on Holtec's bid to construct a small modular reactor in the UK.

articles.title: Contract for ITER vacuum vessel assembly
articles.summary: The Sino-French TAC-1 consortium - led by China National Nuclear Corporation subsidiary China Nuclear Power Engineering and including Framatome - has been awarded a contract to assemble the vacuum chamber modules of the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor, under construction in Cadarache, southern France.

articles.title: Fuel loading begins at Indian fast breeder reactor
articles.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi witnessed the start of fuel loading at the 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam in Tamil Nadu. Fast breeder reactors form the second stage of India's three-stage nuclear programme.

articles.title: Start up of Chinese industrial nuclear steam project begins
articles.summary: Commissioning has begun of China's first industrial-use nuclear energy steam supply project, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. The project at the Tianwan nuclear power plant in China's Jiangsu province will supply steam to a nearby petrochemical plant.

articles.title: Grid connection for Vogtle 4
articles.summary: Georgia Power's Vogtle 4 AP1000 began delivering electricity to the grid as part of start-up testing.

articles.title: Grid connection for Vogtle 4
articles.summary: The AP1000 reactor is now generating electricity and was connected to the grid for the first time on 1 March, Georgia Power has announced.

articles.title: French reactor using full core of recycled uranium fuel
articles.summary: Unit 2 of the Cruas-Meysse nuclear power plant in south-eastern France was recently restarted with its first full core of recycled uranium fuel. The move marks a major milestone in France's efforts to revive its domestic uranium reprocessing industry.

articles.title: Fourth Barakah unit starts up
articles.summary: The Emirates Nuclear Energy Corporation has announced the successful start-up by its operating and maintenance subsidiary Nawah Energy Company of the fourth unit at the Barakah nuclear power plant in the United Arab Emirates.

articles.title: Plans announced for pilot US nuclear fuel recycling plant
articles.summary: Orano USA and SHINE Technologies have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to cooperate on the development of a US pilot plant with commercial-scale technology for recycling used nuclear fuel from light water reactors.

articles.title: IsoEnergy to reopen Utah uranium mine
articles.summary: The Saskatoon-based company will reopen underground access at the Tony M uranium mine in Utah during the first half of this year, with the goal of restarting uranium production operations in 2025, should market conditions continue as expected.

articles.title: PEJ seeks insurance for Polish nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe, which is responsible for the construction of Poland's first nuclear power plant, has joined the Mutual Insurance Association of the Polish Mutual Insurance Institution. It said the move is an important step toward providing insurance coverage for the project.

articles.title: UK research reactor fully decommissioned
articles.summary: The Imperial College Reactor Centre in Ascot, England, has become the first reactor site to be fully decommissioned in the UK under modern regulatory controls, the country's Office for Nuclear Regulation has announced.

articles.title: KHNP, Centrus enhance cooperation in fuel supply
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a Letter of Intent with US nuclear fuel and services company Centrus Energy to ensure a stable supply of nuclear fuel. It follows the signing of a memorandum of understanding between the two companies in April last year.

articles.title: Argentina's RA-10 research reactor aiming for 2026 operation
articles.summary: The RA-10 multipurpose research reactor is now about 80% completed, with its reflector tank set to be installed as construction enters its final phases, Argentina's Foreign Minister Diana Mondino was told during a tour of the facility.

articles.title: India's newest nuclear unit connected to grid
articles.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd has announced that Kakrapar 4 was connected to the grid on 20 February. The 700 MWe unit reached first criticality on 17 December.

articles.title: Sweden moves to lift uranium mining ban
articles.summary: Sweden's Climate and Environment Minister Romina Pourmokhtari has announced the launch of an investigation to abolish the country's ban on uranium mining. The move was welcomed by Australia-based Aura Energy, which hopes to extract uranium as a by-product from its 100%-owned Häggån polymetallic project in Sweden.

articles.title: EBRD signs new grant agreement for next stage of Chernobyl work
articles.summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant have signed Grant Agreement No.2 designed to help "solve the most urgent and critical needs" at the site.

articles.title: Prototype fusion reactor planned for TVA site
articles.summary: US fusion energy developer Type One Energy Group has announced plans to build Infinity One - its stellarator fusion prototype machine - at Tennessee Valley Authority's Bull Run Fossil Plant in Clinton, Tennessee.

articles.title: Investment contract supports US demonstration reactor project
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy and Kairos Energy have signed a technology investment agreement to implement an Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program risk reduction award to support the design, construction, and commissioning of the Hermes demonstration reactor.

articles.title: Construction starts on second phase of Zhangzhou plant
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 3 at the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in Fujian province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. It is the first of two Hualong One units planned as the second phase of the plant, which will eventually house six such reactors.

articles.title: Kyoto Fusioneering and UKAEA sign collaboration agreement
articles.summary: The UK Atomic Energy Authority and the private Japanese fusion technology company Kyoto Fusioneering have signed an agreement which aims to advance tritium breeding blanket technology from its conceptual stage towards commercialisation.

articles.title: Reactor testing of HTGR fuel confirms functionality, Rosatom says
articles.summary: Samples of the fuel began tests in two research reactors in 2022, with Rosatom reporting they "fundamentally confirmed the functionality of the fuel design" for high-temperature gas-cooled reactors.

articles.title: Onagawa 2 restart expected in September
articles.summary: Tohoku Electric Power Company now expects to reconnect unit 2 of its Onagawa nuclear power plant in Japan's northeastern Miyagi Prefecture to the grid in September. In January, the utility said additional safety construction works had delayed the previously planned restart in May.

articles.title: Work begins on new Iranian research reactor
articles.summary: Concrete pouring for a 10 MW research reactor has begun at Isfahan, the Atomic Energy Organisation of Iran has announced. The organisation has also declared operational a new emergency control room simulator for unit 1 at the Bushehr nuclear power plant.

articles.title: GNF gets approval to manufacture higher enrichment fuel
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved GE Vernova's nuclear fuel business to manufacture, ship and analyse the performance of nuclear fuel with uranium-235 enrichments of up to 8%.

articles.title: Slovakia's SMR timescales outlined as Project Phoenix gets under way
articles.summary: A feasibility study, as part of the US-funded Project Phoenix, is looking into the potential for small modular reactors in Slovakia with an indicative timeline to 2035.

articles.title: Vogtle 4 reaches first criticality
articles.summary: Georgia Power has announced that the new Vogtle unit 4 AP1000 reactor has reached initial criticality, with the unit's in-service date now projected to be during the second quarter of 2024.

articles.title: Waste issues need consideration in SMR deployment, says CoRWM
articles.summary: Waste management issues need to have a significantly greater prominence in the process of developing and deploying small modular reactor and advanced modular reactor designs, according to the UK's Committee on Radioactive Waste Management (CoRWM).

articles.title: ČEZ steps up preparations for arrival of Westinghouse fuel
articles.summary: Czech nuclear power plant operator ČEZ says that its fuel diversification strategy will see the first Westinghouse VVER fuel delivered to its Dukovany nuclear power plant at the end of the year.

articles.title: Westinghouse begins UK licensing process for AP300
articles.summary: The company has formally submitted an application to the UK Department of Energy Security and Net Zero for approval to enter the Generic Design Assessment for the AP300 small modular reactor.

articles.title: Fuel transfer trolley in place at Finnish encapsulation plant
articles.summary: The transfer trolley for moving used fuel transport casks has been installed at Finnish waste management company Posiva's encapsulation plant under construction at Olkiluoto.

articles.title: Bulgaria and USA sign nuclear cooperation agreement
articles.summary: The USA and Bulgaria have signed an intergovernmental agreement to cooperate on the development of the European country's civil nuclear programme, including the plan for new units at the Kozloduy nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Cylinder shortages hit Centrus HALEU plans
articles.summary: The US nuclear fuel and services company expects the shortages to be temporary but says it will no longer be able to deliver the anticipated 900 kg of material under the second part of its contract with the US Department of Energy.

articles.title: TRIGA International begins fabricating MARVEL fuel
articles.summary: The Framatome-General Atomics joint venture has begun fabricating the fuel for the US Department of Energy's MARVEL microreactor, with delivery of the first shipment of fuel expected in spring 2025.

articles.title: Agreement signed for planned UK fleet of AP300 reactors
articles.summary: Westinghouse has signed an agreement with Community Nuclear Power Limited for the construction of four AP300 small modular reactors in the North Teesside region of northeast England. It would be the UK's first privately-financed SMR fleet.

articles.title: Construction starts on French lead-212 production facility
articles.summary: Orano subsidiary Orano Med has laid the foundation stone for its Alpha Therapy Laboratory in Onnaing in northern France. This will be Europe's first industrial-scale pharmaceutical facility dedicated to the production of lead-212 based radioligand therapies.

articles.title: Five express interest in Kozloduy new nuclear construction
articles.summary: The deadline to express an interest in the construction of the proposed two new units at the Kozloduy nuclear power plant in Bulgaria has passed, with five companies submitting applications.

articles.title: UK decommissioning research partnership begins to bear fruit
articles.summary: A research partnership between the UK's Nuclear Decommissioning Authority and National Decommissioning Centre, formed in 2022, is already helping the energy sector to reduce costs and emissions, improve environmental outcomes and deliver sustainable net-zero decommissioning.

articles.title: SaskPower-GEH agreement to advance SMR development
articles.summary: Canadian Utility SaskPower and GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy have signed an agreement to advance small modular reactor development in Saskatchewan. In June 2022, SaskPower selected GEH's BWRX-300 as the technology to be used in its SMR development work.

articles.title: Invitation issued to express interest in Kozloduy 7 construction
articles.summary: Those seeking selection for the engineering, construction, procurement and commissioning of a new AP1000 unit at the Kozloduy nuclear power plant site by 2035, have until 2 February to respond to an invitation for expression of interest.

articles.title: US Administration signs off on federal funding for Diablo Canyon
articles.summary: The US Administration has signed the credit award and payment agreement finalising the USD1.1 billion in credit payments awarded under the Civil Nuclear Credit programme to help keep the Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant in operation.

articles.title: UEC to restart Wyoming uranium operation
articles.summary: First uranium production at Christensen Ranch is expected in August after Uranium Energy Corp's board of directors approved restarting the fully permitted and past-producing in-situ leach operation - the output will be sold at prevailing spot market prices.

articles.title: Sizewell C project to enter construction phase
articles.summary: The Sizewell C nuclear power plant project has been awarded a Development Consent Order, paving the way for formal construction work to begin at the site in Suffolk, UK.

articles.title: Molten salt test system reaches operational milestone
articles.summary: Kairos Power has successfully completed 1000 hours of pumped salt operations with its non-nuclear Engineering Testing Unit. The unit, loaded with 12 tonnes of Flibe salt, is the largest Flibe system ever built and will inform the design, construction, and operation of the Hermes low-power demonstration reactor.

articles.title: Licences issued for main stage of Leningrad 7 and 8 construction
articles.summary: Russian nuclear regulator Rostekhnadzor has issued licences to Rosatom for the construction of nuclear installations for Leningrad nuclear power plant's proposed units 7 and 8.

articles.title: China approves construction of four new reactors
articles.summary: The construction of two Hualong One reactors at each of the Taipingling and Jinqimen sites was approved by China's State Council at a 29 December meeting. Meanwhile, various milestones have been reached in the construction of other Chinese units.
